Many cancelled appointments for various things like blood tests and cervical smears etc. that’s if you can get an appointment. Worst surgery I’ve ever been to. Moved my son and myself today and hoping the new GP is as good as its reviews!

reviews.author: Lally Rai
reviews.text: This GP surgery is completely unfit to provide patient care. The behaviour of both staff and doctors is unprofessional, dismissive, and unsafe. I was refused an appointment for my baby one year old despite nappy rash , and medication was issued without a proper examination. The lack of duty of care, empathy, and basic medical standards is alarming. Patients are not treated with the seriousness or respect they deserve. I would strongly advise anyone who values their health and their children’s safety to consider registering elsewhere.

reviews.author: Yuran Amorim
reviews.text: You look for gp is because you need help, but they act as if they are doing a favor. No interest in helping or solving the problem.

reviews.author: Fazaila Pirbhai
reviews.text: Receptionist show no warmth or care , very cold and don't seem interested in being friendly. I have been at surgery since I was a child and have seen it change. Sad to see this. Specially when they are dealing with the elderly and vulnerable members of our community. Nurse also had no real warmth and gentleness you would expect when dealing with an elderly person. This is a reflection of the times we live in. Shame. Considering changing GP after 30 years with them.

reviews.author: Sherni 97
reviews.text: One of the worst receptionist and doctors , unfortunately we still have to use this service just because my mom lives around the corner. My mom unfortunately doesn’t speak English and for this the receptionist cancelled her appointment just because she was not able to confirm her date of birth in English instead of bringing a translator on the call. Racism on a high level in this surgery they booked her in 3 weeks from her appointment when they were always aware she was not able to communicate in English. Receptionist and doctors where laughing and refused to speak to me as they where aware what they did with her was wrong ! Once again one of worst surgery , receptionist and doctors and I’ll report this higher and take legal action against them. I’ll soon upload on TikTok the call I had with them to show there real faces.

reviews.author: Richard Seddon
reviews.text: Rude, unhelpful, ignorant and condescending receptionists

reviews.author: Christine Astley
reviews.text: I have been with this surgery for nearly 70 years. The service we now receive is terrible. I was trying to get an appointment via this new system. A member of staff helped me fill it in I said can I see a doctor now she said no someone will ring you back within 48 hours. I was in agony and ended up in A& E. I know it's the same all over the board now. I'm not happy at all with any treatment with my particular issue at the moment. NHS is absolutely bobbins now and it's not getting any better

reviews.author: Marianne Smith
reviews.text: There is no point in adding a note on the app for this surgery. As they ignore it or dismiss it. Also the receptionist are very condescending. Could do with training in mental health as they are very ignorant.

reviews.author: Afziba
reviews.text: Very good

reviews.author: Gwenda Atherton
reviews.text: I have been with this surgery all my life. Have always been supportive and responsive to all our families needs. Cared for my parents during serious health conditions. Support has been amazing for me in the last 6 months following a significant health need.

reviews.author: Lucy Clark
reviews.text: I was unfortunately involved in a RTA and experienced acute pain as a result of my car being written off. Receptionist was rude and uncaring and told me there were no appointments. I was told I would have to pay to be seen! Once I had made it clear I would pay the earliest appointment was offered a month later and told me to go to accident and emergency.What an absolute waste of NHS resources. Surgery are forcing patients to use app which is impossible! Feel so sorry for elderly vulnerable people being told they can’t simply get an appointment without filling forms on line and with access to internet.

reviews.author: Lauren
reviews.text: Had an appointment for my son in regards to certain traits he’s showing and eating habits. Just a complete joke of a place. This so called new doctor Rebecca Oakes was running 45 mins behind, not even a “sorry for the wait I’ve ran behind.” We all run behind and an apology doesn’t go amiss. I was told to contact the doctors to get some help and information on my child and his eating habits and showing signs of ARFID, ADHD and autism. Now I know ADHD & Autism isn’t something that can be assumed at a younger age of 3 but the second I went into her room I felt like I was being looked down on, judged and spoken to like a piece of rubbish. Rebecca Oakes wasn’t someone I’d want to see again, I’m assuming she thought I was some irresponsible 18 year old girl when I’m not, I’m 32 years old and I know when I should be worried about my child. Instead I was judged, looked down on like a piece of rubbish and spoken to like a complete joke and sent a link on why my child is a fussy eater. I’d rather pay to go private than ever come to her again for any form of advice.

reviews.author: Shirley Burke
reviews.text: I have been with this practice for years. I said it used to be hard getting an appointment until they merged with Heaton practice, I have recently seen a few of the doctors and I have found them very helpful and easy to talk to. The receptionists I have found very professional and helpful. Well done to all.

reviews.author: Euan
reviews.text: The receptionists are so incredibly rude , an elderly man showed up early for his appointment and was met with unfair judgment and a confrontational attitude all because he was confused about when he was supposed to arrive Unfortunately it is always the same every time I come

reviews.author: Amelia Stringfellow
reviews.text: Always offered an appointment when needed, and receptionists are helpful on the phone whenever I have queries. I have used the e-consult form a few times now and am always contacted promptly and booked in appropriately. I have seen several doctors who have all been very knowledgeable, caring and empathetic. Would definitely recommend this surgery!

reviews.author: Shez N
reviews.text: I first registered with this doctors surgery in 2010. Never had a problem until they stopped making appointments in person or over the phone. Since e consult came in they just don’t seem to care. They fob u off all the time. My brother has had same issue and ended up inA&e more time than I’d like to recall. They don’t care he has type 1 diabetes and suffers immensely daily plus has a young child to care for as a single father so a GP is sorta his life-line. Just say o fill out the e consult. Don’t know why they even bother picking up the phones they’re so rude. I moved to horwich to Kildonan house & they are an absolute god send making appointments via the phone even on the same day, even have a pharmacist trained to Prescribe & will call u back to discuss medication changes etc. pharmacy is open all the time (til late) and the surgery even Saturdays. Good luck if ur new to Dalefield, I hope you have ur health and never need to go!

reviews.author: Had68 Bu123
reviews.text: They wouldn't let me get an appointment with the doctor because it had to be done online, even though it was an emergency and the receptionist wasn't friendly.

reviews.author: Dipisha patel
reviews.text: Receptionist are absolutely horrid no care in the world for their patients. So rude on the phone they need to learn how to speak to people with respect! Think they need to learn customer service. If you don’t like your Job find another one! 🤬 …

reviews.author: Martin Morris
reviews.text: Been a patient here since it was built. When it was Avondale Health Centre.Time Not anymore. Receptionist unhelpful. If you can speak to one. E booking system? No wonder it's empty.

reviews.text: Kovacs bendeguz1 reviewEdited a year ago

reviews.author: A B (B.A)
reviews.text: With this new e-consult system they are getting worse. If someone is having emergency they say they don’t have appointments for same day. Don’t know when NHS will get better?

reviews.author: Peter Sloane
reviews.text: What a palaver!!!! The e-consult form is a complete waste of time and effort. Rang the surgery 4 times, only to be advised to go on-line and use the e-consut form.🤬🤬🤬🤬 It DOESN'T WORK!!!!!!🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬🤬

reviews.author: Christina Allman
reviews.text: I contacted the surgery with my issue via the e consult app. Having never used it before I was a bit sceptical however I had a call back within 30mins from the surgery and a sane day urgent appt booked for me within 2 hours. The dr I saw was empathetic and knowledgeable. I was referred to secondary services and within 30 mins of leaving the surgery I had a message asking me to book my appt with secondary care which is in early May. The reception staff were friendly and polite. Overall very happy with my consult, the staff and the new process. Thank you despite the challenges you are all facing.

reviews.author: james hughes
reviews.text: Tried calling, got to number one in the queue and was then on hold for 20 mins. Finally got through to someone to order a repeat prescription as not showing on the NHS app. I was then told my prescription, which i have had for years, was now classified as a controlled drug and could not be a repeat prescription. Was told to order via email and to get the info form the website. Tried find this this but was advised by the website to call the surgery direct.... When I tried to call back, placed on hols again, then a message came one that the lines were now closed for unforseen circumstances. What is going on Dalefield surgery, Going from bad to worse over the past few years.

reviews.author: Rodrimars Lúcifer
reviews.text: One of the worst experiences I've ever had, poor service and lack of professionalism. If you want the best for your health, look for another GP

reviews.author: Kamini Patel
reviews.text: I've been woth this surgery for over 40 years, since I was born. Shocking how bad it has become! My prescription should have been sorted 2 weeks ago. It's now Easter weekend and I'm left without meds after calling many times this week to sort it out! Time to find a new surgery!

reviews.author: Gh Ku
reviews.text: I will say just if you suppose you are dying you can't get an appointment. Because of this GP i admitted in Hospital ENT ward.Receptions staff are really rude they don't know how can they use manners. Very rude and aggressive. It should be reported this GP and all rubbish staff.

reviews.author: hadeel fathi

reviews.author: Marilane Dias
reviews.text: Disappointed very bad costumer service .

reviews.author: maryam rizvi
reviews.text: Lovely friendly staff always been a good experience

reviews.author: Jamie Ale
reviews.text: Mental health team push you aside and don't care, the doctors are very fast to say its viral your arm could be hanging off. The receptionist are the first to judge "ring at 8, I got here before 8" forgetting there job could be done by a toddler and probably run better. They want to be treated with respect but talk to you like you've just curb stomped there nan. And the reply saying you can book appointments is a lie either ring at 8 or forget it. Let the hunger games begin.

reviews.author: Lauren Edwards
reviews.text: Can never get through ringing from dot on 8am for the line to be constantly engaged. Ever since certain people left this doctors have gone downhill. Rude receptionists, more interested about going to the pineapple and having a kebab for their dinner and slagging patients off.

reviews.author: Chloe Armstrong
reviews.text: I thought I was just being abit petty about this but looking at these reviews it seems like everybody has the same thoughts. This surgery has gone down hill massively! The receptionist think they know it all, rude! (Not all of them as I have had some really helpful ladies help me in the past) being put on hold from 8am till 8.38am to be told yet again 'no appointments' call back at 8am.

reviews.author: Ciprian Moraru
reviews.text: Tried to make a booking, for my child (she's having scarlet fever) I've ringed them at 11am and been told that they will book us in ASAP, ringed again around 3pm same story just to get a call at 17.58 to tell me that will be tommorow.

reviews.author: Rockstar Sara
reviews.text: service is shocking not able to get appointments even though form 8 am they are constantly engaged also when you do get hold of someone in the afternoon receptionist thinks she is a doctor and giving terrible advices Needs changing ASAP

reviews.author: Maipelo Maiketso
reviews.text: Worst..from 8 the phone will be engaged when they pick they will tell you ho fully booked they are I have been calling from 23 December till today I haven't been able to book to see the doctor bt I am a diabetic patient

reviews.author: young spanglas
reviews.text: Worst GP ever if your dying you will probably die before getting any help from them been calling for nearly one month to get an appointment, but they keep telling me to call back in the morning at 8:00 o'clock when your calling at 8:00 they don't pick up the phone until 9:00 when they do answer the phone they tell you they don't have any appointments left, and when you do ask for a call back if anyone cancel they tell you they don't have a cancellation list.. if I could honestly give no star I would!

reviews.author: Nadia Bibi
reviews.text: I have been calling for an appointment for 3 day all they saying no appointments are left, they don't answer the call until 8.30am and when they do they say no appointments left. This gp is on of the worst in Bolton. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Our phones are answered from 8am and we have a team of receptionists answering the phone from that time. GP services are in high demand and one of the top comments we receive is that people are held in a queue for long periods of time in the mornings. Another way to access Dalefield Surgery is to visit www.online-consult.co.uk/org/dalefield-surgery and complete an online consultation form. These are looked at and responded to within 2 working days. This reduces the need to phone at 8am for non urgent issues. www.mygp.io/fxb. If you feel that your problem is urgent then it helps to explain to the receptionist so as they can speak to a clinician for further advice and get back to you as there may be other services that you could be signposted to that have availability sooner or the clinician may agree that your problem needs to be dealt with that day and will add you to the end of their clinic. You can also pre book an appointment. We have appointments up to 3 months in advance at 1-2 weeks notice.

reviews.author: Geraldine McPhee
reviews.text: I find all aspects of the surgery very efficient and professional. Reception staff are always polite and helpful. Couldn't wish for a better GP than Dr. Pat Cross. Nurses I see are all friendly and knowledgeable. Very happy with Dalefield Surgery.

reviews.author: basma zoghbi
reviews.text: Worst gp surgery every, very disappointed with the service they provide I had to wait up to one hour to speak to someone over the phone.

reviews.author: Atlas Rock
reviews.text: Worst surgery I've been to. You can wait upto an hour to speak to someone then they will say ring up at 8am in morning. You don't get to see a doctor. Very bad service.

reviews.author: Sam Dee
reviews.text: Very disappointed with the service they provide. It's almost impossible to get through to someone for an appointment, the phone just bleeps for a good half an hour before a receptionist is available to take a call. They need to improve the quality of their services quickly!

reviews.author: Justa Guy
reviews.text: Worst gp surgery ever, they will tell you anxiety and depression is your own fault, also quick to over prescribe medications like omg soooo many pill's but yet cant tell me whats wrong, they only it for the money they dont give a damn about you as a person you are just a paycheck to them, unprofessional rude and questionable practices..... Avoid this place at all cost

reviews.author: Georgia Kelly
reviews.text: I was worried when I moved address that I would have to change surgery but thankfully I was able to stay. Really helpful reception staff. Easy to get an appointment with your GP of choice. Quick waiting times. All round good service.

reviews.author: Paul Rogers
reviews.text: Absolutely abysmal. Impossible to get an appointment. My wife tried every single day for 10 days, queuing from 8am and just gets told no when she eventually gets through. Avoid at all costs, there are better alternatives in heaton. I go to a surgery in BL3 because this surgery has been useless for years.

reviews.author: Alison Caller
reviews.text: They work hard to give the best care possible

reviews.author: M B
reviews.text: Staff very rude and arrogant, I have a problem with a visit to the specialist. Very bad management, they should learn to be helpful to people. I don't recommend .

reviews.author: Azer Zahid
reviews.text: Clean and reliable

reviews.author: gillian chase
reviews.text: Reception staff should not laugh at the patient. Not professional.

reviews.author: hayley jackson
reviews.text: I've been a patient at the surgery for three years. In recent times I have been quite frustrated. I follow the protocol, which is to ring every morning at 8am to book an appointment. Everytime I ring it takes a while to actually get through to the phone. Always busy and beeping till at least 8.30am. When i do get through to their phone, I wait at least 30 to 45 minutes until I speak to a receptionist. Only then to be told that there are no appointments and to ring again the next morning. They always mention that they've not got enough reception staff to answer the calls on time and apologise. It's every day. I already have anxiety phoning in the doctors anyway, but to be told everytime there's no appointments it puts me off even more to go and see the doctor. I went in person today, to a quite surgery we're there was no patients in the waiting room. In hope that I would get an appointment finally. I was told again there were no appointments, would I like to book one for next week. I said yes please. She had a look for an appointment next week, to my disappointment there were no appointments available at all for next week. She then told me to ring out of hours or ring in next week at 8am. What's the point when I have been told there are no appointments and then to be on phone for over an hour to get the same treatment again. Sick to death of their being no appointments to see a doctor. If the number of patients is increasing get more doctors and receptionists! I will be changing my surgery.

reviews.author: Monika Mikolajczak
reviews.text: Made me an appt which I took a day off for, they then moved my appt for another day. I turn up on the day again been cancelled without even letting me know. This is now two days off work I had to take for nothing. Absolute joke

reviews.author: cath perks
reviews.text: Astonished that I was not informed that I do not have to pay for prescriptions for cancer treatment! At a stressful time this is a fundamental piece of information to take away financial worry. Communication needs to be improved here!

reviews.author: Scootes
reviews.text: Went there for a blood-test and was 5 minutes late and they said i couldn't have it because i was late, but the thing is that you have to wait maximum half an hour for it and the man at the desk was very rude to me and my mother, arrogant staff

reviews.author: Peter Holt
reviews.text: I find that I can usually get an appointment that suits me. Usually see Dr Cross or Dr Priest or the practice nurse. I always feel confident that I am bring treated correctly in a clean & safe environment Reception staff are all helpful and friendly.

reviews.author: zodwa zulu
reviews.text: My family and I are very sad to be leaving due to change of address. You looked after me extremely well. Many thanks to you all members of staff. Special thanks to Dr Cross, Lorraine and Dr Ahsan. God bless you.

reviews.author: Natasha-Anne Greenhalgh
reviews.text: Not been at this surgery for long, but the doctors we have seen have been great and the reception staff are always polite and helpful.

reviews.author: clare nicholson
reviews.text: I'd rather not say but definitely changing my doctors never asked abut why I went to see them just had ago regarding missed appointment with clinic 😭😭sat in mess never offered tissue and always full of rubbish outside …

reviews.author: Alex Matlock
reviews.text: Extremely friendly reception staff, they will always help you if they can. The doctors here are first class and very professional as are the nursing staff too.

reviews.author: Yasin Gajra
reviews.text: I think the doctors need more training the reception staff need to go on a customer service training course as the have no manners and the toilets are filthy absolutely ridiculous for the year 2016 I thought I was in 1990 the way I was dealt with

reviews.author: David Butcher
reviews.text: Friendly staff. Appointment service top rate. Friendly and efficient medical staff. Who could ask for anything more?

reviews.author: Brian Grimshaw
reviews.text: Good family doctors. Dr J Lowe and Dr Falkner have retired (Sadly all good things must end). New doctors are fine Have to phone up early morning 8 to 8.30 to get a phone appointment or emergency appointment can be hit and miss for same day face to face appointment. Like most doctors surgery's no walk in service. May not be able to see or speak to doctor of your choice as there are a number of trainees woking here. Have started an out of hours service but only trainee GPs for minor ailments.

reviews.author: Paul Mirza
reviews.text: The best Doctors around

reviews.author: Nicola Henry
reviews.text: Got a call to say GP needed to do an exam following an ultrasound. GP who I seen kept looking up and down at me from the moment I walked in the room. Body language shocking! Asked me why I was there and why I needed the exam?? Attitude made me feel horrible considering the reason I was there. When I said I think it was all to do with menopause she told me I had to make a new appointment for that which is fair enough if it takes more time. She wouldn’t prescribe me my migraine medication and said needed another appointment for that! I wouldn’t usually leave a bad review if something didn’t really annoy me but I feel the GPs attitude to me from the moment I walked in was absolutely disgusting! Booked yet another appointment with a kinder doctor over the phone who actually listened to me and prescribed correct medication for my needs.The 2nd GP who dealt with my needs was brilliant! Hats off to him! The 1st one I’ll never book an appointment with again!

reviews.author: Elaine Buckley
reviews.text: Every doctor i have ever seen have been very good

reviews.author: Tony Barlow
reviews.text: I've waited over 3 weeks for a phone consultation despite contacting the surgery because I'm in extreme pain and being told that I would have to have a phone consultation first to be assessed. I've even contacted the surgery a second time to see if the appointment could be brought forward only to be told thar there aren't any other appointments available and that I would have to try ringing at 8am each morning to see if I can get one...a bit difficult when I start work at 7am and drive for a living. Finally got to the day of my appointment only to receive a text message saying that the doctor had tried to get through but couldn't. That's a bit strange because I received the text 5 minutes after I had allegedly been called and also rang the surgery straight back at 16:43 who said the doctor called at 16:28 . Amazing isn't it that I can get through to the surgery but the doctor couldn't get in contact with me when I was in the same location...then again it is getting close to home time after a very long day so why try any harder than you have to. I've now got a appointment with the out of hours doctor in two days time...pity I wasn't offered this earlier. The surgery has gone down the pan and doctors are exploiting the phone consultation.

reviews.author: Carol Turner
reviews.text: Rubbish surgery wouldn’t even check if a prescription had been sent to my nominate pharmacy as it wasn’t past 9am the receptionist told me to ring back I said I can’t I’m in work then. Receptionist said well ring the pharmacy I said how they don’t open until 9am I’ll be in work then. Receptionist said we are dealing with emergencies first thing on the telephone, I said there can’t be that many I was number one in the telephone queue Whilst I understand there are rules whilst she was being rude and arrogant she could have looked for it 30 seconds it would have taken instead the call took 2 minutes. I have to check as there has been ongoing problems with my repeat prescriptions. Awful practice

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.text: Can never get to use e-consult especially when the surgery is closed. (Which is when it would be more convenient) When I telephone to ask for a sick note, they send you an e-consult🙄. I am sometimes made to feel like that I am inconveniencing the reception staff. …

reviews.author: Maxine Cooper
reviews.text: Calls always answered in a friendly timely way. Very helpful and patient recetionists. Doctors and nurses very supportive and totally patient friendly. Never had a complaint since coming to this practice about 10 years ago.

reviews.author: Brian Smith
reviews.text: I have been a patient at the surgery for 40years and I am now in my 60s. I have never had any cause to complain in an that time. The Doctor's, Nurses and Receptionists are professional and caring in everything that they do.

reviews.author: Gemma Eccles
reviews.text: Well never had problems with the doctors there fab ots the receptionist think they now it all whos requests for the bloods doctor nothing on here well that's what he said anyway I got my appointment. But they should mind thete own business and if you say you need bloods should not be asked anything eles

reviews.author: Julie Allen
reviews.text: Lovely Lady doing my Ultrasound today very reassuring.

reviews.author: Ali Abdallah Hassan
reviews.text: My lovely GP Thank you every one ther .

reviews.author: Chris Stokes
reviews.text: I honestly don't get the poor reviews, I've been here 9 years and cannot fault it other than a cold receptionist at one point who has now left. The doctors are supportive and have helped me many times in the past, there are always some negativity with people but for me 5* and cannot even compare it with the abomination which is Tonge moor health centre and it's absolutely shambolic practice. The GP's are humans and talk to you as a human not just another job task do be sidelined. Thank you for your support all of you, outstanding performance

reviews.author: Roz
reviews.text: 20 years ago Dr Faulkner told me I had IBS without first testing for other causes. Yet on my file it is listed as "suspected IBS" so not formally diagnosed despite being told it was. You cannot diagnose IBS without ruling out other issues. Celiac runs in my family, but it could also be IBD. So been possibly living with either of these untreated for 20 years. Also refused my Right to Choose for ADHD diagnosis (details of which are below, as this was my first reason for the negative review), and had to go private and turns out I do in fact have ADHD. Also failed my Mother in multiple ways, who has now died unexpectedly this year ----- FINAL EDIT: P-UK got in touch personally with Dr Faulkner (only contact they could find) and were ignored. They don't wish to help at all so I'll be switching GP. EDIT: Responded to my letter, basically saying they do not have funding for Bolton, when P-UK have the authority of NHS England that any NHS England patient is eligible for treatment with them under the Right to Choose. I'm now having to follow up. Also, what health centre does not have a way of contacting them online? ----- Really disappointed. Sent a letter to ask to be referred to a specialist (under my Right to Choose) to see if I potentially have ADHD and have had no follow up almost a month later. I'm sure my letter, sent by Signed for Delivery and received, was ignored or thrown away, despite me taking the time to write it and filled in forms which could indicate that I have it and I should be referred. Can't get into the clinic to see someone and ask (though I sent a letter so I'd have some evidence of it). No one has sent a letter or called me. This year has has been extra difficult for me and was hoping I could figure it out so I could get possibly CBT (therapy) to manage it but the clinic do not wish to help. Happy to speak to someone on the phone if they phone me about it, but last time I called about another issue they didn't even know what had happened.

reviews.author: Sonia Forsyth
reviews.text: I would like to leave a review for Niaomi the practice nurse. I have been to see her on 3 occasions over the past 2 weeks and each time she has performed my checks, taking bloods and my ecg in the most professional manner. Nothing was too much trouble for her and her friendly reassuring approach made it so much easier to talk about my problems. A real credit to the surgery. Best I've seen. ❤

reviews.author: Katie Brett
reviews.text: AVOID AVOID AVOID If I could gove zero stars I would, this has taken a while for me to write. Been with the surgery since birth never changed from the area I live in. I had literally just had a baby and within the first week of giving birth contacted the surgery to register him. Not only was I told this wasn't possible due to my area I was then told I was to find another doctor as I was also out the area due to changes within area restrictions. I explained I had just given birth and had been with them myself for over 30 years to which I was told well I'm sure you will find another doctor, I also explained my concerns over my new babies vaccinations and also his health check an my own, I was told we will send all details over but it can take 8 weeks. I was mortified in tears and emotions all over the place to which I was met with a cold non helpful response an one point a laugh, I didn't find this a funny situation at all I was in a vulnerable position and then had to find myself an my newborn baby a doctor. Also my eldest son was registered with this surgery but at no point was it mentioned he had to be removed it made no sense! I Pleaded to stay with the surgery as I felt comfortable with to be met with we have already removed you whilst on the phone I suggest you find somewhere else. Absolutely disgusting. I removed my eldest son from them as I do not want him to have to deal with surgery and reception staff who work within it. I also accept surgeries have to adhere to changes of area etc but I do not accept how it was dealt with and how I left after just having a baby the most vulnerable position a women could be in! I am so glad I found elsewhere who immediately arranged checks for my baby an myself an ensured all vaccinations where taken care of.

reviews.author: Gaynor Van Den Berg
reviews.text: Literally cannot fault this place. Been here since I was a child. They've been so supportive, even through Covid. Superb service and my husband and I have always been able to at least talk to someone if we've needed reassurance. We're so grateful.

reviews.author: Sumera Majeed
reviews.text: I like this place

reviews.author: Helen Tatr
reviews.text: I have been with this practice since birth and am now in my 50s with a range of long term health needs. The rest of my family are also registered with the same practice and several of them including my daughter have complex ongoing health needs. We have all always had amazing care and service from all involved in the practice and I would never want to go anywhere else. As with all NHS services there maybe a wait for routine matters but whenever we have needed them or the need has been urgent the practice have always seen us quickly! reviews.author: Kal Chudasama
reviews.text: Patient Feedback I have been with the practice for around 36 years and have seen many changes over time, especially with staff turnover — particularly among receptionists, where there seems to be a high turnover and a lack of consistency. The doctors have also changed in recent years, but the current team is very good. I have spoken to and been seen by various GPs, and I appreciate that treatment options are always explained thoroughly, including both the pros and cons. It’s reassuring that I can always speak to a doctor over the phone when needed, and face-to-face or out-of-hours appointments are available upon request. However, I feel that out-of-hours appointments are not well-promoted, and more awareness should be raised around this service. Despite the many changes, the care and quality from the MSK team, doctors, and nurses remain consistently high. Prescription requests made via the app are handled promptly and sent quickly to my nominated pharmacy, which is very efficient. I have given 3 stars due to the attitude of some of the receptionists, which has impacted my overall experience. Suggestions and Areas for Improvement: 1. I would like the option to speak directly with a practice manager or someone in a managerial position in person to address any issues, without the need to email or raise a formal complaint. 2. Some reception staff could improve their communication and approach with patients. On one occasion, I went to collect my medical records and had a phone appointment booked to discuss results. The GP called during my work hours, and when I called the surgery back to explain, the receptionist was dismissive and defensive. I was told the receptionist who made the booking was in training, but the conversation lacked empathy and professionalism. This needs to be addressed to ensure better patient interactions. 3. I would like the ability to book appointments via the app again, as I was previously able to do. It would be great if the surgery could look into reinstating this feature. 4. Where possible, it would be helpful to have continuity by seeing or speaking to the same GP consistently. Lastly, I do appreciate the improved phone queue system — it’s a noticeable improvement compared to before. Practice response date: 10 months ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We welcome your feedback which will ultimately assist us to improve the services we deliver. The surgery endeavours to provide the best possible standard of care to all our patients and we will continue with regular monitoring and review to enable us to constantly improve the services we offer. Octagon Medical Centre

reviews.author: Kasper MB
reviews.text: Consider the fact I booked a blood test because I had my own concerns about something. After my blood was taken I was told it would take 7 days for the results with a day I received two text message one telling me to book an appointment with a health improvement practitioner and not requesting me to book a second blood test. When I called the office the automated message ask me to call after 3pm for blood test results when I called after 3pm I was told I had to call at 8am to book a doctors appointment to speak about my blood test results. So the automated message was misinformation and what's more I still had not been told why I needed a second blood test. The reception insisted they didn't know why and I should speak to the doctor however they still expected me to book a second blood test I informed them several times I didn't have time for this yet they failed to understand why I was annoyed about being asked to do something without being informed why, especially as this is about my blood test, for which I already had concern is about and this was my time the fact I am the patient and have the right to be informed about my own health and what is happening with my blood seems to evaded this office. Furthermore I received a phone call hours later insisting I was to book a second blood test, totally ignoring my previous conversation, even more ride this was by way of phone call one a withheld number, why does the doctor need to hide its phone number? Ridiculous! It gets worse because all this was on Friday and Monday afternoon yes I received another call from doctors office on a withheld number telling me I must book another blood test once again without informing exactly why this was needed! Terrible treatment of patient and total lack of respect for what I previously explained, I was busy but that didn't matter just pestering me, so yes I spent 60 pounds in taxi to get to the doctors and have a second blood test still unaware of what happened to my first test. And when I asked what was happening with the second one I was told I had to book an appointment to speak to the doctor I'd that after 3pm or 8am? Why is it so difficult to gey an answer and be informed I went from being concerned to not wanting to know well atleast the doctors has satisfied thier curiosity about my blood and my health and I guess I'll to wait two weeks to discover why I need to speak to a health care improving specialist, Terrible experience.

reviews.author: Stoobhoy MacanAba
reviews.text: My experience of this surgery has been nothing but positive. Previously been healthy and rarely visited a doctors surgery, but due to a back injury a few years back I found my first port of call the Octagon Medical Centre and my Dr and Physio at the centre have been nothing short of a Godsend. Due to the nature of my injury and the waiting list for hospital appointments etc after Covid I was initially dreading the wait, but have been well looked after and was sent for a scan relatively quick after my initial appointment at the Octagon Medical Centre. A couple of surgical procedures later and one to one with pain management specialists have helped me come to terms with my ongoing injury and I feel positive about my recovery and the future. My medication and prescriptions have always been talked through and are always available when requested and I am now being talked through my next procedure with the specialists - all thanks to that initial meeting with my Doctor at the Octagon MC. All involved have been nothing but a credit to the NHS and if you’re unsure about your next step then my advice is make an appointment to discuss it with someone at the Octagon MC and I’m sure you won’t be disappointed and any worries will alleviate after that discussion. Thank you OMC! Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for your recent positive review and taking the time to tell us about your experience. reviews.author: Lisa Inns
reviews.text: I telephoned the receptionist yesterday for a chick up with the nurse but she said I can't have on because I am not due till February but I have not had one this year I asked for this because my blood pressure is sky high I had it taken at moss bank pharmacy when he did my flu jabs I was quite worried also I asked for a annual check which she still said no to I was very disappointed with her attitude Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to tell us about your experience. We provide annual review around a patients’ birth month including blood test and a nurse check-up for those with chronic illnesses. However, if there are any issues, we would absolutely like to see you earlier but not necessarily for a full annual review. It sounds like there may have been some miscommunication. You’re welcome to attend the surgery at any point and use the BP machine in our reception without an appointment during our opening hours. Alternatively, you can book an appointment with our HCA or nursing associate for a BP check. However, ideally national guidance suggests recording daily BP at home twice a day for 5-7 days for the most reliable readings. These can then be sent to the surgery for a GP or nurse to have a look at. If you wish to discuss this further, please contact the surgery. Octagon Medical Centre

reviews.author: Vee Matt
reviews.text: Worst possible GP Surgery. After months of being nervous and putting off my cervical screening, finally booked an appointment and went in today. First off, I was ignored by reception staff as they chatted and laughed while I stood there waiting. Eventually when I go in for my appointment with the Nurse Practitioner Nicola, she tells me that she thought I was someone else even though she clearly got my details from when I made the appointment. I know she only said that because I had come in for a cervical screening. She said she couldn't do screenings because (in her own words): "even though I'm a nurse, I am a nurse practitioner and I don't do those". She then walked out of the room, comes back a few mins later to tell me to go to reception and they will "deal with it". Reception staff were also rude and nonchalant with the woman smirking and rolling her eyes. She made it seem like it was my fault for booking an appointment with 'the great nurse practitioner' that was too good to perform cervical screenings. I was so frustrated with the way she was responding to me that I almost cried. At this point obviously other patients waiting in reception knew why I was there which was embarassing. I was so nervous prior to the test (as most women would be) and I had put it off for months. I finally got the courage to go today but was treated so badly. I said I will be making a complaint but she didn't care and told me to take a leaflet because I'm sure she knows that nothing would get done even if patients complain to the Practice Manager. I left there feeling so down and I want to change GPs as soon as possible now. This whole experience has really made me scared to get a cervical screening now even with another practice. I have now made a complaint with NHS England and will also be complaining to the Health Ombudsman as I believe this 'Practice' needs to be investigated. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Hi, We note this review is from 2019. The practice has gone through significant personnel and procedural changes with a fantastic new management, admin, nursing and clinician teams. Nicola has left the practice several years ago. reviews.author: Ludmila Tomasev
reviews.text: Review of GP Surgery – Dr. Kumari I am extremely disappointed with the level of care my family received from Dr. Kumari. My mother had an appointment due to severe stomach pain that had lasted for three days. She could barely walk, felt nauseous, and had intense cramping radiating to her back. During the appointment, Dr. Kumari only pressed on her stomach (which caused my mum to scream in pain) and then prescribed omeprazole — without carrying out any basic tests such as blood or urine checks. Shockingly, my mother was told she would have to wait six weeks for a scan. Later that same day, her condition worsened, and she had to be taken to hospital. She was diagnosed with acute cholecystitis, treated with IV antibiotics, and is now awaiting laparoscopic cholecystectomy. A simple urine test at the GP surgery would have shown signs of infection and helped avoid a potentially dangerous delay in treatment. The lack of proper examination and follow-up was incredibly irresponsible. In a separate case, the same doctor prescribed cream for my young nephew’s face, assuming he had psoriasis or dry skin. However, the issue turned out to be skin tags around his eyes, which clearly needed a different type of assessment and care. These experiences have left me deeply concerned about the quality of care and the lack of thoroughness shown during appointments. A more careful and investigative approach should be expected from any GP, especially when patients present with such serious symptoms. Practice response date: 6 months ago Practice response: Dear Ludmila, We apologise that the experience you have had with the practice has not been a positive one. The surgery endeavours to provide the best possible standard of care to all our patients and we will continue with regular monitoring and review to enable us to constantly improve the services we offer. Many thanks Practice Manager Bolton Medical Centre

reviews.author: Itsme Ayen
reviews.text: I went there this morning. But as usual they said they’re fully booked (I have been calling since two weeks ago when my illness actually started developing, at least 150 times every morning but never got any appointments) So I asked them to refer me to the pharmacy nearby. And the pharmacy referred me back to them as my temperature was high and I had chronic infection in my throat which clearly needed their attention. So I went to the GP straight from the pharmacy at 10.30 and my GP appointment was set at 11.30. I don’t have any voice now since Friday, and I was so tired of walking here and there just to see the doctor. At 11.20 I went to the reception only to be told to wait until they called my name. I couldn’t even speak because my voice is not coming out but I did come to the counter to ask for my appointment. It’s just to be sure because and I was feeling so fatigued and nauseous. Then I sat again at the waiting area until there’s no one left at 12. I quickly asked the receptionist when will I be attended? she checked the system and she said that I never showed up at 11.30 so the doctor has cancelled my appointment. She even told everyone there that I was late. The nerve she had to say that straight to my sick face was beyond me. She even asked me to go home. It was purely rude. I asked her to check the cctv and she said when I came at 10.30 I didn’t get to the counter for registration. It was true because I was way too early for my 11.30 appointment. So they kept blaming me and said I was late to everyone that’s there. I was so ashamed. I was shaking and crying myself out and asked them to check the cctv at 11.20 because I was positive that I did go to the receptionist to confirm my appointment but she only asked me to wait. But of course they won’t because they knew I was telling the truth. They kept arguing with me until I couldn’t take it anymore and I finally lost myself and my nose started bleeding so bad on the floor. This system is crazy. I really couldn’t understand how the Great Britain falls to this low level. I paid thousand pounds to NHS annually with my visa but not even once I get to use your services. And this time I am really ill I had no choice but to see the doctor physically. And this is how you treat your patients. You should be ashamed to be called a doctor when you refused to see your patients! Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Dear Itsme Many thanks for your feedback. We are sorry that your recent experience has not been a positive one. Please can you contact the surgery on 01204 463900 and ask to speak with the Assistant Practice Manager providing your full details so we can investigate this matter for you. Kind regards Practice Manager

reviews.text: I have been at this doctors for 39 years and I think they are great. Yes, sometimes the receptionists can be a bit abrupt, however this does not apply to them all. One month it was over 100 which was disgusting. It is this type of behaviour that take appointments from others who may need them. The doctors do not know when someone won't attend until on the day when it is too late. I think the doctors are fantastic. Dr Tran helped to looked after my terminally I'll mum. He treated her with respect, compassion and thoughtfulness at all times. Everyone is entitled to their opinion. reviews.author: Rachael Zarei
reviews.text: Absolutely appalling service and dismissive attitude. Avoid this practice if you value your time and dignity. I submitted a consultation request on 23 April and was told I’d hear back by 29 April. That deadline passed with no response, when I chased they told me I wasn’t to expect such a quick response. I was called 9 April and to tell me they had no appointments and they will call me by the end of the day. I was then called today to 16 MAY When I questioned the delay, the person on the phone said, “Do you want an appointment or not? ,” in a rushed and dismissive tone. When I asked for their name, they refused to give it. The lack of professionalism and accountability is staggering. I also spoke to Heidi today. While this interaction was fine, I have had very poor experiences with her in the past, as I see others have mentioned in their reviews as well. This isn’t just poor service, it shows a clear disregard for patient wellbeing. Delayed communication, broken promises, and an unhelpful, even hostile attitude toward perfectly reasonable concerns. People deserve better than this. I’ll be formally reporting the interaction and encourage others to do the same. Patients are not just numbers. We deserve respect and timely care. Please take a moment to consider the 5-star reviews on here. Many of them sound completely false and do not reflect the reality of this practice’s service. Practice response date: 9 months ago Practice response: Dear Rachael, I am really sorry to read that your recent experience with the Practice was not up to our usual high standard. I would be happy to discuss your feedback further so that I can address the issues you experienced. Please can you get in touch via email? sophie.whitehead3@nhs.net Kind Regards, Mrs Sophie Whitehead Practice Manager

We appreciate all feedback, as it helps us to improve our services. We were concerned to read about your negative experience with our receptionist, Heidi. Our reception team, including Heidi, are usually commended for their friendly and helpful approach, so your feedback is certainly unusual for us. For quality assurance and training purposes, we do record all incoming calls. We will be reviewing the recording of your interaction to better understand what occurred. We were unable to locate your contact details and would very much like to discuss your experience further to understand the situation fully and address any issues you may have encountered. Please could you contact me directly at sophie.whitehead3@nhs.net at your earliest convenience? I would be grateful for the opportunity to speak with you and work towards a resolution. Kind Regards, Mrs Sophie Whitehead Practice Manager

reviews.author: Grahame Harwood
reviews.text: Been trying to get get an appointment with my own doctor now for 8 weeks. Past to outside doctors who have been useless and one practice nurse(from another practice) who was the best of the bunch. Why do we keep having to ring back in the morning? Receptionist are polite but that's no help. It seems working people are disenfranchised from a decent service. And while this continues , my health deteriorates! Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Dear Mr Harwood, I am sorry to read that you are finding it difficult to see a GP at the Harwood/Tonge Moor site. I understand your frustration with the current situation and appreciate you taking the time to provide feedback. Due to funding changes within the NHS, we are encouraged to work collaboratively with other practices in our area. This collaboration is known as Turton PCN and comprises 6 practices, including Harwood/Tonge Moor. The funding is used to provide additional appointments to practices to deal with the increased demands on our services. You may have been offered an appointment in our PCN as these are usually available sooner than those available in practice and are appropriate for your ailment. I have tried to contact you this morning to discuss your concerns and organise an appointment if that is what you require. We value your health and well-being, and we want to ensure you receive the care you need. Thank you again for sharing your experience. Your feedback helps us improve our services. Kind Regards, Mrs Sophie Whitehead Practice Manager

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: UPDATE 2: The Practice Manager (Sophie Whitehead) took the time to speak to me and my partner in person. She addressed our concerns and has assured me that steps will be taken to minimise potential issues in future. After taking good & friendly treatment from a few members of staff into consideration, I've changed my rating from a 0/1 to a 4. UPDATE: The situation has gotten worse, I ended up on the phone for around 2 hours trying to get my appointment, was given an after hours appointment 12 days later. I had the appointment but because it was after hours, couldn't book in for bloods. So I was told to come in the next day in person to book in with daytime reception, which I tried to do (after waiting at least 20 mins in queue). I had to collect sample pots, book in for a blood test, a GP appointment for a referral and to hand in a urine sample I'd been given at my GP appointment the day before. The receptionist told me they "didn't have the authority to give (me) sample pots", they "couldn't accept (my) sample because there wasn't a form" and that they couldn't book any appointments for me. They said they couldn't see my notes, even though I'd watched the GP typing them up and she explained they would be available on all 6 practice systems (although I was in Harwood for the appointment anyway). The receptionist said I would have to speak to the Practice Manager, they would call me in the morning - I explained wouldn't be available in the morning and my phone blocks private numbers automatically so they said I needed to call in, I asked when and they said I could come in person, I tried to clarify whether she meant I had to phone in first or could just come in and she wouldn't give me a clear answer, just kept repeating that she couldn't do anything and I should call in and everything would be sorted tomorrow. So I went in today to talk to the Practice Manager as I'd been told I needed to do, but receptionists had no idea about any of the previous. I was in there at least 30 minutes (I was the only person waiting for around 10 minutes). The receptionists ended up printing off the forms and giving me sample pots with no issues and booked me in for the appointments I needed. Other than confusion over blood tests (because I already have a separate blood test related appointment) - the receptionists were able to do everything I had been told *couldn't* be done without talking to the Practice Manager. So once again I have had my treatment/appointments delayed because of a receptionist. I CAN NOT EMPHASISE ENOUGH, AVOID THE HARWOOD MEDICAL GROUP PRACTICES. Original Review: I don't know where to start. GPs who don't listen and deny urgent appointments and blood tests (until A&E step in) causing unnecessary and potentially harmful delays in treatment, last minute cancellations of appointments because they decide patients "aren't eligible" (with no evidence to back it up, for arbitrary reasons), gaslighting from GPs, gatekeeping by receptionists, online services which don't work, and now I've spent the last few days waiting to make an appointment (I was told to wait until today for appointments to be available) only to spend over an hour on the phone on hold (with multiple attempts where I couldn't even get through) only to go through a queue of 7 people, get to position 1 to be hung up on, then a queue of 8 people, position 2, hung up on, now I'm waiting again (currently over 23 minutes to get to position 6 from 8). Absolute nightmare. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Dear Amy, Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback on your recent visit to our Practice. I am really sorry to read that your experience was not a positive one. I have arranged for you to come in to the Practice to discuss this further and ensure that the points you have raised are addressed, fully. Kind Regards, Mrs Sophie Whitehead Assistant Practice Manager

reviews.author: Ren Ashi
reviews.text: Well what can I say, what a lovely caring practice this is!!!! I am from Merseyside but my grandmother Mary Anderson-W is a patient here who has been very poorly for months, in and out of hospital & at the moment residing in a nursing home temporarily to have rehabilitation. During her stay in hospital her hearing aid was lost & she has been struggling for months with no hearing due to the lost hearing aid! I telephoned this surgery desperate for any help/support for nan with this issue & was given a telephone appt with nans GP Dr Leach who telephoned me & listened to my queries etc about everything re: Nans hearing loss and other well being such as flu jab/covid booster etc! What a lovely doctor and what lovely admin/reception team you have here!!!! I felt really supported and that nan is cared about and to top all that Dr Leach acted immediately to process 'urgent referral' to the audiology department for an up to date hearing test/hearing aid for nan & the very next day I heard back from the admin team with all the details for me to arrange appointment for nan next week!!! She is thrilled & so am I & all the family at this result! Just had to write a warm review to express this! I couldn't be more grateful 🙏 honestly! My nan is '87 yrs old & it means the world to me to know she is in safe hands at this wonderful surgery especially as I live out of town!! Many Many Thanks To You All 🙏 😊🌈 God bless our NHS we are so so lucky!

So how much wiĺl that cost in comparison with the cost of pregabalin????!!!! She cannot get through to the surgery, she doesn't have a named GP, there is no continually of care. She receives mixed messages from the service providers. This to me is NOT a GOOD standard of care for the elderly. She has received a quality of care not fit for purpose for several years now! She is upset and extremely stressed regarding her care delivered to her from this this practice even the receptionists can be abrupt and quite rude (I have spoken to them myself!) I retired a few years ago due to ill health , MS, after having worked as a nurse since 1984! I was a very senior nurse retiring on a grade of 8b! I am appalled at the care delivered by this practice. reviews.text: Lottery appointment system, You need to call between 8am to 8:30am to win a appointment, but everyone else is also calling at the same time. If your call actually connects during this period, congratulations you have a ticket that gets you a 30% chance of an appointment ( providing they have not all been taken already) , if not try the lottery again the next day. You have 1/5 chance for an appointment if you follow my advice. I have a hack for those needing urgent doctor, use all the phones you can get access to and call them one after another, one will likely get through. Edit: It is possible now to go into the doctors before 8 am to obtain a golden ( yellow ) ticket, which helps you bypass the lottery phone system and be seen the same day. While the lottery system is not ideal, I can see its a way to deal with a already struggling health system and therefore I am rating this place higher for finding a way to deal with a failing system. reviews.author: Peter Mason
reviews.text: I have been with this practice for over 12 years, whilst it can be difficult sometimes to get an appointment, you can always turn up on the day and wait. As this is a first come first served system you will have to wait your turn. They operate a card system before they actually open so if you get there at say 07:30 and you're the first person there, pick the card marked 1 and when the practice opens at 09:00, book yourself in you will be seen first, simple! Get there after 09:00 go to the window they will book you in and you wait until your name appears on the wall message, again simple! If the waiting room looks full don't despair, many of those might be waiting for other services like nursing services, flue jabs, or child inoculations etc. If you are a registered patient and you need to speak to your GP but not necessarily see your GP you can ring, ask to speak to them and after a few questions from the staff they will decide if it might be better you attend in person if necessary or if not they will include you on a ring back from your own GP. When your GP either finds time between patients or at the end of the patients in the waiting room, you will receive a call back by your GP, again simple... I don't understand some of the complaints I have seen posted, Yes sometimes the staff could friendlier, but they too are human, with their own problems, and the person before you might have been one of those self centered winging buggers who turn up on the day hoping to jump in front of all those other patients who have appointments . Yes the list might be long, but that's because there are a lot of patients who are HAPPY with the services provided you DUMMY! So stop winging, get there early, pick a card, book yourself in, sit yourself down, and wait like everyone else!!!
