reviews.author: WAYNE LARGE
reviews.text: Possibly one of the most disappointing experiences I’ve ever had with senior doctors. After being told by district nurses and undertakers that I could collect a death certificate to register my parent’s passing, I arrived at the practice only to be informed that the procedure had changed. Neither the nurses nor the detailed NHS leaflet I was given reflected this change, leading to unnecessary confusion at an already difficult time. When I asked to speak to the manager, I was instead met by her secretary, who I initially assumed was the manager until informed otherwise. Despite requesting the manager again and asking for the new procedure in writing, I was then redirected to a junior doctor. They asked me to fill out a form I had already completed with the district nurse, which then had to be emailed. To make matters worse, I later received a call from a senior doctor accusing me of upsetting and being rude to staff—a claim that was both unfounded and deeply upsetting. This same doctor, during a previous home visit, did not even know my parent’s name. On the phone, her tone was condescending and defensive when I questioned her. Over recent months, during an incredibly emotional period, I have consistently found this practice to be unhelpful, lacking in empathy, and frequently contradictory in their communication. Sensitive matters were often discussed in the crowded reception area, which felt completely inappropriate and disrespectful. This experience added unnecessary stress during bereavement, and I sincerely hope the practice takes steps to improve their procedures and communication in the future.

reviews.author: sarah urmston
reviews.text: All of the staff at the Oaks Family practice are professional and friendly. We have been using the practice for over 10 years and have had nothing but first class care and service. They often go out of their way for patients always doing everything they can to ensure the you can the best care.

reviews.author: Abby Fox
reviews.text: A great GP practice. Remains a family friendly GP surgery, with staff that are considerate and always friendly, from reception, admin and practice manager, to the GPs, Nurses and other clinical staff. The only reason I don’t give it 5 stars is like with all NHS services right now there are elements it could improve on, I don’t think the majority of these are within the control of the practice but I do feel every one is committed to looking after patients. A recent visit and one of the newest GPs listened to everything I had to say, has read my notes before I arrived, and worked with me on a plan for my long term condition, working with the specialist care I am under from a local hospital too.

reviews.author: Jamie Welsby
reviews.text: Amazing experience when I recently visited the oaks. Very friendly staff and great service

reviews.author: Nicola Guffogg
reviews.text: At my recent visit I found reception staff to be really helpful .. gave me an appointment that was convenient .. GP was great.. Efficient great service ..

reviews.author: Kelly-Ann Hughes
reviews.text: Don’t need the GP often (luckily!) however I recently attended the practice for some travel immunisations. The admin staff were super friendly and helpful and had a flawless experience with the nurses. Thank you. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you Kelly-Ann for your kind words

reviews.author: Paul Lomax
reviews.text: Complete disgrace never answers the phone never get to talk to a doctor the receptionist think they know your problem and give you a date for a appointment according they are not doctors and should be got rid of and replaced with trained medical staff I had a bereavement and could not get to see a doctor just a terrible practice do not use and when I complained the receptionist put the phone down on me who do these jumped up receptionist think they are to treat people like this the nhs will be getting a report from me if dr w reads this I hope you follow up and either quit or tidy your practice with a good clean up

reviews.author: Paul Fellowes
reviews.text: It seems that my previous review has been deleted No bother As with all things there are some good and some bad points to note. Unfortunately the bad points are terrible the majority of reception staff are great however there are one or two who are so bad they border on hostile. Now the GPs some are great pleasant, engaging and helpful but by far the senior partners are rude, entitled and prone to telling none truths I have to be careful what I say because the last review I left ended with me receiving a letter with advise that I will be struck off, for leaving a poor review it also told me a pack of lies but did advise that I could discuss this with the author however when I enquiredabout this I was told that the author does not see patients??? How can you call yourself a GP then Just recently I had a telephone consultation where the GP asked if they could call me back this never happened and when I asked for a reply I was told another pack of lies that they had never said they would call me back. This should tell you all you need to know about this practice.

reviews.author: Yvonne Connolly
reviews.text: Best doctors surgery that I have ever used, practice staff, health care assistants and the doctors are always polite and helpful couldn’t ask for a better surgery. They all go above and beyond to help you. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Yvonne, on hard days reviews like this make our year. You are most welcome. Thank you so much for taking the time. Dr W.

reviews.author: calum vintage bus & coach & train service rice
reviews.text: Still same discrace of a doctor surgery tried to get appointment for Friday can't be done unless emergency looks like a report to health board again hopefully it get shut down bardoc best out of hours going and still not replying back to online consultation via.web page joke this GP surgery to the CCG looks like NO CHOICE Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Callum, we always prefer a patient to allow us to address any concerns first by letting us know what’s gone wrong. However, it is entirely your prerogative to raise your concerns with another health body if you wish to. All our staff are working extremely hard in extreme challenges and we have nothing to hide. Best wishes

reviews.author: julie lee
reviews.text: Good luck trying to book an appointment where you don’t have to take an afternoon off work!!!

reviews.author: Dave Moran
reviews.text: My young brother went with pains in tummy servell doctors told him ibf no botherd to check what it was it was cancer thank all for taking a uneccey life.why.did this happen please tell me lwill take this matter farther my brother told me can dicuss other pat this my young brother.plrase tell me wnhy

reviews.author: Lou Mac
reviews.text: Can not thank this surgery enough, they have been absolutely brilliant with me from doctors/nurses down to the receptionist who are always so lovely and kind over the phone when booking in for an appointment. I suffer from health anxiety, I’m made to feel reassured by everyone at this amazing practise so thank you.

reviews.author: David Rostron
reviews.text: Choose the times you phone and you normally have to wait five minutes, try ringing BT or your Bank, now that is a journey. Always found the staff courteous and supportive on the phone or face to face. Many thanks. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to comment. Your understanding means a lot to us.

reviews.author: M O
reviews.text: Doctors aren’t helpful at all from what I’ve experienced. Not supportive whether it’s for mental or physical health. A certain receptionist also has attitude on the phone every time. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: We are very sorry to hear you have had a bad experience. Please contact us with info so we can address this and improve.

reviews.author: Hazel-Lea Peyton
reviews.text: Hazel we are truly sorry you feel this way. Please let us know how we can improve. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hazel we are truly sorry you feel this way. Please let us know how we can improve.

reviews.author: Emma Payne
reviews.text: Appointments promised on the phone, turn up at the time and date given and no appointment is in place. Once is an accident but this is reoccurring, it surly can’t only be happening to me. Shambles!

reviews.author: S Barlow
reviews.text: Awful service not sure how you see a GP I am presuming that is why A&E are full. Been ill 3 weeks hoping to ride it out but just getting worse. All they could offer is a nurse to call me and diagnose a chest infection over the phone. I would prefer to be examined and an accurate diagnosis but that is not an option anymore Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Sorry to hear you have been unwell. Most of our appointments are face to face but if an emergency we may ask that the duty dr call you first then establish how quickly we need to see you that day and ensure everyone gets seen when they need to be. This is a very common method to keep people safe and manage our excess demand. We will always ask to see you once we have established this if you need to be examined. We haven’t had any nurses working at the practice that do telephone calls like this since April 2023 so unable to comment on this but please let us know if you’d like us to look into it for you. We hope you are feeling better.

reviews.author: Emma Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: Ringing through to try and get a doctors appointment is now an extreme sport. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Emma we agree it is a nightmare: Our phone literally never stops ringing; it is incredibly hard work for our staff with over 7000 patients and demand higher than ever. We hope you managed to get through.

reviews.author: Adam Fitzpatrick
reviews.text: It’s really bad when ringing the doctors is is like ringing a call centre. You listen to a mantra of “your call is important to us, please stay on the line and your call will be answered in the order it was received” only to wait 10/15 minutes and then when you eventually do get through, you’re then placed on hold for another 10/15 minutes.

reviews.author: vivienne boardman
reviews.text: We moved to this practice a few months ago after our old Drs was really going downhill after merging with about four other practices. we are in or mid to late 70's, with a few ongoing problems, me with diabetes, which luckily doesnt give me any problems, but the osteo arthritis is a different story! that can stop me in my tracks when it gets bad, but my other half, he has dementia, COPD. and also bad pain in his leg as he had a plate put in years ago,, anyway when all the problems with covid started we lost most of the regular Drs, and the dr who we used to see retired, and trying to get an appointment even on the telephone was a non starter, and i was worried that if "him indoors" had a bad breathing attack i wouldnt be able to get in touch with anyone, so i decided to ask around like many other people from there and find another Drs who we could trust.. Luckily a few of my friends told me about "the Oaks" and thank god they did. this Drs has done more for us in the few months we've been here than our old Drs did in a few years,, and everybody has been so nice from the Drs, nurses, and the receptionists... because as you get older you just need the reassurance of knowing there is someone who will be there for you, even if its only for advice on the end of a phone, I know there are times when you have to call back because they are busy, but this happens everywhere, because its obvious other people need a Dr as well.. so I want to say THANKYOU, your very much appreciated Mrs V Boardman Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Thank you Vivienne much appreciated

reviews.author: Wasim P
reviews.text: Cannot fault my experience here today. Called in and was handled fantastically by the reception staff, spoke to a GP and the experience was so good. A hard job, can’t please everybody, as is life, can only speak for myself but would highly recommend this practice to others! Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Thank you Wasim much appreciated

reviews.author: Damian smith
reviews.text: Can’t fault the service, never had a problem getting an appointment, even though during these tough times sometimes it’s online for assessment, but if the doctor needs you to go in then they make the arrangements. I have to say I’ve moved around the country a lot and by far the best surgery I’ve been to. I think the fact they are also a training Surgery helps as the new doctors are keen to learn and speak to you on a level you can understand

reviews.author: Mark Lever
reviews.text: i have been trying to speak to someone for over two weeks, whenever i phone im told all phone lines are busy and to try the online consultation, when i try online and put in my symptons im then told i need to speak to someone at the practice!

reviews.author: Shahbaz
reviews.text: The receptionist I spoke to was rude and unhelpful, which made the situation more stressful while I was already feeling unwell. I hope the practice can improve the communication and attitude of the reception staff, as this would make the service much better for patients Every receptionist and call handler should be properly trained on how to treat people

reviews.author: Karen Haywood
reviews.text: Thankyou you all Dr's and colleague for everything you have done for my family and myself I've had a few bad times over the last few year's and you are always there to help I feel very lucky to have you as my Dr's and colleague to secretary's nothing is to much for our practice outstanding care given i feel I would be lost with them with all my care I have I've been here for over over 40 years and would never think of changing outstanding practice xxx

reviews.author: Aimee roberts
reviews.text: I can honestly say what a good practice. Especially a certain receptionist who's name I have forgotten I did ask for her name today because I new I was going to write a review and would of liked to add her name in here, although I am useless at names! However such a good Doctors and a brilliant service each and every time we have phoned in the last two weeks. My dad has been a patient here for many years, had some extremely bad news and a horrible turn in health very quick and recent, Doctor Rizwan and reception have been amazing even hiccups on our end with prescriptions the staff have been amazing to sort and help. Thank you so much for making this difficult time, that bit easier when we phone. Thank you. (Patient N.S so who ever helped with prescription today you are always helpful and polite)

reviews.author: Sophie Heath
reviews.text: Everyone always complains about GP receptionists, I've been at this practice nearly 7 years and the receptionist's are all absolutely lovely. Most know me by my voice, they're always super friendly and helpful. Dr Rizwan and Dr Gillbanks are absolutely brilliant. I have chronic health conditions and several times they've called me the day after an appointment to follow up (not requested by me) - patient care and support is brilliant. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Lee Diggle
reviews.text: Been registered here since birth, however, I'm changing my doctors now. The last few appointments have been nothing short of a joke. Been laughed at and refused prescriptions, even though I pay for them.

reviews.author: Gail Sumner
reviews.text: Always there for me and family when needed and I have needed a lot of support over the past year.

reviews.author: Amelia Lennard
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful service, changed GPs after feeling unheard have had every issue listened to and successfully diagnosed staff that not only listen but care. Keep up the good work !!!

reviews.author: Lui
reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful receptionists, have always had a lovely experience and they always go above and beyond for me , thank you guys so much x

reviews.author: Thomas Brown
reviews.text: A great doctors surgery with all the same pressures every surgery has. Despite this I have always been able to get an appointment when I needed one. The best part are the doctors which work here. I have always had a good experience with them and felt listened to and helped. There is a small free on-site car park but if that is full there is plenty of free on street parking on the nearby roads. The surgery is wheelchair accessible via the ramp provided.

reviews.author: Louise McCarthy
reviews.text: Had an out of hours appointment here. Something came up in the morning meaning i had to cancel the appointment, i have been ringing the ooh number since 8:30am but nobody is answering. I even spoke to bardoc but they could not cancel the appointment. Real shame as somebody else could of had it.

reviews.author: Anne Marie
reviews.text: I turned up at the GP surgery today without an appointment in desperation as I needed a course of antibiotics. It was later in the afternoon, and whilst I couldn’t get an appointment, Sue the receptionist was very understanding, compassionate and helpful by doing a referral to the chemist where I was given a prescription. The system between the surgery and the chemist works really well if your prescription doesn’t require a GP appointment. A very positive experience for which I am grateful.

reviews.author: David Benn
reviews.text: Six weeks wait for a severe diarrhea infection!!!

reviews.author: Jessica Liptrott
reviews.text: Worst doctors in Bolton !

reviews.author: David Taylor
reviews.text: *STAY AWAY* Absolutely useless GP Surgery. Receptionist seem to think they can diagnose your problems over the phone and they deem if you are able to see the actual doctor or not. This practice has let me down on many occasions, even after I left! On numerous occasions over the last few months they have informed me my prescription had been sent and it had either not in fact been sent or had been sent to the wrong place. I recently moved from Bolton to Bury and I was already being seen by this practice for a knee problem, I was constantly "told off" by the receptionist that I need to move to a new GP as I have moved address and they won't continue to send my prescriptions to Bury. I emailed the practice to order my repeat prescription before I decided to make an application to a join a new GP. I did this via email, I was emailed to confirm my medication had been sent. After going on public transport to collect my medication ( whilst struggling to walk) I arrive and to be told that nothing has been sent. I contacted the GP to see why this has not been sent and was met with a receptionist who insisted I am not a patient anymore as of Wednesday last week. I informed her I ordered this prior to moving to my new GP and was informed that this had been sent and I have the email as proof. She said leave it with her and if I don't hear anything back by 5pm to ring her back. I stressed that I needed my medication as I have ran out and I have come all the way to collect my prescription now. her response was nothing she can do. As I heard nothing back I had to call them back again I was met by a different woman on reception who was very rude to me. She said yes we have done it but you will have to come to Bolton to pick it up. This would take me hours on public transport and it was 5.30pm, I asked why could my prescription not be sent electronically or sent to my new GP which is 10min down the road from me as I need my medication today. The woman talked over me, wouldn't let me finish and said your prescription is here if you want it or contact you new GP and get them to assess you and go from there. I was shocked at how poorly this has been dealt with, I stressed at 12 o'clock that I have ran out of my medication and I need it. The GP hadn't even bothered to ring me back. Now I am awaiting for a manager to ring me back, which wont happen. I have spoken to my new GP and they haven't been informed that I am taking medication and would require me to see the doctor which is the earliest appointment is seven working days!

reviews.author: Frank Guffogg
reviews.text: Now its 2 month for an appointment!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! That was 4 month ago, so I changed doctors. Today I needed to see a doctor and spoke to a very nice polite receptionist who asked what day and time would be suitable for the appointment. I could not believe my ears having never had that type of polite service at Mandalay!!!!! I took the 1445 appointment that day The move away was in every way was correct

reviews.author: Barbara McDonald
reviews.text: I contacted the practice as there was a problem with my prescription at the pharmacy end. As a result of this, I had to go back to the practice for a review and another prescription issued. Sue went above and beyond to get me an appointment the day after, finally ringing me on the same day as there had been a cancellation. Extremely efficient and always smiling. Great GP's, Nurse practitioners, Phlebotomists and Reception staff. Thanks for all your hard work in such trying times.

reviews.author: Gill Houghton
reviews.text: I want to say that sue who is one of the receptionists has gone out of her way on 2 occasions to help me. She is very efficient and deserves to be recognised.

reviews.author: jackie
reviews.text: I was seen by Shirley. What an absolute credit to the practice. Very thorough professional and friendly. Also the receptionist Rebeka went out of her way to help me. Great service.

reviews.author: leshek lebiecki
reviews.text: leshek lebiecki43 photosa year ago

reviews.author: Teresa Tinker
reviews.text: I was very impressed with the Doctor I saw yesterday at Mandalay. He was thorough, professional , didn’t rush me and was extremely helpful. Couldn’t have asked for a better service, thank you.

reviews.author: Mark Eglin
reviews.text: Unbelievably bad booking system, told weeks before I could get an appointment, but if I wanted to see if there is anything sooner ring after 18:30 for out of hours appointment. That number refers you to only Booked appointments and says to ring the surgery for an out of hours appointment.!!! Round and round in circles. No Coeliac care after 15 years, have to push for recommended annual tests past a barrage of clinical ignorance to the disease. Used to be a great surgery and must have cuts or over subscription now. Very disappointed and stressed. The respect so much lauded by the automated start to a call goes two ways and is NOT shown in return.

reviews.author: Julie Robinson
reviews.text: Really hard to see a doctor

reviews.author: Pam Illing
reviews.text: I have to say that I was treated with the most respect from the receptionist to Jenny who I had a appointment with. They made me feel very welcome and at ease. I know there have been problem's since covid. But I was very happy with my treatment.

reviews.author: Stuart Webb
reviews.text: Very good doctors

reviews.author: Andrew George
reviews.text: Always busy, always helpful

reviews.author: Ilyas Ibrahim
reviews.text: Extremely rude and unhelpful reception staff with zero sympathy for patients. The pre-recorded voice when you call asks callers to speak politely and with respect or the call will be terminated. The receptionists should be held to the same standard.

reviews.author: Hayley Ingham
reviews.text: Reception staff so rude and unhelpful!!!!

reviews.author: Ahmad Patel
reviews.text: Recently moved to this gp as moved to area and I have had nothing but negative encounters. The receptionists don’t seem to answer the phone but when they eventually do they are extremely rude. Went in for my daughters immunisations and 2 receptionists were gossiping about another colleague loudly so everybody in the reception area could hear and then when I tried to get their attention to book ourselves in it was like I was an inconvenience as I interrupted their gossip. So unprofessional. I think they need some new staff or to put their staff on some training about how to deal with the public.

reviews.author: Kathryn Louise
reviews.text: Receptionist not answering phone and when do hang up, disgusting behaviour from healthcare professionals. Patients are always supposed to come first or so I was taught when in a similar job role. Please provide more staff if current staff are struggling with work load, this will not only help your staff but build better relations with your patients and from what I have seen you need it.

reviews.author: Bilal Khalid
reviews.text: Called to make a appointment, receptionist refused to access Pt records or take symptoms. Was told can not book appointment , have to call back 8 in the morning to be triaged. Did explain this is difficult given have to drop kids off to school and have work commitments and asked to book a appointment while on the phone. Receptionist told this is how they work and I have no other option. Been calling since 8 this morning and for two hours can not get through. The lack of Pt care is very concerning. The practice has no practice manager and when you try to speak to some one in charge , it is very difficult to establish who that is?

reviews.author: Becky Ryan
reviews.text: Bad experience before I even started. Just moved to the area and tried calling on 5 occasions at different times of day - phone rung out but sounded odd as if it wasn't a valid number. Sent through registration forms electronically and after a week still hadn't heard anything... Needless to say, have registered at another surgery instead

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: Rude receptionists, referral delayed with no reason given, multiple issues building up to make this a practice worth avoiding. Edit UPDATE: Was rudely told by a receptionist "I don't want to talk to you" when I was told to call them via text then told that my appointment had been cancelled, to which I obviously expressed shock (wasn't rude, wasn't abusive, just genuinely shocked and confused about the cancellation of an appointment I'd waited 5-6 months for). I was then put on hold before I could say anything, after which I was put on the phone with someone who gave a bunch of excuses, told me to complain to the Commissioner of the NHS, and left it at that. I tried raising formal complaints with both the surgery and the PHSO but both have decided to blame the other and both are saying they won't do anything. The receptionists at this practice aren't worth their pay and patients deserve better.

reviews.author: M J
reviews.text: Some very good Doctors at this practice, however the practice is let down by its unqualified & unprofessional receptionists. One of the receptionists hung up the phone when I was trying to explain to them I missed their call as I was in the bathroom and I could no longer get an appointment as I missed the call! Went to the surgery to confront them they then said sorry we have an issue with the phone line and was issued an appointment straightaway! As stated, the doctors are incredible here, but the receptionists are shockingly bad and have no duty of care towards patients.

reviews.author: Roy Hibbert
reviews.text: This practice has descended into an unacceptable level of lethargy. Phone calls not answered, appointment times not met and staff that are quite obviously only there for the pay. Rude, short tempered, unethical in how they speak loudly about patients concerns etc. The practice needs to switch off and log back on to a realistic level of customer service. If everyone needs to be sacked and start over, then deal with it. Sorry for the one or two possible exceptions to this, but there needs to be a major and significant improvement immediately.

reviews.author: Christina
reviews.text: I'm done with this surgery 😒 Few months back I was waiting for a telephone consultation, which I had to wait weeks for. Waited all day but nobody rang. I called the surgery the following day, just to be told it was a face to face appointment, which "I didn't attend". It definitely wasn't a face to face as I would have been in work but instead of getting an apology, the receptionist made me out to be a liar or I may be confused. I write all my appointments down at time of booking! That was the first time. Second time, only yesterday, I rang to double check on an upcoming face to face appointment, only to be told there isn't one booked in. I spoke to my GP on the 13th of July and she herself booked me in for the end of August. Again, the 'lovely' (sarcasm) receptionist made me out to be confused, saying "I didn't attend" as it was booked for July and "we're now in August, not July" (no s*** Sherlock) I have prove it was booked for the end of August. The GP I see only works twice a week, so getting an appointment takes a few weeks. This surgery has seriously gone downhill since COVID and the receptionist are worse than ever. Rude beyond belief and obviously incapable of doing their job. I've cancelled all my appointments now as I won't be going back. No wonder people don't go and see their GP if this is the kind of service, or lack of, they receive. .....and yes, I did put in a formal complaint 😒😉

reviews.author: Elissa murphy
reviews.text: Waited over 45 minutes with a 7 month old, to be told the person my daughter was meant to be seeing is currently in a meeting. If that's the case, you should either ring me prior to my appointment and change the time or just let me know on arrival.

reviews.author: One with nature “Love you mother xx”
reviews.text: Fantastic drs best around receptionist are very helpful indeed

reviews.author: System Fitness
reviews.text: Totally agree with previous comments and experience with Mandalays Receptionists. I rang to make an appointment 07/02/2022 (ringing for 20mins as usual) only to be answered by an arrogant, unhelpful, unprofessional receptionist. I was immediately informed that the earliest appointment that I could have, would be on the 21st Feb 22????? I informed her that unfortunately I didn't know if I would be ill on the 21, but I DO KNOW THAT I AM ILL TODAY! WHO RINGS TO SEE A DOCTOR 3 WEEKS BEFORE THEY ARE ILL? After my refusal of this ridiculous situation and my repeated request to see a doctor (as a patient that the surgery gets a funding from the NHS for) I was told that I had to ring back AGAIN after 11am to see if she could fit me in. I informed her that I would just turn up as I was appalled with her repeated terrible behaviour. After this incident I decided to change doctors, so I went to another surgery and was greeted by a helpful, professional receptionist that informed me that they NEVER REFUSE OR turn away a patient. EVER..!! NEVER HAVE I FELT LIKE POSTING A NEGATIVE RESPONSE TO MANDALAYS RECEPTIONISTS THEN I DO NOW! REMEMBER NOBODY IS INDISPENSABLE!

reviews.author: Jonathan Kelly
reviews.text: A shockingly awful example of smug, ignorant and self righteous receptionist who have no time or patience for the patients that rely on them to be understanding, professional, knowledgeable or helpful - all things they spectacularly manage to fail at for the smallest and most simple of tasks. They are rude, disrespectful and more than happy to simply hang up on you if the fancy takes them, and stonewall any attempts to find out who they are held responsible by. The doctors fail to deliver on promises and requests consistently, appointments regularly run over 15 minutes late, if you can even get them at all. They're booked over three weeks in advance and their ancient phone system is always "line busy" - good luck managing to talk to one of these ignorant receptionist, and good luck if you actually manage to.

reviews.author: Laura's El Passo
reviews.text: Doctors have always been helpful and reassuring. Today had another experience of unbelievably rude and unhelpful reception staff. I only popped in to pick something up yet I felt like I was wasting their time and they couldn't be bothered to help at all and just fobbed me off.

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: Only recently registered with them, first experience with the doctor (Dr. Ashraf) was positive but consequent visits have been pretty negative. A follow up appointment was running 10 minutes behind (I'd turned up at least 10 minutes early, for a 9am appointment and the waiting room had been empty). My "ten minute" appointment was about 4 minutes long and I was rushed out the room before I even got to discuss my symptoms, which I'm now very worried about. Instead of getting to discuss them in my appointment I've been made to feel like I'm not worth treating and I'm wasting their time, but looking on the NHS website (among multiple others) has suggested my symptoms are actually quite serious, I'm just too nervous to go to A&E because they're for "emergencies" like people who need stitches, etc. So I don't feel right taking up their time, especially after being rushed through my doctor's appointment like my symptoms don't matter. The receptionists here are very hit or miss (miss = rude and useless!) I had to phone to ask for the doctor to request images from my ultrasound scan (I couldn't request them from the company directly) and the receptionist acted like I was asking for them to do a handstand and sing the alphabet backwards. I called again a few weeks later to find out there wasn't even a note of it on the system. I also had to basically shout personal information over to a receptionist (in front of people in the waiting room) who kept interrupting me before I could properly get a word out because she "couldn't hear me, WHAT do (I) want?" (Bobbed brown hair, older middle aged woman). I have now just got off the phone asking a simple, non-medical question because I didn't want to waste the doctor's time (especially since doctors are being overworked and I was rushed out last time in under half my alloted appointment time). Her attitude was disgusting, she spoke down to me like I'm some sort of idiot and you could hear in her tone she thinks she's better than other people (she even did one of those "taken aback" sort of "throat tutts" if that makes sense). I have to book an appointment tomorrow to try and discuss my more worrying symptoms with a doctor (if I win the phone lotto, otherwise I'll be going to A&E) but now I have to add on another issue to discuss, which could have been done without my needing to have an appointment if the receptionist hadn't been such a stuck up her own a--e tw-t. I think she said she was called Pat or Pam.

reviews.author: I “User121960” M
reviews.text: Doctors are 5*. Receptionists are 1*. Rude office staff need to learn manners.

reviews.author: Marc Ward
reviews.text: Always spot on and very helpful 😊 …

reviews.author: Nadejda Hamurari
reviews.text: Very good doctors 5*, but.....the reception staff are rude, talking behind your back when you take a seat and unhelpful. They make you feel unwelcome and like your presence is a nuisance. Grow up, we're adults. Show some professionalism.........

reviews.author: Jan Rhodes
reviews.text: Jan RhodesLocal Guide · 636 reviews · 6,323 photos4 years ago

reviews.author: Jess “Jess” Cara
reviews.text: Been trying to ring for the past few days and the number isn’t even ringing?

reviews.text: I deal with crippling anxiety and depression. Even then after having a review for my meds, they won't log this on their system and will continue to deny me my meds saying that I haven't had a review eventhough I have. What kind of people would deny someone who when unmedicated, has bouts of self harm and suicidal thoughts?? Very poorly run pharmacy and the doctors are never available either. My doctor is supposedly Dr Green, who i haven't seen now for about 3 or 4 years? My family has also had similar experiences with Burnside.

reviews.author: Professor J.
reviews.text: I attended for an emergency appointment that the practice themselves scheduled, despite me explaining that traffic at that time is extremely heavy. I accepted because it was the only option given. On arrival, I was spoken to by the receptionist in a sarcastic, rude, and dismissive manner. When I explained that this was an emergency and asked to be seen, I was told I was not allowed to wait, despite the practice’s own policy stating that late patients may wait for the doctor’s discretion, not the receptionist’s. Most concerning was a racist and discriminatory comment made by the receptionist during the discussion: “You can’t argue with us because you’re not in Pakistan now.” This was shocking and completely unacceptable in a healthcare setting. I was also told there was only one doctor working and that they were “busy,” yet shortly afterwards, a doctor came out to call the only other patient, with no one having left the doctor’s room beforehand. This contradicted what I had been told. Patients deserve respect, honesty, and basic professionalism. That receptionist failed at all counts.

reviews.text: My review of this GP Practice is long overdue. I have been a patient for almost 40 years, much of that time being under the leadership of Doctor Green and Dr Muhsin. In this current climate when people are often unable to see a doctor, I find that this is not the case at Burnside. I have had no problems obtaining telephone consultations and, when appropriate to my circumstances, a follow up face to face appointment at the surgery has been provided promptly. The senior doctors are both very experienced and genuinely interested in the wellbeing of their patients. The reception staff, nurses, doctors on placement and other health professionals are welcoming, knowledgeable and supportive. There is a warmth and understanding at Burnside that means a lot to people, especially when they are anxious about a diagnosis or injury. I am both lucky and proud to be a patient at this practice. Margaret Parrish April 2024

reviews.text: I transferred myself from the Egerton and Dunscar Health Centre to the Burnside Surgery some 3 months ago. The first thing that I want to highlight is that wonderfully there is no background music whilst waiting to see the doctor or nurse and this for me is a big plus. It was my perception at the Egerton and Dunscar Health Centre that events leading up to my heart attack some 5 years ago included stress whilst waiting to consult the doctor.I actually felt worse having seen the doctor than when I walked in at the front door. This is no longer a problem at Burnside and I am grateful. Dr Gillooly is my local practitioner and is very patient. He makes me feel confident in his advices and takes great interest in any problems I have. He is great! Lastly I just love the TV screen where you can alert the practice of my arrival simply by typing in my surname and date of birth etc. So easy.

Secondly rang again they gave him a steroid cream and the third time they gave my son a cream that was for a cyst I went hospital to dermatologist with my son and he CLEARLY said it was an ingrown hair my son has had this since 4 months old now he is nearly 2 and this doctors haven’t helped him once Secondly about 2 weeks ago I have had a very bad rash on my face I was swelling up my face was burning up like it had been burnt I rang for an appointment for 5 days straight every morning just before 8 and they WOULD NOT GIVE ME AN APPOINTMENT on the 6th day I ended up in hospital as my tongue started swelling up and I was choking on my tongue of course the woman from reception she’s very very rude and is honestly by far the worst woman I have ever spoke to she said to me send a picture to us because it might be ringworm I said it is definatly not and she said just send us a picture this was on 3rd day as so I did after arguing on the phone because I said I’ll send a picture and get medication for something else like what happened to my SON! reviews.author: Dilhari Kirindeniya
reviews.text: The most worst and rude doctors in Bolton. My son was very ill and had high temperature for 2 days and he was having endless cold for a month. I asked an appointment on the same day rang reception several times and all they said was that they will get back to me after checking with doctor but no one rang me back. Following day I had to call in the morning to get an emergency appointment which was given 5.20pm. Went there on time but about more than 30 minutes late Doctor Anjaana came from out and called us. She was complaining that she had an appointment on the day before for my son which we were not informed to us. She was communicating with us very rudely just looking at my son's face she said I am not giving antibiotics at all even before checking any symptoms because he had given antibiotics a month before as well. She just wanted to ignore it purposely. My son had ear pain for 2 days and she did not check until I asked to. After I asked she only checked one ear and said it was little red but she is not giving antibiotics at all. She was also blaming us about ringing the surgery and asking an emergency appointment. You shouldn't ring the surgery and ask for an emergency appointment even when the child having temperature for couples of days! That was her response in her words. She was treated and communicated with us very badly today and I am really disappointed and worry about my son's situation. This was not the first time that doctor Anjaana has behaved like this. She clearly need to know how to talk and treat people. I would not recommend this Medical Centre for anyone at all. I will be making an complaint to the relevant authorities regarding this incident.

reviews.text: If I could nothing I would, absolutely terrible service overall. Previously in the waiting area an old man asked for water and he was advised to go buy it, so I went next door to get him a bottle of water, I’m not expecting them to buy everyone a bottle, but on the odd occasion surely the least you can do is go to the kitchen or something and get a glass of water. reviews.author: Moo Roo
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. An appalling practice that puts profit over patient experience. I’ve been registered with this practice for around 15 years or more and hate having to go in for anything, primarily due to certain receptionist staff… curt and off putting to put it lightly.. I try not to use this practice as I find the human interaction there highly emotionally disturbing, yes I may be over sensitive to people’s attitudes I accept that but I only pick up on what people give out, not what I imagine, and so the animosity I feel from certain members of staff led me to take up private heath care some time ago. It’s unfortunate I had to make contact with them over a matter recently that just upheld the issues I have with them. The malignancy that I find pervades certain members staff is highly unpleasant and unwelcoming. Luckily Bupa now have a GP service so I use them, but a recent issue required I needed a form signing by the GP at this practice.. Firstly the older receptionist told me curtly that it would be a 4 week wait for the signature, was told these waits times were displayed on the entrance door.. they were not, and still are not at the time of writing this. It took over 4 weeks to ring me to tell me they had eventually been signed and was told it was £104!!!! I questioned this cost a few times over the next few weeks while I was trying to save for the money, I needed to see a consultant, I asked several times for a breakdown, wasn’t given it, was treated with contempt for asking on several occasions.. a £104!!!!!! In my eyes I’m saving this practice the money that they get for having my name on their register by using Bupa, you’d think they’d be more helpful that I was trying to save time for more needy patients. That said I had a medical need and my needs weren’t met by these people and I was treated with contempt by unqualified receptionists and ultimately by the practice manager. When I was able to save up enough to go and get the form I needed signing I was told they had destroyed it on my say so during a phone call, I had not, I had told them it was unaffordable, that they were creating a block to my healthcare in such a cost but I never said to destroy it or why would I go in to pay… Absolutely untrue and a vicious attempt to cover up their personal petulance in relation to myself. I am on the spectrum and dyslexic and so are other people who visit their business, for that’s what it is.. a business. I’ve tried to report them to the relevant trusts for this cost but they appear to be unaccountable to Bolton NHS trust and their appears no real avenue for complaint. Charlatans, they’ll reel you in for all the checks they like because they get paid per diagnosis of say things like blood pressure medication… but the community service and true medical care has given way to a corporate identity.. So be warned of unpublished costs and be warned that Heaton Medical Centre may make you feel sick.. it did me!

reviews.author: Stuart Briely

reviews.author: Lee Yates
reviews.text: I've been frustrated with the difficulty in securing appointments that are long enough to address my concerns properly. It’s also been disappointing to see reviews being booked only to be canceled at the last minute, then rescheduled with long wait times. I shared my feedback with the receptionist — who, to be fair, was one of the better staff members — but I felt it was just lip service. I let her know I was considering switching doctors, and she seemed pleased. As a regular working-class individual, I just want honest, reliable care without having to rely on the doctors unless absolutely necessary. I hope my feedback helps improve the situation. Paperwork completed and dropped off to move practice!

reviews.author: Rachel Hunter
reviews.text: I came here today for my over 40’s health check & was seen by a lovely lady called Janice Kerr. She was so full of knowledge & fantastic advice and acknowledged everything I was saying about my current situation. Janice was so easy to speak too & she has opened my eyes as to how everything works in conjunction with each other in the body & I've learned so much today about health & how to improve things. She took the time to listen. Janice would make a fantastic counsellor. Thanks again Janice I have already started to process everything you have said & will put it into practice. I have made notes so I don't forget what you said. What a fabulous addition to the NHS these people are especially when Dr’s don't have the time due to busy schedules. Thank you!

reviews.author: Tracy Williams
reviews.text: I have been with this practice for almost eighteen years. My personal treatment has always been great as has that of my family members. Receptionists are always really helpful and I have had great treatment from all of the doctors I have encountered over the years. Times have absolutely changed with the pandemic - that is true- but the booking system is easy to use- your call is triaged and you are contacted back as promised. . I have never not been seen or had help when I have needed it . Five stars from me.

reviews.author: Jimothy Z
reviews.text: Helpful & friendly staff - over phone, at reception, at appointments.

reviews.author: Sarah Almond
reviews.text: I've been with this practice for years and always had great care. I've been prompted to review today by the recent changes to the appointment booking system. Gone is ringing up at 8am. You now fill in the econsult form either on the NHS app or surgery website and your information is then reviewed by a Dr and an appointment made if necessary. I've had to use this system twice in the last month and both times I have been contacted in under 3 hours of submitting the request, with same day appointments available. I really can't ask for any more than this from my GP. The staff have always been brilliant here as well, but the change to the appointment system has really made a huge difference to me and made the GP service so much more accessible (and less awkward than having to explain all your symptoms over the phone!) EDIT: Just seen that someone else has reviewed the same system with a very different viewpoint! They might want to wait an hour or so and maybe they'll be surprised with a same day appointment... They definitely do exist!

reviews.author: Jay Shepherd
reviews.text: We joined this surgery during COVID, I assumed the poor service was to do with the pandemic, however it simply just hasn't got any better. Every time my wife goes to pick up her repeat prescription, it's NEVER ready. So she's started ringing in advance to check that it's going to be ready on the daythey say it is, that's also made no difference... Each time this happens, the chemist next door and the medical centre just blame each other. Hilarious. Last time I checked the 'My GP' app, there are no appointments made available by the surgery to book online. Ringing up at 8am for a same day appointment really just isn't good enough a system, me and our children all need to be 'where we need to be' by 8am, we can't simply wait at home in case we get lucky and get an appointment, which could be any time that day. Or worse, not get an appointment and us all be late for school and work for no reason, potentially doing this every day until we get lucky. It really is quite disruptive from a school / work point of view. If it's all due to staff shotages and people doing 'no-shows' for appointments, I don't know what the solution is. But that's not my problem, I already have a job, that's their responsibility to sort out. Which they have not, during the 4 years I've been here.

reviews.author: avtar ubbi
reviews.text: I have always found the practice staff to be helpful and responsive. I tend to use on line consultations so as to leave face to face appointments for those that really need them. In doing so my queries and requests are answered within 2 days. I don't need to go into the practice for my repeats and I can do most things on the app. My advice to other patients is to use the app if you can it will save you a lot of time. The clinical staff have always been responsive to my healthcare needs.

reviews.author: Anan Hassan
reviews.text: I have a disability and was throwing up all morning so arrived late 9 minutes to appointment, I say good morning, the receptionist ‘Libby’ completely ignored me and continued her conversation with a colleague didn’t even look my way, then after her little chat was done she tells me Ive gone over my 10 minutes even though if shed have seen to me earlier I would have been within the timings. Rude receptionist acting like she owns the clinic, dealing with mentally ill people like that a GP, the irony.

reviews.author: Craig Ronson
reviews.text: Truly awful experience, just beyond astounded at how bad these places are becoming and a real concern for society in general. I have received no contact in over 3 months from an apparent “referral” which I was informed would be no later than 2 months. I decided to try to utilise the private health care I also pay for, knowing that my NHS is falling short of what it should provide. Funny thing is, I can’t even do this as my GP can’t even be bothered to sign a form to enable me to utilise care. After chasing this up for 3 months I have repeatedly been told to my shock that, “this is not essential NHS work, signing a form isn’t medical care so isn’t an urgent task”. What’s funny is, this isn’t just “signing a form” this is purely for medical care that I AM NOT RECEIVING. What’s also funny is, if your services are so stretched, why don’t you let me utilise my private medical care so that you have one less patient to deal with! There is absolutely no way that any private company would be able to operate like this, more to the point they would not survive a single financial year. One last thing, please tell your receptionists to stop telling me I am not as important because I am asking for private treatment, do you not understand that I am also an NHS patient?? I pay my taxes too! It does not disqualify you from NHS treatment because you have private health care, private health care I can’t even use because of your incompetence and zero levels of commercial awareness.

reviews.author: Aimee Mills
reviews.text: I moved here from another GP's and I am astounded at the difference in care. You can actually get an appointment with a doctor for starters. The GP's are thorough, highly knowledgeable and are relentless in getting to the cause of illnesses and also treat the symptoms. They do all of this with such empathy. To conduct themselves so cheerfully, professionally and provide the selfless care that they do is remarkable. All in a pandemic too. I have had to ring for emergency appointments on a couple of occasions and had no problem seeing/speaking to a doctor that day. It can take a while to get through on the phone as there is no numbered call queue system but I have always managed to get through after a couple of attempts. I have found the receptionists to be efficient and effective and not at all rude. They have been bombarded with calls about Covid (on top of normal calls), up and down to the door hundreds of times a day to keep the surgery covid clear and compliant with guidance, yet they sit on the front desk with a smile and put themselves at high risk. I genuinely commend you all at the practice, for the care you provide and the difference you make to so many. We are often quick to find fault and slow to find the positives. There are lots of positives.

Reading the Inspection report it seems inconceivable that GOOD was awarded for mental health services which included dementia! Seriously consider the communication strategies and appointment system They are both dysfunctional. reviews.author: Jean Leader
reviews.text: We joined this practice many years ago and we were quite happy with the doctors and the whole practice. As time went by and the doctors changed except for a couple who stayed. Things started to deteriorate. Each visit would always be a new doctor as there seemed to be a regular changeover, this meaning you never got to know a doctor or they you. To ring for an appointment could take forever being on hold. Too get an appointment well that could be weeks away ( my very last attempt was over 3 weeks !!!! ). That made my decision to leave this practice.My husband made this same decision for a different reason. He had a motor accident and the hospital told him to go to his doctors as soon as he could. This was fine he got in the next day ( a one off ) as it was a sort of emergency. He saw the doctor but the doctor would not take his blood pressure, he told him to do it himself in the waiting room. Myself and my husband tried this but the machine was broken, reception tried it and agreed it was broke. So reception rang the doctor and asked could my husband go back in ( no other patient had gone in or was waiting ) The doctor said NO make an appointment to see the nurse another day. One thought came to mind DISGUSTING. I myself was seeing the nurse a couple of days later and she said " tell your husband to come and see me after his work and i will wait for him if he struggles to get back to Bolton on time". What a difference we found the nurses are so helpful and caring. Also we would always be on time for our appointments but the wait sat in the waiting room could be anything from a good half hour to well over an hour. !!!! We have now changed to another surgery and we are so pleased with our choice. It may not be an updated modern surgery but it is so welcoming. The staff lovely and the doctors 1st class. I have had too visit more than normal so another reason I am glad we changed, as TWO days is the longest I have had to wait for an appointment and next day the other two appointment's. To close I can only say I am surprised Heaton Medical Center have managed just over one star in these reviews. Our opinion is that it has gone down so badly over the years and feel so relieved to have got away from Heaton Medical Center.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: I feel the need to write this review due to the many unnecessary unfair reviews. I am writing this review to provide feedback on the experiences of my wife, who is a patient at Dr. Subramanian's practice. My wife has been a patient of Dr. Subramanian for many many years, and we wish to convey that she finds him to be an excellent and highly valued doctor. She is more than extremely satisfied with the care she receives and would not consider changing practices. Regarding her access to appointments, my wife has always been able to get an appointment when needed and has never encountered any difficulty in being seen. This is in stark contrast to my own doctors at the same health centre, where it can be impossible to get an appointment unless you book three weeks in advance. Despite the option to call at 8 am for a same-day appointment, I have found it nearly impossible to get through to the practice, which often just gives an out-of-service tone. This brings me to a common complaint I hear from people about potential delays to appointment times. I have observed that Dr. Subramanian often makes a significant effort to accommodate patients who present with urgent issues on the day. Furthermore, I have noticed that delays can also occur when patients require a double appointment but only book a standard one, or they present with multiple issues they need addressing. From what I can see, the doctor is very thorough and compassionate in addressing all of their concerns, which can sometimes extend beyond the scheduled time. While this might occasionally lead to waiting longer for a pre-booked appointment, I believe this reflects a true commitment to ensuring those with immediate needs are seen, and that everyone gets the time they need. This responsiveness for urgent matters is something I value greatly, as it is not always my understanding of how easy it is to access care at other practices. Overall, my wife and I are very happy with the care and accessibility provided by Dr. Subramanian. He is a credit to his profession. Practice response date: 6 months ago Practice response: Dear Paul, Thank you so much for your positive Five 🌟 review. It is much appreciated. We will continue to provide excellent service for all our patients. Kind Regards Dr Subramanian and Dr Haider

Some staff on the desk are lovely but others are lazy, they are not bad folks they just can't be bothered doing their job I guess or maybe they are depressed who knows? The Locum gave me an NSAID one time that boosts gabapentin that was silly so I chucked them away as then i'd be up on my does. I have quite a bit of knowledge on medications. I am happy with my G.P. and some of the staff like nearly most of em, the Indian lady is the best on the desk and Dr Subramannian is very good he has clearly read the NHS constitution. I like the new health centre but it can be stuffy at times the library does that I think the books take up moisture in the air an it gets dry n hot if there is a lot of you in there. I think a solution would be fans and maybe somehow having a window that can open on the panels? Anyway, It's way better now I am happy with this one, happy as larry. An actual Doctor worth waiting even for him if it's busy as you can go in very anxious and come out not depressed and anxious I guess the anticipation must release dopamine. I have never left the G.P.'s office suffering not one time unless I am the one messing it up 0-o. Peace. reviews.text: I have been a patient at Springview Medical Centre since it first opened, but sadly, the quality of care has declined since Dr. Shrikant and Dr. Gupta left the practice. They both consistently offered outstanding medical attention and set a high standard that I wish all doctors could emulate. I would also like to mention my disappointing experience with the in-house physiotherapist. reviews.author: Cedar Hodsman
reviews.text: Absolute shambles of a surgery. Dr Butt has prescribed me the wrong medicine 4 times, even after having a phone consultation where we agreed on a course of action, she still wrote the wrong prescription! I've been waiting over a month to get a simple prescription done correctly. Just baffled at this level of incompetency. Also seems to be extremely difficult to get an appointment at this clinic lately. Not sure if this is because of the recent change in management? You have to call up at exactly 8 am to be put on the list and have the doctor ring you back at some unspecified time, so you have to sit by the phone all day just waiting for the call. Some doctors only work 2 days a week, so you might be waiting a while to speak to them. In terms of the pharmacy, I had a similar experience as another lady's review - my prescription was rejected (because the doctor hadn't bothered to read my medical record and see that I'd already had the blood test results to require the medication), but I wasn't made aware of this. It's only when I called up wondering when my prescription would be ready that I discovered it had been rejected. Just shocking service alround. If you can join a different surgery, you'll probably save yourself a good few headaches by avoiding Spring View.

reviews.text: If I could give 0 stars I would. THE WORST SURGERY I HAVE EVER BEEN TO. JOTSNA the receptionist is so rude, she thought it was appropriate to argue and laugh while I explain my fathers symptoms, who by the way is a vulnerable patient. She then proceeded to lie about it when she didn't realise she was on a recorded line. She just seemed like a very angry person who doesn't enjoy her job, and to be honest if I had a face and personality like hers I would be angry at the world too. The GP's are no better, they also fabricate things against their patients to cover their own backs, my father was given medication he did not need. This doctor then fabricated a story to DR GUPTA who is also an awful and unprofessional person and when I said to Dr Gupta her doctor is lying she got very angry and threatened me with a warning letter, all because I spoke up against this false accusation. Seems to me they bully their patients and families quite often. The fact she thought I would keep my father at that surgery is ludicrous, I question how any of them became doctors anyway. I had also proceeded to tell the doctor that I believe my father is dehydrated as he has not been able to keep anything down and she brushed it off, only for me to later receive a call to say his results indicate dehydration and he must be taken to the hospital urgently for fluids via IV administration. The surgery itself is a risk to health, with damp and mould and also there is NO CEILING in the waiting area. These combined pose a huge risk to ones health and safety. The place is a complete shambles, its below adequate and I'm surprised its not been shut down. I will be taking all my complaints further, to GMC, The Health Authority Ombudsmen and to PALS. I think its about time the staff at this surgery stop bullying and patronising their patients and their families and fulfil their duty of care.

reviews.author: N Bolton
reviews.text: Whilst the service has improved since Dr Caswell’s departure this practice is inconsistent when delivering good patient care. I have been at this surgery for over 5 years. It is not unusual to wait 2 weeks for an appointment unless you push for a same day appointment. However if you have work or family commitments as most people do it isn’t always possible to drop everything at such short notice. Seldom seen at appointment time, sometimes nearly an hour later. Incredibly inconvenient when I’ve just ‘nipped out’ of work and return 2 hours later. You can ring at 8am or 3pm for a same day appointment but they aren’t guaranteed. You can be on hold for up to 10 minutes before you receive an infuriating message telling you the practice is now closed when it is not. I no longer telephone but go in in person as I can’t be ignored then. Some receptionists are pleasant, some are rude, sometimes the pleasant ones are rude! I have used BARDOC myself without prompting from the practice as I can not rely on an out-of-hours service. I have been told twice recently there are no appointments during an acute episode requiring an emergency prescription. The male doctor seems more open to further testing and investigations when presenting with what could be symptoms of a potentially serious or underlying condition ; The female doctor not so much. Money appears to play a part in decisions, such as what medication is prescribed or potential tests to be carried out. I don’t need to know the cost of a blood test just if I need one thanks. On one occasion I had to ask the nurse to close the curtains upstairs in a room that faces residential properties , whilst removing my clothing and underwear. I shouldn’t have to ask. The building is currently being refurbished but would be irrelevant to me if I was receiving good quality care. I have also often partly heard consultations through the walls/doors when stood by reception or in the waiting room. They should invest in sound proofing as consultations should be private and confidential. My biggest concern is inconsistent care, as sometimes I feel satisfied and others times I feel fobbed off or just a patient number. The service is not personal and doctors don’t seem to familiarise themselves with your notes. I work in the NHS and patient numbers here are low compared to other surgeries across Bolton, where I have experienced knowledgeable and proactive doctors who appear to know the patient even if it’s just because they have skimmed the medical notes. Would not recommend this surgery if you have high expectations or previous experience at a good surgery as you will be disappointed. Never mind the building Beehive Surgery, invest in some customer service training and learn the value of your patients.

reviews.text: I was wondering if I had caught the receptionist on a bad day but realised this is clearly an ongoing issue after reading all the other reviews. It just goes to show that patient care is not top of the surgery’s list as this particular receptionist has been there for a long time. Rude, bad mannered, patronising and in need of some well overdue customer service training. The automated message when you ring the surgery clearly states if you are ringing for BLOOD TEST results, phone after 1pm. Mine was a different test so rang at 10am. Tried to make out that I was in the wrong stating “well it should say ALL RESULTS!” Well it doesn’t Karen so get off your high horse and knock yourself down a peg or two. Such a shame because all the other receptionist are lovely and polite. Always one rotten egg that lets the others down.

reviews.author: Linda Southern
reviews.text: What a wonderful example of a Dr surgery I've been a patient for more than 30 years and for many years a patient of Dr E Perry last Tuesday I took ill in the surgery with a problem I had been experiencing over the last few months ,and was awaiting further investigations into. Having alerted the reception staff I was immediately taken into their office space and Dr Perry was informed of my condition I can not thank her enough for what happened next ,an ECG was hastily arranged at the surgery and Dr Perry was then able to contact a cardiologist about my condition and she recommended some medication this in its self was above and beyond what i expected, however she then contacted me later that same day to tell me she had further spoken with a cardiologist and some different medication was recommended .today one week after I was ill at the surgery Dr Perry rang me to see how I was feeling and offered me some further advice and support she has referred me to a cardiologist to answer all my questions and further treatment .At a time when the nhs is under pressure and Dr surgeries are hard pressed to cope with the demands on their time I am so grateful to Dr Perry she has shown what a true gp should be careing and committed to their patients care and wellbeing I want to thank her and recommend her to everybody

My daughter also had a blood test a few months ago and still have not received results yet and when I asked about the results since I was fed up, the receptionist said I know how to raise my voice acting like she was verbally abused. Most surgery have a pre-booked system and Dr Naseef don't have it we have to call them in the morning and if we are lucky we get a appointment or call back next day and same again next day too. In their time slot it's 15:00-18:00 and still not answer till 18:45 and they close at 18:30 so how am I supposed to answer because it's withheld and in Christmas time. Government and doctors needs to improve their service so in the future they will get better reviews otherwise the surgery will get bad reviews and patients leave their surgery. I have noticed Dr Naseef having not one but multiple surgeries. I have been with them for over 5 years and have not seen him even once. I don't think he takes his responsibility seriously. reviews.author: Maria Jobeen
reviews.text: I phoned this practice ahead of my appointment to notify them that I might be 5mins late due to an ongoing meeting. The receptionist Lesley claimed that I didn’t have an appointment and that I was left a voicemail. After trying to explain to her for what felt like hours that I returned the call to confirm my appointment which was in fact NOT cancelled ,the conversation wasn’t going anywhere and there was no apology for wasting my time. Poor customer service as well as an “I don’t care” attitude. After reading through these reviews,I’ve understood that many other patients are subject to this rude behaviour too. Businesses should review job performances based on competency and not how long they’ve worked there for- especially with FOH staff. From my own experience, I understand that receptionist jobs can be extremely challenging but for a middle aged woman to be so ‘fed up with it’ as so to speak, maybe it’s time for her to leave.

reviews.author: K Mlo
reviews.text: It’s incredibly disappointing to have experienced such a low standard of care from Dr. Nasima Sidda. From the very beginning, it was clear that her bedside manner is virtually non-existent—she made me feel like an inconvenience rather than a patient in need of care. Communication was curt, dismissive, and unprofessional, with little to no empathy shown for my concerns. Worse yet, her lack of medical knowledge is alarming. Multiple critical aspects of my care were either completely missed or mishandled, leading to unnecessary stress and complications. She failed to provide accurate diagnoses and consistently displayed a troubling inability to address my health issues properly. What was most frustrating was her dismissiveness when I raised questions or concerns. Rather than listening or explaining things, she either brushed me off or provided vague, unhelpful answers, leaving me with more confusion than clarity. This is not what anyone expects when they seek medical help, and I strongly urge others to avoid her care if they want competent, compassionate treatment. Dr. Sidda's lack of professionalism and expertise makes her a serious liability to her patients.

reviews.author: J S
reviews.text: I have been a patient of this surgery for 30 years and have always had exceptional service until the past few years. Since Dr Newgrosh has retired there is a significant lack of care, communication and professionalism. I don’t believe for a moment that this is the fault of the hardworking individuals of the surgery; the receptionists, cleaners and nurses are overworked and under appreciated throughout the borough. The chemists also provide an excellent service. I also don’t blame certain GPs, who take their duty of care seriously. I do, however, believe that there is a serious problem and someone needs to take responsibility for that. As someone with a full-time job, I have to arrange when I will be ill in advance. There is no walk in option and when it is possible to get an appointment (bearing in mind I have to provide evidence of this at work), they are swift and sharp. Almost as if I am inconveniencing the doctor with my paltry ailments. Now, I am not one of those that has a season ticket to the waiting room (I only go when absolutely necessary), however, when I go to the doctors I expect to be gone appropriate time and attention. This is simply not provided here. Dr Newgrosh was a credit to his profession, I only wish his predecessors had the same commitment to their role.

reviews.text: The worst practice in Bolton. The place is dingy and miserable. Only one doctor so you'll NEVER be able to see him and receptionists are very unhelpful, they don't even pick up the phone sometimes and other times they misinform you. For example I once had a serious issue so I needed to come into the walk in clinic, the lady I spoke to told me to call in the morning at 9am (not before because they can't accept it). Next morning I call in at 9:02am and I'm told it's fully booked and to call earlier. I tried again the next day at about 8:30am and again I was too late... If you ever try and book a regular appointment they try and sway you and say "oh it'll be 2-3 weeks why don't you just come into the walk in?" But then you'll never get an appointment. They never apologise either and sometimes they make it seem like it's your fault for not working around their terrible system. I don't know if they are forced to use this system in place or they prefer it but it is not working. The only good thing about the place is the nurses who you'll end up seeing most of the time if you do manage to see anyone and they are very professional and competent. The doctor is too but you can tell he's overworked and trying to rush through your appointment most of the time, I feel a bit sorry for him but at the same time he needs to get the place in order with some better receptionists and a better system. Perhaps an extra doctor. Needless to say I have left and instantly get a much more reliable and smoother experience at my current GP even with all the COVID situation happening. I delayed writing this review just to see if all GPs were as bad as Deane Clinic and maybe they are all just overworked due to being on the NHS but my new practice has been very smooth and easy since I joined with the nicest staff and best service before and now during the COVID situation. Highly recommend avoiding Deane Clinic.

However, you could be waiting for a call all day. Test samples aren't always interpreted in a timely manner - so you could be waiting for days for a call back, unnecessarily. The practice is rooted towards the bottom of the local GP league tables with good reason. My advice would be to find a practice that is capable of meeting your requirements at times of need. Time and time again, this practice has let me down. One area if hope - Saeed is courteous, caring and highly professional. If only the GP could be half as effective. reviews.author: Len Spiggot
reviews.text: I find the staff friendly, but I treat them with respect, I find the Doctor's helpful, but I don't suffer from Munchauson's or sick note syndrome.

reviews.author: Jackie Mitchell
reviews.text: A really bad experience with a receptionist today Thursday 8th 2026 at 2.20 pm. This is not my previous experience, the receptionists are usually amazing. They go above and beyond to help, especially Karen. Today this receptionist was happy for me to leave without a prescription for an inhaler due to a technical issue and not reading my file notes correctly. Which is pretty irresponsible, she was beyond rude and really unhelpful. Thank goodness for Deborah who ensured I wasn’t going to be without my inhaler this evening, she was kind, reassuring, supportive and was able to sort out my much needed inhaler. Thank you Deborah!! The earlier receptionist really needs to decide whether this is the profession for her. Her unhelpfulness and lack of compassion and just willingly allowing asthma patients leave the surgery without their meditation and didn’t even try to find a solution.

The receptionists also deserve praise for putting up with us all with a smile on their faces!!

reviews.author: Jo Malone

reviews.author: Jon Shedwick
reviews.text: You’re website has a catchment area enquiry and my address fell within it so I called and got told I wasn’t allowed to join this surgery by your rude receptionist

reviews.author: Teresa Cookson

reviews.author: Susan Roberts
reviews.text: This is an amazing centre. They prioritise babies and children. I cannot say anything but great things. If you call after a certain the appointments will be gone for the day. That isnt the receptionists fault. But call at 8am about a poorly baby and they will see you within a few hours, even an hour sometimes!

reviews.author: Jacinta Yates
reviews.text: Thank you so much to Deborah the Practice Nurse for such, professional and caring service to patients. I came to her a few months back and she was very knowledgeable and efficient. Today I brought my elderly stepdad for a blood test he was concerned as had forgotten his letter about the blood test. Deborah had already read his notes before we came in and the latest letter and she knew about his recent change in medication and blood test needed. She explained it all to his in such a caring and professional way and give him a thorough consultation taking the time to also do his BP. Thank you so much Deborah.

reviews.author: jawad ahmad
reviews.text: The worst place ever, waited over an hour on the phone ,for them to tell me they dont have any appointment and go to hospital , because their recepionist think i should go to hospital without even letting me conuslt with a gp . I wish i could give this place zero stars ,
