reviews.author: Paul Cally
reviews.text: Getting an appointment is an absolute nightmare for 3 day's I have tried by phone from 8am -8.30am and not even managed to get in the so called queue !! .... It would be easier to get an audience with pope Francis and I am not even a Catholic ..!!

reviews.author: steven bill
reviews.text: Always been spot on and attentive.

reviews.author: beccy taylor
reviews.text: I have nothing but positive experiences regarding this practice. I have been with them over 40 years. Yes, sometimes it is difficult to get an appointment but if you really need urgent attention and ask politely for help they have always been responsive.

reviews.author: Zen
reviews.text: I had been at the surgery for over 12 years and it’s just gone so down hill. I had gone to see the Dr who I’ve never seen before as they could not get me an appointment with my actual GP she prescribed me the wrong dose for my medication. When I asked for this to be rectified over the phone as I could not do it online I was told it would be done the next day after waiting for over a week and having to keep calling up the surgery I was told by the receptionist that the GP said to take 3 of the same tablets so it would equal the same dose. This is incorrect as yes it would match the does however the lower dosage is more of a sleeper than to help with my mood and mental health which I was told by the pharmacists. It had my anxiety through the roof and with my mental health being so bad the receptionist did not care at all neither did the practice manager who owns the surgery and does not have any care in the world!!!! Can be done for negligence by prescribing the wrong dose and then saying to take 3 of the same!!! They then have decided to take me off the surgery without any notice and I only knew they had when I wanted another appointment with my actual GP. When I explained all this I was told it’s the way you spoke, bearing in mind I did not shout or swear however i have mental health and was given the wrong medication so what and how am I supposed to speak to someone when I’m trying to sort out my medication for over a week which they got wrong in the first place!!!! Absolutely disgusting behaviour!!!!!! If I could give the surgery zero stars I would but it does not allow that. Leaving a person with mental health without medication is negligence and digusting!!!!!

reviews.author: Eamon O'Carroll
reviews.text: I have been registered here for over eight years, although I don't have any ongoing chronic conditions other than Achilles tendinitis , every experience I have had has been a positive one. Reception staff answer the phone in a professional and polite manner and direct you to the most appropriate health care expert. When I have to attend to see the nursing team to manage my vitamin B12 condition, reception staff are polite and greet you with a nice snail Andy a friendly hello The nursing team are brilliant and do all they can to facilitate your appointments around you. Drs have an excellent bed side manner and are genuinely interested in your health. A paramedic practitioner has been added to the clinical staffing levels whose assessment process is thorough and galvanised with good safety advice before terminating the call. Well done and thank you to all the staff at Blackford house.

reviews.author: richard gotti
reviews.text: I was no 1 in que for 50 mins. Purposely don't answer phone I've seen them in action phone ring and they just let it ring and press a button for silent. By far the worst staff aswell so rude on the phone no customer service left. Your talking to ill people have some respect

reviews.author: garwi choy
reviews.text: the staff there are actually very caring and trying their best to help with chronic medical issue. People need to realise this is a GP not an emergency department. if you are very unwell you need to be seen by the a&e dept

reviews.author: Poopy Rosa

reviews.author: Inayah Siddique

reviews.author: Andrew Mcgookin
reviews.text: Don't answer phones

reviews.author: Ankur Vij
reviews.text: Really Poor reception staff. Was called in for an emergency appointment for 8:30am after a telephone consultation. I arrived there at 8:25am waiting to be checked in, only to find the receptionist on her phone (probably checking her Facebook notifications) - when i finally got to the DR at 8:40am I was told I am late where I politely replied “it’s your staff I been here since 8:25am!” . This isn’t the only time I’ve been at the practise when I’ve actually seen the staff pick the phone after a call and leave it on the desk so no calls are answered and that’s why you find it engaged!! You get there early and you’ll still miss your appointment time because they’re ‘running late’ or if you’re late they be rude to you. On a positive note the Drs are great and helpful but the reception staff tend to let them down.

reviews.author: Jake Potts
reviews.text: Dr Alier is the best doctor I have ever had. His knowledge and level of care is unmatched.

reviews.author: bgn aquariums
reviews.text: My mother was carried into this practice by my father after suffering from dizzy spells. She had been a few time but they found nothing wrong as she wasnt dizzy at that moment in time. This time she was dizzy. But the receptionist sent her away saying it wasnta walk in centre. I spoke to carol armstrong ( the practice manager) regarding this poor service. She promised me it would never happen again. Fast forward 18 months. Now my Father is suffering from high blood pressure. He tried for 6 weeks to get a face to face appointment and failed. Then one day he went to the surgery feeling desperately ill, to be turned away at the intercom. Eventually he got a face to face with a GP (a poor one at that). He was told by this waste of time GP that he was the fittest 79 yr old man he’d ever seen and was sent away. 2 days later my poor father suffered a massive stroke. Because we waited over 30 minutes for an ambulance we rang the surgery to see if a doctor could come and help, only to be told no, the doctor has other patients. He wouldn’t even speek on the phone. Where was this doctors duty of care? He was taken to Fairfield hospital. We rang the surgery and got a phone appointment with this so called GP. He said he was worried about what we had told him regarding my Dads condition as he was very good at detecting oncoming strokes. He missed this one, and it hit my Dad like a freight train. My Dads specialist said if he had been sent to A&E they could have prevented the stroke. 3 1/2 weeks after being told there was nothing wrong with him and he was the fittest 79 yr old man ever, my Dad sadly died. I hold this disgraceful so called Doctors practice responsable for my Dads death. This place needs a total overhaul. From doctors to reception. Especially the practice manager. A zero star rating is still too much for this disgraceful practice.

reviews.author: Isie Xox
reviews.text: Honestly the reception staff are unbelievably rude and unhelpful. They don’t care and leave you on hold for over an 1.5 even at position 1 In the que? I’ve dealt with a few of the receptionist the only helpful lady is Lorraine, they always make errors and don’t care to help you. I’m still waiting for 2 call backs from before xmas (LOL). Also I was reduced b12 injection even Though dr advised, ended up in hospital the next day after blood results because my b12 was so low. Go figure. I’ve had enough! They really don’t care about Well-being, your just a tick box exercise. The only decent DR who cares is DR quershi, but I wouldn’t recommend this surgery at all. Mainly because of the receptionist, rudeness, and how hard it is to get a basic appointment. The drs will fob you off with a prescription if you explain your problems par 5 minutes. Wish I could give half a star.

reviews.author: Lucy Hunt
reviews.text: The reception team are so rude and unhelpful. Covid seems to be used as the excuse but it wasn't great before. I didn't think they were allowed to refuse to see a child, but apparently that doesn't apply to Blackford house. When I questioned why they couldn't make an appointment for my 1 year old, I was shouted at by the lady on the reception.

reviews.author: maic 66
reviews.text: If there was an option for a zero rating then that's what I would have given it. If you're looking to change practice and use Blackford House Medical Centre my advice would be to give it a wide berth and choose a different practice altogether. Due to moving into the area I had to change practices so I've now been with this practice for just over 4 years and have regretted joining it ever since. The doctors at this practice seem pretty decent and genuine... however, if you're looking for quality care, respect and a level of helpfulness then forget it. From practice manager and right down through the ranks to receptionists all you get is a total lack of professionalism, rudeness, failures in duties followed by lies and false accusations. Normally I wouldn't take the time to write reviews however in this particular case I thought it's my duty to warn people what they would be letting themselves into. From the offset of joining this practice, I've been constantly accused of being rude and abusive towards the members of staff resulting in which I believe to be a "SPECIAL NOTE/black mark" being placed on my medical record. From my very first encounter to the very latest visit to the practice I've just encountered barriers ever which way. Not receiving notifications for things like flu jabs (because I'm type II diabetic), or simple things like changing quantities of medication on prescriptions. Constant barriers! For me what instigated all this animosity was my very first visit to the practice. I approached the reception desk to ask about a medical certificate and how long it would take to issue. My approach was calm but direct because to me... this was an important medical certificate which was needed for a new employer. Rather than replying with a simple "let me check... " what I got was "I haven't got the f-ing time to chase up stupid requests and it'll get sent out when it's sent out!" When I challenged her on why she was being so rude she tried twisting the situation and replied that it was actually me that was being rude and abusive and that she would be reporting me to the practice manager about my alleged abusive behaviour. I subsequently received a letter from the practice manager informing me that the practice will not tolerate aggressive and abusive behaviour towards NHS staff from patients and that any re-occurrance would result in me being struck-off the register. At no point was I ever approached or asked for my account of what was said or done...it was automatically taken for granted that I was the aggressor not the receptionist. Since then I've had countless incidents where receptionists have been rude to me, application forms for medical exemption certificates being lost preventing the certificates from being issued which inturn delaying me from getting my presciptions of upto 3 weeks or more. (forcing me to incur a financial cost for something that's free on the NHS with an exemption certificate). I've heard receptionists saying under their breaths here's that Bl**dy awkward Mr W _ _ _ _ again, what the F**k does he want now...? When I reported these and many more similar incidents to the Practice Manager her response were always totally dismissive and supportive towards her frontline staff insisting that it was I who was always being rude and the aggressor and that if I was not happy with the service provided by the surgery then it's my perogative and that I should go enrole with a different medical practice. These are just a few geniune accounts of my experiences with this practice. It's a closed shop where everyone sticks together and lies their ways out of a situation. Where no complaints are ever being logged or followed up on. "Duty of care" doesn't exist at this practice. It's literally a case of.... If you don't put a fake smile on your face then you're being abusive! lets see what happens when the CGC gets involved and they're Audited!

reviews.author: Jim Jones
reviews.text: Given the extreme pressure GP surgery are under ! This is a well run efficient surgery . Well done to all the front of house and back office your efforts are appreciated . Regards

reviews.author: Konrad Swirad

reviews.author: Ag Shadowwolf
reviews.text: I have been with this practice since I was born and I am 55. They have always been fabulous. The reception staff are always understanding, helpful and lovely whilst Dr Golding is just amazing. They all really care. Thank you all. 😊 …

reviews.author: BELINDA Cohen
reviews.text: very hard to get an appointment but great G.P's

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.text: My Son and I have been a patient at Blackford House Medical Centre for over 19 years now having been recommended at the time by one of the Mums from his Primary School and am I glad I listened to her ! It saddens me to read some of the negative reviews about the practise when I have always had nothing other than a 'first class' professional service from everyone working there. I have never had a problem of getting an appmt, if one was urgent it has been allocated on the day and if not urgent have had to wait no more than a couple of days to see a Doctor. If I have preferred to see my own Doctor ; Doctor Ehsan then that wait time has been 2 to 3 wks but I don't mind waiting to see her as she has to be the kindest and most understanding GP I have ever had and I have always had a good Doctor no matter where I have lived ! Sometimes when ringing for an appmt I may not always get an answer on the telephone straight away but I have never found anyone rude there. They all work very hard and under a terrific amount of pressure and do a fantastic job. I cannot praise them all enough !! Keep up the 'good work' all of you, you are the best !!

reviews.author: AlexanderW
reviews.text: Customer service is extremely poor, it is always frustrating calling them. Today the online prescription service is unavailable. So tried phoning prescription line over 20 times always engaged. Amazingly got through to reception but they were unhelpful. So now stuck without prescriptions!

reviews.author: Karen Brooks

Shocking and bullying behaviour. Surely as a someone who is there to help a more caring attitude is required.

reviews.author: Gilda Nevitt-Arnold
reviews.text: Really great doctors and plenty of them to always get an appointment. They have a dedicated script line and the receptionists are the best I've ever come across, nothing is too much trouble.

reviews.author: Eden
reviews.text: Friendly staff and kept nice and clean

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.text: Staff at this surgery are fantastic. They will do everything possible to fit you into the days surgery. Dr Salahudin in particular is very good.

reviews.author: Claire Grover
reviews.text: Update: I have had more urgent need to speak to the practice in the last few months and I'm sure I have drove them mad but it never shows. Don't particularly like the GP triage to get an appt and you cant book online but its good that they do call same day; my previous doctor you waited 3 weeks just for a tel con. reviews.author: Garry Grover
reviews.text: Excellent service from all the staff

reviews.author: soňa lengyel
reviews.text: Dr Katie Butler is an exceptional professional and a truly wonderful doctor. From the moment I arrived, she was incredibly kind, approachable and attentive. She took the time to really listen to me, explained everything clearly and made sure I understood all my options. What I appreciated the most was how supportive and reassuring she was throughout the appointment. She never rushed the conversation and made me feel comfortable and cared for the entire time. Dr Butler is not only highly knowledgeable but also genuinely compassionate. It is rare to meet a doctor who combines professionalism with such warmth and understanding. So, thank you sincerely Dr.Katie Butler

reviews.author: Robina Jones
reviews.text: Recently had an issue with my foot, phoned first thing Monday morning, was seen on the day. Sent for an xray and saw the physio on the Friday. Great service

reviews.author: Michaela Kirsten
reviews.text: I recently joined this medical practice and just wanted to say how wonderful all the receptionists have been. I’ve had to call a few times about different things, and each time every member of the team has gone above and beyond to help. I’ve never known a GP practice to be so friendly, supportive, and efficient. Thank you all so much for your kindness and excellent service

reviews.author: Jessica Boddis
reviews.text: I’ve been with a few surgeries over the years and this is the best by far. The doctors listen to you. Telephone appointments on the same day. Reception staff are polite.

reviews.author: Fran Fitton

reviews.author: Wojciech Miskis
reviews.text: Very happy with this GP surgery! Always have time to discuss any concerns and when they feel something is a concern via telephone appointment, they will see you even on the same day. Never had a problem as they are always helpful!

reviews.author: Jill Hazzelby
reviews.text: During the past two weeks, when I have felt very unwell, I have received prompt and caring attention after triage calls. Thank you to Doctor's and Receptionists.

reviews.author: Peter Hoolickin
reviews.text: Great service at all times

reviews.author: Abby Leeann Byrne
reviews.text: Great GP surgery, always polite and always get an appointment quickly.

reviews.author: maxine harris
reviews.text: After a few initial hiccups, I am so happy with the service. Dr Shafar is so patient and understanding. He explains fully and also takes the time to repeat everything on the NHS app for me. All the nurses are so lovely and friendly as are all the extremely helpful and friendly receptionists.

reviews.author: Mike Johnson
reviews.text: Thankfully, I rarely need to see a doctor. On the odd occasion when I, or a member of my family, did in the past it was usually very difficult to get anything out of this surgery. The doctors/nurses were always great but simply getting an appointment felt like a chore and getting blood results was also pretty difficult. Happy to say that when I did need to see the doctor recently things seemed much improved. The doctor was great as always, but it was also simple to get a callback the same morning for triage and then an appointment for a couple of days later which, for non-urgent issues, is pretty swift.

reviews.author: Ali Salman
reviews.text: Poor attitude Doesn't answer call TRYING FOR A LOOONG TIME

reviews.author: Sophie Williams
reviews.text: Ive tried for weeks to get an appointment for my daughter who has a rash on her stomach. After being told by the doctor they "don't need to see her" and to "send in pictures" I was prescribed a cream which has made the rash even worse. I phoned again this morning to try and get an appointment for my daughter. The receptionist was very understanding and made a note of my concerns. I was then messaged and asked again to send in pictures which by now I have point blank refused. My daughter is of a darker skin tone and it's hard to see through a picture the severity of the rash so I decided to go to the Prestwich pharmacy. Luckily for me there was a lovely chemist who was more than happy to take a look at my daughter and thankfully I have now been given the correct treatment. This surgery needs to rethink it's procedures you cannot diagnose everything through a picture and it's ridiculous to think that you can. You are causing unnecessary stress to your patients and making situations worse by prescribing the wrong medications.

reviews.author: T Gee
reviews.text: The Doctors in this practice are very responsive.

reviews.author: Pamela Leith
reviews.text: I've only given 1 star just so I can do an honest review otherwise they would have got none ! My mum is nearly 90 and very ill and cannot get to the surgery. Dr webbley himself made an appointment to come and visit my mum at home , what he failed to do was tell us that he unlike other people can seemingly be in 2 places at once ! ... he chose to not tell us he was on 'annual leave' when he was meant to be visiting mum ! Disgusting behaviour from a public body!

reviews.author: Wendy West
reviews.text: How can a GP make arrangements to visit my ailing mum, yet when I phone at 4pm to find out what time he is due, I am told he is on Annual Leave and to phone again in the morning to start process all over again. I am devastated!!

reviews.author: Julie Green
reviews.text: I find this surgery very efficient. I organised a triage phone call on the nhs app also to order medication. The response was fast and I was very happy. I have never had a problem. The doctors are always very prompt and helpful. Thank you.

reviews.author: J

reviews.author: Jackson aquatics
reviews.text: You can never get through by phone. There's no point even having a doctors if you can't even make contact with them

reviews.author: Lynton Susman
reviews.text: One of the most innacurate cliches from the public, describing the emergence from this pandemic is that, "GP Practices are all the same," suggesting, no matter which practice you are with, they all suffer from the same shortcomings. ie: they don't answer your calls, there are no face to face appointments, the receptionists are rude and GP's are still hiding under the cover of Covid. So, are they, indeed, all the same ? The reality is, whilst many practices have emerged from this pandemic, very successfully and efficiently, Unsworth Medical Centre have, somehow become frustratingly "stuck," and haven't appeared to make the kind of progress that, most would describe as, "getting back to some kind of normality." I have experienced hanging on the phone for up to 50 mins before my call to the practice was finally answered and more recently, an automated message suggesting receptionists were busy and to call back later. To ad insult to injury, the infamous text to all patients, advising to call the surgery ONLY if, "urgent/emergency assistance" was required. I heartily believe, certainly at the time of this posting, that this medical practice might actually fail to meet even the most basic needs of some of its patients. So, reaching the point at which I was begining to feel very vulnerable and neglected, I whole heartedly knew it was definitely time for a change. My wife and I are so, so, lucky to find a new GP practice, which thankfully resembles, absolutely nothing like, the above !

reviews.author: Alicia SB
reviews.text: This medical centre is an absolute joke, they are still using COVID-19 as an excuse. They have a lock on the door so you have to wait for them to answer before you can sign in for your appointment (if you ever get one), which usually makes you late if you have to wait, and then they tell you that you’re the one who was late. The receptionist are useless, you have to call at least twice before you can get put in a queue (which is usually more than a half an hour wait) to actually book a phone consultation because you’re not allowed to book face to face appointments. The automated response is ‘our receptionist are currently busy please call again at a later time’, well you can barely get through. I’ve seen people waiting outside pressing the buzzer for 15 minutes before they were let in and they were then told their flu jab appointment was given away because they were late. The majority of the time, they ‘diagnose’ you over the phone, or just give you antibiotics but won’t tell you what is actually wrong with you, it’s a joke.

reviews.author: Manchester Kung Fu
reviews.text: Never anyone available to answer calls. Failing at their most basic duties.

reviews.author: Joseph Bird
reviews.text: Since covid the place as gone down hill rappid, 4 days trying time and time again all our receptionist are busy dumped, at one time you were put in a queue but not no more, so I drive there waiting area empty and know one answering the phones. So from 5 stars to 2 you go, I really have no idea why it gone from one of the best surgery's to this debacle is beyond my comprehension.

reviews.author: Jane Berry
reviews.text: Excellent care. Staff are helpful and dedicated. I have been with this practice since I was child and consider my self very fortunate as the care is second to none!

reviews.author: simon twigg
reviews.text: Yeah just leaving this practice as soon as possible.

reviews.text: **NEW PATIENTS BEWARE** AVOID REGISTERING HERE AT ALL COSTS! A constant source of medical negligence. I'll be writing a complaint to the practice manager, the CQC, the NHS, and my MP. reviews.author: Paul Rimmer
reviews.text: Simply cannot get an appointment to see a GP at this place now. Call in or phone up during the day and you'll be told (politely, in fairness to the receptionist) that there are none available so you'll have to phone them at 8am the next morning. So you call at 8am the next morning, and of course there are dozens of other people doing the same thing. Sit in the queue and you'll be told there are "more than 30" people ahead of you. Wait patiently for 20 minutes, then get cut off. Call back and be told again that there are "more than 30" people ahead of you. If you choose the option to get a call back, they'll send you an SMS with a link to a website where you can see exactly where you are in the queue. I did this the other day and I was 113th in the queue. That's not a typo: one hundred and thirteenth. So that "more than 30" you hear while you wait patiently, could mean there are 31 callers ahead of you, or it could be 112 callers. Or more. Go on the app to book an appointment and, if you're lucky, there'll be one or two available - in a month's time. I guess if you're going to fall ill and need to see a doctor, plan it a month in advance.

reviews.author: Paul Dutton
reviews.text: It would be comforting to feel that these reviews change anything, but here goes. Greenmount Medical Centre, on Brandlesholme Road was an excellent Practice until they amalgamated with others in the area. We were never told why that was, but experiences since suggest to me that per capita, here in Greenmount we were lucky to have a good GP:Patient ratio (with up to seven or eight front-line GPs), (nearly all of whom were truly excellent) some first-class front-line Nurses and a lovely team of Admin staff that always made you feel welcome. Waiting times for the telephone were rarely more than five minutes and you were always able to get a face to face appointment with a GP within two weeks,-sooner if you agreed to one other than your first choice. I remember there being facilities sometimes for early morning or evening/ Saturday appointments. The growth of the Practice to being part of TFH was introduced very quickly and stealthily; all of a sudden we had several times more (probably up to twenty times more) patients and far fewer front-line GPs to take care of them. Funding gave us money that was spent on privatising the administration of the practices, redefining of roles, introduction of a heinous telephone system and several iterations of computerised management, more than one legal constitution of the new “business” and total chaos for all the patients. Not surprisingly, many complained. Then many more, so that some more GPS and more qualified Nurses have left. I wrote to the Practice Manager three times over a number of months, also the Care Quality Commission and only received a reply seven months later from the Practice Manager that patronisingly complimented me on my IT skills ( they are not very good) and then claimed that the new systems in place are working and that the patients are no longer waiting so long to receive urgent treatment in the NHS. She also said that many of the problems had been down to COVID, although the decay was set in far before that. I now know that the Practice Manager has left, “for a far bigger job” elsewhere and that the real problem, as a few of us expected has been a migration of GPs away from their jobs here. Nevertheless, I believe successive governments have been complacent and blind in letting a lot of these things happen. Why do we need a Triage system to filter out less demanding cases to newly-defined roles for cheaper employees? Why do we need outside administrators to run our surgeries? Why do we allow barely-qualified staff to take on so many of the appointments GPs used to handle? The answer, I fear is “money” and yet so much of it has been spent and wasted elsewhere with expensive IT software that didn’t work (Lorenzo), hordes of HR and IT admin staff and all sorts of roles created in pursuit of Diversity and Equal Opportunities problems that seem to be far worse elsewhere than in the NHS. Our telephone staff at Greenmount number only two some days and they have to handle hundreds of incoming telephone calls and still answer the bell at the door! I for one would be glad to help for nothing if that would help, but please everyone, write to your MP to get some support for the restoration of 1:1 appointments.

reviews.author: Brad Coleman
reviews.text: Moved here as my partner is registered here too. Everything was great at first. But since COVID, all you get is "NO", "WE CANT". you can never get an appointment. The receptionist only refer you to "ask my GP" (Funny that because you never get to see your GP). When you ask for an appointment the receptionist wants to know the ins and outs of your problem!!!! Sorry but that has got absolutely NOTHING to do with you at ALL.... and if it's so you can put it down in the notes as you said, then it would be nice when I eventually see a doctor that he or she actually knows what I'm there for since you wanted to know for the said "NOTES". I asked if a doctor could take a quick look at my son's stitches after surgery and I was greeted with NO, YOU WILL HAVE TO GO ON ASK MY GP IN THE MORNING!!!!! What a lovely, warm, welcoming practice. Came out of there feeling worse than when I went in..... COME ON GUYS ITS NOT HARD TO BE NICE!

We’ll if the dr called when they said they would this wouldn’t be a problem would it? Then when we ask to book for them to call us on another day we get told that the receptionist can’t do that? What is the point in them then? Just to give abuse your the people needing help? I’ve never ever spoke to a more pointless set of receptionists in my life I honestly feel it should just be full automated with how basic and automated their responses sound, NO CARE and certainly NO HELP from this GP I beg anyone who really needs help to sign up anywhere else or your just wasting your time

This took a week before I could due to work/school runs.then I waited all day for a phone call, spoke to a doctor who then made a doctors appointment for a week later. Unfortunately I had to cancel this appointment due to work. I called in the clinic to rearrange. Today I was told the receptionist isn’t able to book any appointments and that I would have to start the process again, or I could have a telephone call on 11th June, 2 weeks away! Then the doctor could rearrange my appointment on the call. Her advice was to go and overload an already crippled A&E if I wanted to be seen sooner! What the hell are GP’s telling people to go and sit in A&E for routine doctors appointments for? Disgusted at this attitude and not sure that the amount they are paid per patient should allow them to send non urgent cases to A & E! Not sure the local hospital would be too pleased with them doing this either.

reviews.author: Ann Ashworth
reviews.text: From the best GP surgery in the area to the worst. I could cry, why oh why did they change I have been with them for almost 50 years. I would change in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Alison Davis
reviews.text: Receptionist was very helpful today. Thank you.

reviews.author: Mark Haviland
reviews.text: This is the worst DRs I have ever had to use. Rude staff, don't accept anything that's not on ask my gp even though two thirds of their patients are elderly and cant use the Internet. They never follow up you have to follow them up. You can't get an appointment and when you do it's in 6 weeks time by phone. They have used covid as an excuse for all the staff to be lazy and do nothing. I left and have gone to garden city, it amazing, an appointment in 2 days and the follow up for bloods and ecg 3 days later and they rang me to give me the results. So glad I left that dump and hopefully their management reads this as you can't complain

reviews.author: Georgia Platt
reviews.text: Absolutely ridiculous! I wouldn’t bother with this ‘ medical centre’ its impossible to get an appointment and when you finally do they tell you to just get over your illness and ‘give it time’ refused to help me or give me any kind of prescription

reviews.author: Marcus Deluier
reviews.text: Shocking! Unhelpful. No appointments available. I needed an appointment and was fobbed off. Have not been to the doctor's for many years as I am usually very healthy. Not a chance of any help. I have gone elsewhere and paid privately for a consultation.

reviews.author: Amanda Winskill
reviews.text: Having waited for 90 mins on the phone for an urgent appointment & still being 27th in the queue I called at the surgery. The receptionist was on her own & despite being under enormous pressure, she eventually got me an appointment with a Doctor at Spring Lane which I attended & walked away feeling reassured. I also asked if she could arrange a face to face appointment for my husband, rather than a telephone one that had already been arranged. Again she spent some time time & arranged one at Tottington. With all the negative press, I feel that Tower Healthcare should be given due praise & in particular the receptionist who went gave fantastic service to accommodate our appointments.

reviews.author: Heather Marshall
reviews.text: I called Greenmount medical Centre as my 21 month old son has been unwell for a week. The previous 2 nights before calling them he'd had a temperature of 38.8 degrees. Explained to the receptionist I didn't know what was wrong with him but he was unwell and I was worried about him. Her response was "have you seen a pharmacist" 🤯. Luckily a doctor did ring me back and said she definitely thought my son should be seen so to bring him in. He was then prescribed a 10 day course of antibiotics for a bacterial infection. Next time I'll remember to go and see a pharmacist....

reviews.author: Simone Stansfield
reviews.text: I spoke to reception lady this morning and she was fantastic 😊thank you very much😊 …

reviews.author: walrus gumboot
reviews.text: Rude and aggressive practice nuse

reviews.author: Clare Murray
reviews.text: Awful uncaring staff, avoid if you can. It's such a shame because it used to be amazing, reception staff were lovely, nursing staff seemed to actually care. That's not the case anymore. As others have said, I dread having to try and make an appointment, firstly rude reception staff, not all but some in particular, then you get promised call backs that never happen. It's so sad to see. Wish they hadn't merged with Tower. If you can, go to another practice that isn't with Tower.

reviews.author: Korin Smith
reviews.text: Most awful GP practice in England, Rude staff who laughed when I said I'm deaf as I have an ear infection and can't hear!!! Told me not to be rude when I was just speaking loud because I can't hear. Never had a more disrespectful experience in my life. Someone needs to take a look into what medical care is these days.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.text: Nothing short of neglectful

reviews.author: Mrs Matthews
reviews.text: This is without doubt the worst GP Practice I’ve ever been to. Joined about a year ago after moving into the area. Rude, uncaring staff including practice nurses- totally unsympathetic and uncaring when dealing with vulnerable ill people. Shockingly poor attitudes from receptionists. Ironically on the very few occasions I have seen a GP they have been friendly and kind - it’s the other staff that are the problem! I have now changed to a different local surgery. Do not use this inept surgery- my daughter was so ill last year yet got nothing from a curt dismissive practice nurse - as soon as she returned to her university the doctor there said she should have been put on strong antibiotics immediately. Dreadfully disappointed with this practice.

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text: Once Greenmount was a very good medical centre. Sadly over the past several years the standards have dropped significantly. You can no longer simply ring & get an appointment. You are pushed to do it via the internet. Then you still can't get an appointment but simply a phone call first. You are left feeling exposed vulnerable and frustrated as a patient due to the structure in place. For shame.

reviews.author: Singers Unite
reviews.text: My mother is 66 and in tears in pain , her doctor says they will get back to her and never do, absolutely shocking place DO NOT USE THIS DOCTORS

reviews.author: Andrew Nicholas
reviews.text: Very helpful staff who always look after you.

reviews.author: Ada Grundy
reviews.text: Was always an amazing practice but since it changed to Tower Family its been diabolical. If it wasn't for my nurse Diane I would've left years ago. Never see the same doctors, no one ever calls you back, stop your meds for months at a time. Refused to process a complaint for me, then said complaints would call be back shortly to discuss further; that was November 23rd... it's now April 26th! One lady on reception is the rudest person you can speak to, I cannot remember her name but if you get through to her you'll know!!

reviews.author: John Carter
reviews.text: I joined this practice 8 months ago I have a lot of health issues but I have found I get very good attention from the doctors nurses and reception team all my call are responed to very quickly well done

reviews.author: Howard Mercer
reviews.text: Very difficult to get an appointment and almost impossible to get through on the phone, ask my gp gets turned off at 11am unless it's very busy and has been off by 8.30am before now. Once you eventually get an appointment the GP s are very good.

reviews.author: jason mcdonald
reviews.text: Sadly a once good practice is no longer. 11 days to receive a call back from a Dr let alone get an appointment..

reviews.author: Isabel Stolar
reviews.text: Still waiting on day four for a doctor call back after informing them a 3 year old boy wasn't to well wouldn't let us go to the surgery saying no doctors available this place is not good

reviews.author: Nicola Tuke
reviews.text: This used to be a great practice and I am grateful if was that way for when my children were younger. Now the process to get an appointment is so long-winded and speaking to a human being is like gold dust. If you do get through to the reception staff they just direct you back to the computerised system like call centre staff which is only open until 11.30 am each day. If you work full time and miss the window you have to wait until the next day. So many medical issues will be missed as a result of people just thinking "this is too complicated". They'll just wait until their situation improves on its own or sadly until it gets worse.

reviews.author: Andrew Hardman
reviews.text: As said in previous review this used to be a fantastic surgery. Since the merger/ covid, is an absolutely awful practice.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.text: This used to be a great family GP surgery under Dr Phillips and latterly Dr Hampson. Dr Patel got greedy, most of his family work at the surgery and you never see any accounts published, which is a requirement. The level of care is terrible, my relative was rushed to hospital with heart failure as the Dr's failed to respond to requests for help.

reviews.author: Linda Kennedy
reviews.text: Greenmount... what has happened? The merger with Tower was a bad move in my opinion I would have rated you 5* before, the askmygp service is aggravating, no call backs on blood results! Can't see the Doctor you like anymore! Can't even get your referral letters done correctly!!!

reviews.author: John Emery
reviews.text: The usual high standard.

reviews.author: Robert Leigh
reviews.text: After leaving a request on ask my GP I was rung by a doctor on 4 March 22 and asked to drop off a sample for analysis .. this was dropped off at Green Mount Surgery on 7 March 22. Heard nothing so used ask my GP again on 10 March 22 to see if there was anything from the sample I should be aware of and asked for further advice on my ongoing condition.. its now 18 March 2022 .. still not heard anything so just tried to chase it up .. ask my GP system is now stating it can't accept anymore requests and ring the surgery .. 22 on the phone waiting list My wife managed to speak to the surgery on 21 March and was told if the was nothing to be concerned about with my sample I would NOT be notified ( might be useful if somebody had told me that before ) and that my ask my GP contact of the 10 March had been triaged and they were unable to confirm when I would be contacted .. its now 23 March ... no contact thus far

reviews.author: Stephanie Hartley
reviews.text: I have been with practice for 39 years and always said how amazing they are. Since moving to tower family health there has been a real decline in the practice. Now the service is absolutely appalling would have given no stars if I could.

reviews.author: bekah sloan
reviews.text: Dr C Fines is absolutely brilliant. Caring, methodical, a great GP.

reviews.author: Anthony Connor
reviews.text: Gone down hill since it changed.

reviews.author: craig robert
reviews.text: Used to be a brilliant practice but when it went to Tower Family Health it has gone down hill , appalling service

reviews.author: Dominic Kelly
reviews.text: Appalling level of care, had infected abscess the size of a golf ball, told to take pain killers by two doctors in there and it will 'go away'. Got a THIRD medical opinion via 111, ended up in A+E for emergency surgery, 2 days hospitalised. Final straw. Over 10 years a patient, never had any issues until the merger, in fact I loved Green Mount medical centre and the care it provided me and my family. The surgeon who drained my abscess told me if I had of left it a week I could've developed sepsis. I'm taking myself and my family out of this place. Reporting to PALS.

reviews.author: Elaine Walsh
reviews.text: This practice has gone downhill. Too many doctors spoil a practice. Had a home visit for my son. Doctor arrived and I asked her a question about loss of taste and smell and her reply was "I've known people to never get it back". As I suffer from anxiety this only heightened it. I said she scared me saying that and her reply was "what will be will be". She left me on edge, was very blunt and not diplomatic whatsoever. Negative comments do not help. This merger is the worst thing they've ever done.

reviews.author: Eric McNicholas
reviews.text: I have always been treated very well and the staff are always very polite

reviews.author: David Wainwright
reviews.text: Used to be brilliant but since becoming Tower it's very poor, give us our old service back.

reviews.author: MR BOYDER
reviews.text: What a joke the "covid" jab centre no simple ops when there are no more dead in the uk than the 10 year average just a simple manipulation of death certs of people admitted dying of natural causes....misusing pcr to diagnose infectious disease when it is not for that and never has been. A "deadily" virus would not be 90% targetting 82 and over life expectancy with 99.9% no symptoms/survival rate. Oh and anybody thinking vaccines are rushed out in 7 to 8 months are living in cloud cukoo land.

reviews.author: Brett Greenwood
reviews.text: Rude obnoxious staff that won’t offer any help. There customer service training consists of “Do it on ask my gp” Lazy staff that should be addressed if they are to lazy to deal with simple requests. Even when ask my gp is down the line is “try it later”. Disgusting service

reviews.author: Charlotte Edgley
reviews.text: Deserves 0 stars. Shocking practice

reviews.author: Mark Ashworth
reviews.text: Very efficient

reviews.author: Tony Marshall
reviews.text: Excellent, prompt and effective service when I used AskMyGP. Saved travelling to the surgery and unnecessary face to face contact. A polite, professional telephone call from Dr Chamberlain answered my query.

reviews.author: celia bartholomew
reviews.text: celia bartholomewLocal Guide · 26 reviews · 1 photoEdited 6 years ago

reviews.author: Maxine Naismith
reviews.text: Greenmount Medical Practice was - yes WAS the best. What has happened? Can't get a simple routine appointment on line for absolutely weeks. Today it took me almost 15 minutes to speak to a human. I have just tried to get a very urgent appointment. Nothing at all available anywhere. Had to advise why an appointment was needed, but still advised nothing available. Go to the walk in centre or pharmacy. If it wasn't so serious it would be a joke. Why would I go there for a serious problem when I am registered with a GP in Greenmount. For over 40 years our family had received a first class service at Greenmount Practice. I can't say that any more. It has deteriorated over recent times. Long waits to get someone just to answer a phone call. No appointment for weeks. Now can't even get an urgent appointment. This Practice has joined the ranks of so many others in Bury. It's like we are living in a third world country with a third world service. Appalling - and we're told Tower Family Health Care has benefited patients. Please advise me how. God help all us patients. It's obvious not enough staff to man the phones and clearly not enough nurses and GPs to deal with patient care. So sad isn't it - and they tell us the merger was the way forward. Give me back the old service any day.

reviews.author: Paul Crowshaw
reviews.text: I never had a problem with Greenmount Medical Centre, but the service has gone downhill since changing to Tower Family Health Care. It takes a long time to get through on the phone, no matter what time of day you call, the excuse is always that they are short staffed. It's been this way for some time now...so why haven't they employed more? In my experience, when I do finally get to see a doctor it is always someone different, usually a visiting doctor, who has no idea about your medical history. This inconsistency not only portrays a lack of personal care, it's also an issue if your needs are sensitive or require more complex problem solving, with the patient having to explain everything from scratch every time they go back and putting the onus on them to remember where treatment is up to.

reviews.author: Hannah Jones
reviews.text: Always can get an appointment. May take a little longer to get through due to the merger but in the end I always get through. The receptionists are always lovely and helpful, must be hard on them getting the brunt of everyone's frustration all the time. They do a great job and all the nurses and drs I have seen have been amazing throughout my care, I've been under greenmount since a baby. Would definitely recommend

reviews.author: Nathan Hartney
reviews.text: Nice people

reviews.author: Chloe Boardman
reviews.text: If i could rate this practice a 0 i truly would. They do not care about their patients and their reception staff are rude, thoughtless people. I believe most of their staff don't actually understand what their doing, probably just playing the guessing game when it comes to patients health. From my understanding you can't get rid of a patient off the books untill they have moved doctors, however this is exactly what they did while still needing treatment. I would highly suggest not going to Greenmount Medical Centre if you are looking for proper care and understanding.

reviews.author: NOIZE
reviews.text: Tower Health Lacks Any Care. Grenmount was a superb well run practice. Now its absolutley terrible ,not the staff they are still great.But the cost cutting system they are now forced to work under is destroying a once superb practice. And its spread so far over Bury its efect on services is and will be huge . When will CCG or Pennine se this ?

reviews.author: S B
reviews.text: since it merged with other practices its become impossible to get n appointment, phone is rarely answered without a lone wait and they no longer do weekend appointments which they have done in the past, We will be looking for another practice soon

reviews.author: T P
reviews.text: Efficient staff. Calls always answered. Good doctora

reviews.author: Dave Duffy
reviews.text: Dave DuffyEdited 7 years ago

reviews.author: susan horrocks
reviews.text: Since it has gone from being Greenmount Medical Centre to Tower Health the service is very poor can’t get in to see a nurse and I have been told it is due to one nurse that is very poorly and has been off work since March. The receptionist says it’s putting a strain on the other nurses. Might be a good time to find cover for her before all the nurses are off with stress. Common sense gone out the window. So I asked can I book in at one of the other practices that they had merged with and was told no we can’t do that. So what exactly are the benefits of the merger, I have yet to find any Greenmount was alway a great practice never had a problem getting seen before and I have been a patient over 50 years.

reviews.author: Natalie Fernandez (ohemgeeitsnat)
reviews.text: I’ve recently moved to Bury and chose this surgery due to the location. I regret it. How to get an appointment is unclear. Called on a Wednesday to get my medication sorted after the move. I was told I need two appointments, a new patient review and a separate appointment to sort out my antidepressants. They said I can only call on Mondays. I called today and was told there are no appointments until the 30th. I said I need to get back on my meds as I’m not doing good. They said I need to get a same day appointment. But I can’t get a same day appointment without the review? The whole system is unclear and confusing. My partner by the way, was given a month of his meds (same ones as me!) without the new patient review! If anyone reads this and has recommendations for a new NHS GP in Bury please let me know Practice response date: Edited 23 hours ago Practice response: Hello Natalie, To clarify our appointment system, our diary is open for 2 weeks ahead for routine appointment bookings. The diary is extended every Monday morning for the next lot of appointments, so today the diary for week commencing 30th of March opened up for bookings. Each day there are 'on the day' appointment bookings for more urgent problems. Please contact the practice on 0161 509 0340 if you would like to discuss further. Kind regards, Lydia Reception Team Lead

reviews.author: Peter Lee
reviews.text: This practice is a shambles booked a blood test .they phoned me to change it asking me to phone up to change it you can't get through..then before that send you to another practice only for them to send you back .I've had a health problem for about six years and they haven't got a clue well I'm looking at a nother practice your a disgrace

reviews.author: Tim Robinson
reviews.text: Thursday 22nd January 2026 I came into the surgery and your lovely receptionist April was so helpful she helped me with ask my gp as was really stressed about it and showed me what to do she is a absolute credit to your surgery I felt I had to get In touch about this and praise her.

reviews.author: Natasha Unsworth
reviews.text: Dr Khan - unbelievable man, kind and compassionate with our family.

reviews.author: Toby Wrigley
reviews.text: Staff on Reception an appalling have been on hold as the first caller for 25min. And I think that it’s absolutely shocking nobody can answer the phone.

reviews.author: Adam K
reviews.text: One word, inconsistent. One month you can order a prescription over the phone, next you have to go in person (good luck if you are working). Half the time receptionists will not follow through with what they said they would do and you will thus you will never be able to trust them again. Practitioners will lie to get you off their case (not naming names). Sometimes they will do more harm than good, especially if you have mental health issues. But at least its free! Edit: Another example, the receptionist in person looked at me like I said something wrong when I inquired why my repeat prescription won't show up on the app but on the phone another receptionist told me within seconds that it was marked as not available for patient online and she can edit it, why on earth you would prescribe a medication for someone then actively hinder the patients ability to follow the doctors advice?? Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear about your recent experience and understand how distressing it must be to encounter issues with your repeat prescription. We aim to provide safe and consistent care, and it is never our intention to cause upset or disruption to a patient’s treatment. Please reach out to us directly so we can assist you and address any concerns you may have. Kind regards

reviews.author: Elaine Stott
reviews.text: My husband and I have been with the practice for over 60+ years and are so grateful for the care shown by the medical team and the reception team, Nothing is too much trouble. They continually try to assist in whatever way that they can, which is extremely reassuring when you rely on them so much. Thank you all. Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Thank you very much for your kind words and taking the time to share your recent experience. We are always happy to receive any comments on our service. Your feedback is greatly appreciated. Many thanks

reviews.author: Lawrence Booth
reviews.text: Pooed service yet again with argumentative reception staff. I wanted to book an appointment when the "ask my GP" didn't work and I was told it would be over 3 weeks. I said it was urgent and was told to ring again in the morning. I said I wished to book it now but she refused an appointment. She stated that the practice manager could ring me back. I asked to be put through now, she initially claimed she couldn't do that but eventually gave in. Awaiting a recall for an urgent appointment.

reviews.author: brenda walsh
reviews.text: This is completely unacceptable. Last year I was having problems with my medications. I saw Dr Younis and he resolved it and red flagged certain medication which was not to change. Having received my repeat prescription for July 25 the person who authorised my repeat prescription rejected my antidepressants. Ignorned the warning on my medical notes, changed my medication to one that is flagged on my records so now i have medication which can't take and no antidepressants. Im experiences horrible withdraw systems because i only took half my regular dose last night. Just how can this happen? When this is sorted i will be complaining to the CQC. The medical professional who responsible for this has totally ignored their duty of care to which i am entitled too. It's unbelievable!!! Practice response date: 7 months ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are genuinely sorry to hear about your recent experience and understand how distressing it must be to encounter issues with your repeat prescription. Please be assured that we take matters like this very seriously. We aim to provide safe and consistent care, and it is never our intention to cause upset or disruption to a patient’s treatment. We note that you have already contacted the practice manager regarding this issue, and she will get back to you to provide a detailed explanation.

reviews.author: Louise Mary
reviews.text: I’ve been with Ribblesdale my whole life and I cannot fault them - they are always there when you need them, they are very helpful and understanding. Practice response date: 11 months ago Practice response: Thank you very much for your kind words and taking the time to share your recent experience. We are always happy to receive any comments on our service. Your feedback is greatly appreciated. Many thanks

reviews.author: jacqualine scott
reviews.text: Both me and my husband have been patients at Ribblesdale MC for 22 years. In all that time we have nothing but praise for all the staff . Reception are always very helpful and polite My husband was unwell and I managed to get him a same day appointment which I was very grateful for. He was seen by Doctor Khan who was really lovely and reassured my husband who was concerned over feeling unwell. Well done to all who work there regardless of their grade. First class treatment again. We feel privileged that we are patients at Ribblesdale because we know the abuse some NHS staff have encountered by patients Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you so much for your kind words! We're delighted to hear that you and your husband have had positive experiences at Ribblesdale MC over the years. It's wonderful to know that Doctor Khan was able to provide reassurance and excellent care during your husband's appointment. Our team works hard to provide the best service, and it's so rewarding to hear your appreciation. We’re grateful to have you both as patients, and we'll continue striving to maintain the high standards you’ve come to expect. Thank you again for your support!

reviews.author: Sidra Khan
reviews.text: Absolute horrible service! A definite decline from previous reputation of this practice. I have been trying to discuss my x ray results for past 5 days, after a failed phone call attempt by the GP. They also offer an online appointment system managed by the nurse practitioner, who can’t seem to gauge the patients needs. I am asking for an appointment for the day, they instead give one for the next month. Suffering from chronic back pain, had a back x ray done 4 weeks ago. Results are available for me to see but I need clinicians interpretation and its taking this long with no luck. I have taken 2 days off work but all they know is to not take responsibility for their incompetence driven inconvenience caused to the patient. And when you’re antagonised enough to express it they have the nerve to call you rude. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We apologise for the inconvenience and frustration you’ve experienced regarding your recent interactions with the practice. We understand your concerns about the difficulty in reaching a clinician to discuss your X-ray results. Karen, our Nurse Consultant reviews the incoming Ask My GP requests each morning. Looking into your requests we can see you selected the option "Preferred call time: Any time, not urgent", based on this Karen sent you a routine booking link. Our appointment system consists of routine appointments, available to be pre-booked in advance and urgent on-the-day appointments, which release first thing in a morning. If you specify your problem/concern is urgent, we do our best to provide you with a prompt appointment.

reviews.author: Polo Mints
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible can never get an appointment to see a doctor. Rang up this morning on the phone for 15 mins got to number one in the queue, and then cut off. Rang back to be told there's been a bleep in the system. Only one receptionist phone was working. And all appointments had gone.Next available one in 2 weeks. In agony but can never get to see a doctor. Nothing ever gets sorted or referred to the places it's suppose to go too. I'm sure the doctors are under horrendous pressure. But this GP surgery is letting people down. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: We apologise for the frustrating experience you’ve had, particularly with the phone system and difficulty booking an appointment. We understand how challenging it is when you're in pain and seeking urgent help. We're actively reviewing our processes to prevent issues like this from happening and will work to improve availability. Thank you for sharing your feedback, and we appreciate your patience.

reviews.author: Leah Williams
reviews.text: Disgusting medical practice no medical care given I have had heart surgery twice and they point blank refuse to book me an appointment and claim they have never received letters from the hospital when I can see it infront of me sent to them receptionists have absolutely no manners at all and are unhelpful and useless, how can one gp practice loose 15+ letters Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback, Leah. We’re very sorry to hear about your experience and understand your frustration. It’s crucial that our patients receive the care they need, and we take your comments seriously. Please reach out to us directly so we can investigate this matter further and ensure you receive the support necessary for your medical needs.

reviews.author: Gillian Stubbs
reviews.text: We’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations. Please contact us directly so we can assist you further. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: We’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations. Please contact us directly so we can assist you further.

reviews.author: Chris O'Connell
reviews.text: My Doctors since Birth almost 58yrs. Fantastic Service by all Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you, Chris, for your loyal support over the years. We're pleased to know you've consistently received fantastic service from our team. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text: I phoned first thing this morning and by 8.03 I was off the phone and I had secured an appointment for my Grandad. The receptionist I spoke to was brilliant, really polite and friendly and really listened to me and took the time to note down what I was telling her, and she booked the appointment for that day. My Grandad hasn't stopped talking all day about how brilliant Dr Akbar was, he said he didn't feel rushed at all and he felt he was extremely thorough and also really friendly, and he hopes all his future appointments are with Dr Akbar. Thank you so much to all staff for being so brilliant today, they're all a credit to the practice. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for sharing your experience, Emily. We're delighted to hear that your Grandad received prompt and thorough care. It's wonderful to know that our team, including Dr. Akbar, made such a positive impression. We appreciate your kind words and will pass them on to the staff.

reviews.author: Ros Ayres
reviews.text: Tried to book an appointment using Askmygp, it's useless. Tried for 30 mins, but couldn't work out how to do it. Took 45 mins to get through by phone. Was literally dialing, hanging up then redialing. All I'm trying to do is book in for a non urgent meds review with a specific GP. I have this problem every time. I am now so stressed that I'm crying. I feel sick with anxiety, every time my pharmacist says I need a medication review. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: We are sorry to hear about your experience, Ros. We understand how stressful it can be when trying to book an appointment and are genuinely sorry for the difficulty you've encountered. We are continually working to improve our systems and services, and your feedback is crucial in this process. Please reach out to us directly so we can assist you with your medication review and address any concerns you may have. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

reviews.author: Johanne Harvey
reviews.text: Why do they treat patients so poorly? There have been many times over the last two years when I have wanted to write a review regarding how poor this practice is, having been poorly over the last couple of years. Today has spurred me on to do this. It is such a shame that the pleasant and efficient members of staff are so overshadowed by the poor members of staff. Yesterday morning, I made an urgent call to the surgery regarding a prescription for Levothyroxine. Whilst the urgency was the fault of the chemist (for which they have apologised), the only way to remedy the mistake and get the needed medication was to ask the doctors to approve the prescription urgently. As I had no remaining tablets, I was assured by the receptionist that she would mark as urgent and get it signed yesterday. I have to say, she was polite. The chemist, this morning, advised that they had not had the confirmation from the surgery so I was forced to ring again. What is completely laughable, is that the surgery have recently changed their answering machine service detailing exactly how members of the public are to speak to the staff. No mention of the way in which the staff speak to the public! My goodness, speaking to the receptionist this morning was a thoroughly unpleasant experience. What an unpleasant lady. When I explained that I had no medication and had not taken it today and that I was advised it would be marked as urgent yesterday, I was told, and I quote, 'they don't like being pushed into signing a prescription request'. I presume that the 'they' are the doctors. When I attempted to stress that I need the medication and that if it was not approved, it would, tomorrow, be two days of not taking it, I was then told - 'Well it will be approved within 48 hours'. She was rude, dismissive and had a 'could not care less' attitude. How is this allowed to happen? When I tried to question whether it would definately be done, I was spoken over consistently. Truly unpleasant. This surgery should not employ such poor members of staff. What is remarkable is that they do not question why patients may become frustrated or annoyed? If they just took the time to train staff members and look to retrain staff members that are thoroughly unpleasant, then I am sure that not only the patients, but the staff would be much happier. Their care is atrocious and sadly, the practice is tarnished by a few 'bad apples'.

reviews.author: Colin (Tarquin) Griffiths
reviews.text: Being relatively new to Ribblesdale I can't fault you guys in any way, you have all been very professional, courteous and friendly. Thank you. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you very much for taking the time to share your recent experience, we are always happy to receive any comments on our service. Many thanks

reviews.author: Tiara Siddique
reviews.text: I previously wrote a review about this practice last year and didn’t get a response when I called the surgery to discuss my concerns and issues. The service hasn’t improved since my previous review which I have had to take down as it appears I can’t write more than one review about the practice. I called the practice last November to arrange to get a sick note and spoke to an incredibly rude receptionist called Anita. She stereotyped me and asked what is the sick note normally for! It’s the first time I had called for a sick note as I had a serious accident and was unfit to work. Unsurprisingly, I didn’t get a call back when I asked to speak to somebody about the appalling service having spent almost an hour trying to get through and over 100 calls before the call was connected. The surgery now has a new pre recorded message about staff not tolerating abuse from patients. I personally wouldnt be abusive to the staff but find it interesting that it’s ok for staff to be rude to patients but they won’t put up with patients being rude to them. I can understand why patients might be rude to staff. I’m currently sat trying to get through on the phone for over an hour as I need a face to face appointment and my call has been disconnected once so have had to redial and have also logged into the nhs app to try and make an appointment with no appointments available for over 16 weeks. The reception staff should all be sacked and new staff employed who actually know the meaning of patient care and providing a good service. This practice is a joke and needs to be shut down. It’s a waste of tax payers money. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: We are sorry to hear about your recent experience of our service. We understand that telephone lines are exceptionally busy at certain times of the day. We are aware of the problems the whole of Townside Primary Care Centre has had with the incoming telephone lines to the building over the last 4 weeks. We have now had a new telephone system at the surgery with the new number advertised via social media, website and emails and text messages sent to patients. Unfortunately we have been unable to put a message or divert on the previous telephone number as this line is still not working. You are also still able to contact the surgery via the usual means online via 'AskMyGp' or via the practice email address www.ribblesdale.mc@nhs.net. Please contact the surgery using one of the above methods to arrange a telephone call with the Practice Manager to discuss your concerns further as we are committed to providing the best patient care. Many thanks

reviews.author: Sameena Iqbal
reviews.text: always busy cant get throught even 8am on the morning Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: We are sorry to hear about your recent experience of our service. Unfortunately our telephone lines have been down on and off for the past week or so, this is a whole building problem and not just this surgery, however we are aware of the frustration this is having on patient experience. We have apologised and notified patients on a daily basis on the practice website and on our social media pages and advised that we have kept AskMyGp open so that patients can still contact the surgery between 8am and 6.30pm whilst the phonelines are down, along with the practice email address. We will also be having a new telephone system fitted shortly, along with most practices in Bury, which will make it easier to contact the practice by phone and request a return phone call if lines are busy. You are also still able to contact the surgery via the usual means online via 'AskMyGp' or via the practice email address www.ribblesdale.mc@nhs.net. Please contact the surgery using one of the above methods to arrange a telephone call with the Practice Manager to discuss your concerns further as we are committed to providing the best patient care. Many thanks

reviews.author: Asma Ali
reviews.text: Just spoke to receptionist Lydia.. asked her to get urgent repeat prescription for my daughters milk feed refused and then said can take 48hrs...advised her as my daughter has had surgery could not order earlier and need the milk feed... spoke to her in a normal tone...as soon as I said can I ask question she responded yes so I asked receptionist are not qualified doctors so why do they need to know patients medical issues...as she did not like the question she started making out i was being rude, she stared repeating u are being rude to me...by law all employers tell there colleagues if calls are recoded and responded when asked about recording I don't know if calls are recorded....I suggest to the practise calls are recorded because the receptionist are taking advantage and just making out us on the other end are abusing them....

reviews.author: Claire Barron
reviews.text: I have never had a single problem with this surgery and the service and support I have received over the last 20 years has been amazing. I saw Dr Ooi today for the first time when I attended with my son, Dr Ooi was incredibly polite and helpful and is a credit to the surgery. My son is a sulky teenage and on the way out he even commented to say “that doctor was really nice mum” and that lead me to write this shirt review as I’m a firm believer in giving fair credit and thanks when it is due. reviews.text: How does this surgery even exist?! No one answers the phone and when they do they pretend they can’t hear and put the phone down. This happened on every other call! The receptionists lack empathy and basic customer care skills. No doctors phone appointments available for 2+ weeks and only couple decent doctors there left. Ask my gp service only available for 7-8 minutes on average so by the time you type the request it closes and you have to wait another day. Most doctors only work there a couple of days a week so if you try getting the same doctor - good luck! Absolutely fed up and can’t wait to move to a more professional surgery where people actually listen.

reviews.text: The service hours for AskMyGP are restrictive which means a worse service to the vulnerable people you offer help to. To not be able to make an urgent or even a non urgent appt (medication review) is ludicrous. Not everyone is free to make appts between 0700 and 1100. But that doesn't seem to bother the people who you'd expect would be bothered.

reviews.author: Ronald Park
reviews.text: Quite

reviews.author: Mike Balfe
reviews.text: I have been a patient at Ribblesdale for over 20yrs and personally have always received good service from resident doctors, locums and reception staff. It's true that you may have to wait sometimes but the doctors haven't set out to inconvenience you, they have other patients and appointment times inevitably run over. This year has been a difficult one for me with quite serious health concerns and the service and support I have received from Drs Khan Younis and Kyffin has been tremendous. Especially Dr Khan whose early diagnosis of a problem may have saved my life. They have also continued to operate under very difficult circumstances during Covid. This surgery probably sees many hundreds of people a week and it is more likely that people will register their displeasure at perceived bad service than it is for people to give thanks for good service therefore ratings can appear skewed in the wrong direction. In closing, the new ask my GP service also works well. You have my thanks. Mike Balfe

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.text: Dear Woodbank Surgery Management Team, I just wanted to take a moment to write and express my sincere gratitude for the care and support I receive from everyone at Woodbank Surgery. At the moment, everyday life can be a real struggle for me as I am often in constant pain and regularly dealing with infections due to my low immune system. During these difficult times, Natalie has truly gone above and beyond in caring for me. I honestly don’t think I would be here today if it wasn’t for the care she has provided. I have never experienced care like it before. She understands my health conditions and always makes sure I receive the help I need when I need it most. Natalie has genuinely been a lifesaver and is probably the reason I am still here today. Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to her — she is truly amazing and a great asset to your team. I believe she will help take Woodbank Surgery very far. I would also like to thank Dr Javid, who has always been so kind and supportive and has consistently looked after me with great understanding of my care needs. In addition, the young doctor I saw this morning was fantastic, and I am very grateful that you have such wonderful doctors working at the surgery. Lastly, I want to say that Woodbank Surgery is truly a lifeline for me. I know that my health is complex and I do not have much family support, which makes the care I receive from your team even more meaningful. This morning, Natalie arranged for me to be seen straight away as I was feeling very poorly and had an infection, which meant so much to me. Your service is truly person-centred, and you should all be very proud of the care you provide. Once again, thank you ever so much for all your support and dedication. Kind regards, Jonathan Practice response date: 5 days ago Practice response: Thank you so much for this - its great to hear the positive impact we have been able to have on your health and well-being!
