reviews.author: Salma Khan
reviews.text: I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the exceptional care and professionalism consistently demonstrated by Dr. Aqsa Saeed and Dr. Hamad Kayani in caring for me and my beloved family at the Cornerstone Family Practice. Dr. Saeed is a truly remarkable physician who embodies kindness, attentiveness, and dedication. Her ability to listen with genuine empathy and provide thorough, patient-centered care is outstanding. She always takes the time to explain medical concerns in detail, ensuring that we feel confident and well-informed about our treatments. Dr. Kayani is equally commendable, offering a warm and approachable demeanor alongside an impressive depth of medical expertise. His clear communication and patient-focused approach make every consultation a positive experience. He goes above and beyond to address concerns and provide reassurance, making him a highly trusted and reliable GP. Together, Dr. Saeed and Dr. Kayani form an extraordinary team at the Cornerstone Family Practice, delivering the highest standard of care with unwavering dedication and professionalism. I am sincerely grateful for their genuine commitment to their patients and the positive impact they have made on our healthcare journey.

reviews.author: Ruby Shah
reviews.text: I have been with this surgery for 14 years since I moved to Manchester I will rate them 0 stars as it’s one of the worst surgery’s I have ever been to in my 48 years and I have had other drs in 14years I have never ever had an appointment with a regular doctor I don’t even know who the regular doctors are at that surgery I have a massive issue with parking as all surgery’s provide parking for patients instead this surgery only provides parking for their doctors lol which is a joke as I parked on the main road and got a 35 pound parking fine to go to see my dr also the surgery is situated on a main road next to a very busy junction and 2 schools one in front and one at the back and the bus station if u have an appointment after 2 there is no where to park and when you do eventually find parking your in a queue to see reception to tell them you have an appointment when u get to the front they tell you your late and can’t be seen this has happened to me and my son even though I have called to say we will be 5min late she said on phone as long as it’s only 10min but when got there I was in queue got to reception dr can’t see you also they need to have a self sign in so we don’t be late because we in the queue it’s ridiculous I have seen one at the surgery but has never worked or haven’t been told to use it in 14 years… also we got txts saying appointments are on the nhs app there is rarely any apps available on there I had a lump they checked it said goin to send me for scan I got a letter scan can’t b done contact dr again I did and reception said I have to call at 8.30qm to make an app with the dr I explained the txt said call and discuss the lump as it’s worrying and would like a scan but they are not bothered about there patients at all I have never heard anything back from drs and they are not bothered about any of my illnesses. I have tried getting apps it’s so hard the receptionist said the appointment I did have I can’t discuss my lump it at that as the dr can only deal with one problem and it’s whatever I wrote down she asked what did I book that app for I said pain she said you can only discuss that I find this not acceptable and the answers I have got back from the drs are not satisfactory I suffer from Mental health and they have made it worse I now in the process of changing drs to collegiate as they have parking and the app system is different I made sure I checked the new surgery because I don't want the same experience as this one for the next 14 years one of the worst surgery’s I have been to drs not bothered reception definitely not bothered I come home feeling worse than when I went also I have read recent good reviews which I don’t believe and think they have wrote then themselves as as the rating is a 2.5 as it should be how they treat patients or if they just treating me a certain way this surgery doesn’t know hat they doing Practice response date: a week ago Practice response: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are sorry to hear that you have experienced difficulties with appointments and parking. Please note that parking is not part of GP NHS contracted requirements, and as we do not own the building, we unfortunately have no control over parking availability. Regarding appointments, we aim to start consultations on time; however, if patients arrive late, it can impact the schedule for subsequent appointments, which is why it is important to try to arrive on time to help the clinic run smoothly for everyone. We appreciate your comments and are always looking at ways to improve the patient experience. If you would like to discuss your concerns further, please contact our practice directly and ask to speak with Stacey Simpson, our Patient Services Manager. Kind regards Mike Neville Business Manager

reviews.author: khalil zeria
reviews.text: I would like to share some positive feedback about my surgery. The doctors there are good but could do better with patient care and understanding. My go-to GP is Dr. Bukhari. He truly stands out to me—always welcoming with a smile, attentive, and genuinely focused on helping me improve my health and overall quality of life. While some doctors insist on addressing only one issue per appointment, they could take a leaf out of Dr. Bukhari's book—he's always willing to listen and help with multiple medical concerns, showing true dedication to patient care. The nurses working in the practice are genuinely compassionate and attentive, always showing kindness and care in their approach. The reception and phone staff are always friendly and helpful. They do their best to assist within the limits of what they’re able to do. The practice also benefits from having an in-house pharmacy, which is incredibly convenient and valuable for patients. Additionally, the surgery has expanded by opening a secondary site to accommodate the increasing number of patients. I see this as a thoughtful and proactive step to ensure continued quality care. Areas that need improvement. 1. Phone service needs changing. 2. More availability on appointments. 3. Rather than operating as two separate entities, the surgery and the pharmacy should work in closer partnership to better support patients and provide a more seamless, integrated level of care. 4. Parking issues, but I guess that's down to location. All in all, a big thumbs up to the surgery for their commitment and service.

We sincerely regret to hear about your experience with our reception team and appreciate the opportunity to address your concerns. Our receptionists strive to provide courteous and efficient service, and it’s important to note that their role is to communicate policies and facilitate processes, rather than make decisions about what can or cannot be done. We understand that this may be frustrating, especially if the outcome doesn’t align with your expectations. Please know that our policies and procedures are in place to ensure fairness, compliance, and consistency for all our patients. It is also important to note that our hands are tied in many respects due to chronic underfunding in General Practice, which has seen over 20% reduction in real terms funding for our services from the government since 2018, yet in that time we have increased our patient appointments by over 20%. While we aim to accommodate requests whenever possible, there are times when certain requests cannot be fulfilled due to either internal or external limitations, or both. We value your feedback and will ensure it is shared with our team as we continually work to improve the service we provide. If there is anything specific you’d like to discuss further or if you have unresolved concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out to Stacey Simpson, our patient services manager who would be happy to assist you. Thank you for your understanding. Kind regards, Mike Neville Business Manager

I am getting confused all the times and lost a trust on the Dr's unfortunately. However the Receptionist are now doing well. Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear Lazy foodie, Thank you for taking the time to write about your experience at the practice. There are many occasions where presenting symptoms could offer a multitude of prognoses. It is for this reason that in order to ensure that the correct diagnosis is made to treat you appropriately, then other possibilities need to be ruled out first. It is for this reason that the clinicians will send you for tests, to rule out these other possibilities. Thank you for your positive comments about the reception team; we are always keen to hear feed back - both positive and negative, to ensure that we can continually improve. Kind regards Mike Neville Business Manager

reviews.text: The clinic reception service is very poor. Whenever I call the I have to wait 15 - 30 minutes to speak to a member of staff. I plead to the clinic management that they look over these receptionist and see how rudely they are treating patients who speak to them. They are very rude and are causing patients to leave this medical centre. Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear Rebaz, Thank you for taking the time to write about your experience of the practice, however unfortunately seemingly not very positive. The reception staff do not make the decision of who you see. The Doctors have written very comprehensive directions based on national guidelines on who is the most appropriate clinician for you to see, depending on what your health problem is. It is disappointing to hear that you have said that you had to wait on hold for so long on the phone. I am not sure how this happened as the lines time out a lot sooner than that. We have more than the recommended staff required to answer the phones, however with a combined registered patient list of just under 17,000 patients, it is understandable that there will be some parts of the day that are more busy than others. I am sorry to hear that you perceive that the staff spoke to you in a rude or disrespectful way. Without knowing when and who this call was with I can not investigate. If you feel this way again, please get the name of the person you are speaking to and record the time and date. Our calls are recorded, so I will be able to to investigate this if you keep a record of these details. Thank you for taking to time to write about your experience, and I hope the next time you call the practice it will be more positive Kind regards Mike Neville Business Manager

reviews.author: Jade Harvey
reviews.text: If I could give this GP 0 stars I would, I am happy to see a review to say they are under special measures but nothing seems to change. Every single receptionist in this practice is the least compassionate or empathetic people I have ever had to deal with. If you don’t want to work in a GP practice, don’t do it!!! I have had the phone put down on me and in one day I’ve counted 4 lies told by separate receptionist. I have continually been lied to about appointments, blood test results and the process of actually getting help with several symptoms I have had. I have had medical issues relating to family history with blood disorders for 3 months, several blood test which were not sent to the lab in time and the story goes on. The appointment system is a joke, a doctor will call you between 8-5pm. What about the people who work in call centres who need to request specific times as they have no other option?? Even when providing several hours I would be available in that day, it is still not possible?? EVERY SINGLE RECEPTIONIST LIES!!! Don’t trust them. As someone who works in the customer service industry in a call centre, I take time to ensure everyone I speak to feel heard and has a plan of action. This surgery is actually now medically neglecting me so who else are they doing it to? I will be writing a complaint against this surgery, if this doesn’t get me anywhere I will sue them and I have very limited funds to do so but all I care about is that they make adequate training for ALL RECEPTIONISTS or close down because they are terrible. If you can do anything, transfer to a new surgery. It’s not worth your time or health. To the receptionist reading this, try to be more empathetic or get a new job because this is people’s health at risk now!!!!!

reviews.author: Iris Cooper
reviews.text: The automated telephone line opens at 8.00 am prompt. At that point you are invited to join 'the queue' due to the 'high number' of calls they say they are receiving. You are told someone will call you back as soon as an operative is available... and instructed to stay close to the phone. You can then wait for up to 4 AND A HALF HOURS to advance to the front of the queue! Appalling and misleading system. It purports to be a dedicated/staffed switchboard but it clearly isn't - the place is short staffed and sadly, customer service is acutely lacking. I have had the misfortune to try and contact this surgery on two consecutive days - yesterday I waited almost 3 hours to speak to someone, before being let down badly with no promised information, help or advice being communicated to me before they closed in the evening. Today after being placed in the telephone queue at 8.00 am, I gave up and went into the practice in person in order to make sure the needs of my elderly father are met. If it wasn't for the personal loyalty he has given to this place over many years, I would have no hesitation in registering him elsewhere. I have reluctantly given this review one star - the bare minimum in order to successfully make this post.

reviews.text: Dr admin outstanding with his supportive team in the background and receptionist he's turned this doctors round single handed there was always at least 3 doctors here, but now there's only 1 doctor Dr admin who doing it all himself, through no fault of his own but the NHS as it is, replaced 3 doctors with one top quality doctor yes its hard to get an appointment but when you do Dr admin is outstanding in his class his patients wellbeing and there health and care is much better than when you seen the older doctors every time I've got to see him I've got top treatment with his fresh approach in getting you better not just pain free but restoring your quility of life Dr admin doing it on his own working long hours and a little support from a locum when ever possible, but it's always first class treatment from him and he's always at the end of the phone if you need any help or advice he's a breath of fresh air, serving up quality every time, he isn't the problem because you can't get an appointment that's the N H S he's only one man doing the job of 3 support him and let's keep this exceptional doctor

reviews.text: Extremely careless staff. Long waiting hours, doctors give wrong named blood labels, practicioners book wrong appointment, receptionist have no clue if the doctor is in the surgery or not. Also, I had to book all my son's immunizations myself he was long overdue with no acknowledgement from the surgery. Pathetic place.

reviews.author: Ellie A
reviews.text: I’ve never known a phone line like it. I’ve been with this practice almost all my life but haven’t visited in well over 5 years, and no doubt am not going to anytime soon. I’ve been constantly left on hold while desperately trying to book a simple appointment. The standard waiting time when ringing up is 25mins (if you’re lucky) while you have an average of 6-7 people apparently ahead of you in the queue. But I often give up. That’s not even remotely acceptable. I’m currently in work, and have been on hold for another 37mins after their automated line rang me back to inform me I was at the front of the queue. The reception I get when I finally get through is almost always shockingly rude and short with me, even though I keep my agitation to myself. I honestly couldn’t tell you what the staff are like inside the clinic, considering I can never seem to get an appointment.

reviews.author: Louise Griffiths (LJ)
reviews.text: Rang this practice to ask if they are taking on more patients. What an experience, 4 in the queue and got to number 1 after 30 minutes, then 30 minutes later NOTHING!! No reply. 60 minutes wasted with no reply. Appalling and the worst reception system ever with music designed to make you go insane whilst waiting!! Avoid like the plague. Why is it so difficult these days to find a good doctors practice that is my concern!

reviews.author: L Chan
reviews.text: Was my childhood Doctor, but my parents still with them. They have undergone a lot of changes. But when you eventually get through the reception and admin staff are helpful. Dr Amin is especially exceptional. He sensitively looked after my Dad through a bad time and took the time to make sure he was looked after.

reviews.text: They say you can call to book an appointment but they keep you in hold for up to 30 mins and sometimes they dont even pick up.

reviews.author: Jake Bowen
reviews.text: Been my family doctor since iv been a kid onwards and it's gone right down hill! Massive issue with booking appointments minimum wait if you're under the age of 60 is about two-three weeks No consistent GP to see to you so your medical history needs to be recited like a Bible passage to every changing doctors. Lastly be sure to get second opinions I had to basically beg for a prescription to be made for serious back injury I took whiles working and ended up going to a walk-in and getting it in an hour sorted.

reviews.author: Shaddow Flame291
reviews.text: Very poorly organised. Had previous problems with this place but today took the it to a stupid level. Due to the incompetence of the Dr's at this surgery, I ended up having to visit both the surgery 3 times and the pharmacy twice in the same day. The Dr's had mis-dated my prescriptions, sent the wrong ones to the pharmacy and because of their mistakes I had to spend 2 1/2 hours travelling between my house, the surgery and the pharmacy on an injured foot, all for 4 tablets to last me a grand total of 2 days. Instead of getting my weekly tablets. meaning ill have to go through all this again in 2 days time. The journey used to only take me 30 mins, to go to my Dr's, actually see a Dr, go to the pharmacy, get a prescription and get home. All i needed today was to pick up a prescription that they had sent to the pharmacy electronically and return home, I didn't even see a Dr. Therefor for it to take 2 1/2 hours being driven to each place, due to my injury, i feel is extremely unacceptable. I am currently thinking about changing Dr's now as they seem to be causing more and more problems and delays as time goes on.

reviews.author: Satisfying Posts
reviews.text: Can never get appointments n they never answer the fone

reviews.author: Ліна Сафрановська
reviews.text: Today I came to my appointment with my three-month-old baby, which was scheduled for 3:00 pm. Despite having a confirmed appointment time, I had to wait almost 50 minutes while holding my baby. Adult patients were being called in before me, and it was completely unclear how the schedule and appointments were being managed. I am very disappointed with the attitude and the overall organisation of the service. Our vaccination appointments have also been rescheduled several times, which creates additional difficulties for us as new parents. I kindly ask you to review the organisation of appointments for patients with young children and ensure that scheduled times are respected, as situations like this cause significant discomfort and concern. Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Thanks for taking the time to leave a review. I am sorry to hear that you had to wait some time for your appointment which had been rearranged a few times. Unfortunately, we have had some unplanned staff absence. We covered it as best we could with locums, however sometimes locums run behind due to being new to a surgery. Whilst this information does not excuse the lateness and rescheduling of your appointment, I am hoping that it has highlighted that sometimes despite doing our best, things can go off plan. I am sorry the situation caused you discomfort and pain. If you would like any more information or would like to discuss it in further, please get in contact with me. Alex - Practice Manager

reviews.author: Rosi Hunter
reviews.text: The irresponsible behaviour and code of conduct has come to the point that now the A&E has urged them to look at my child and make sure that she is ok because yesterday when I called they didn’t take seriously and operator was complete nonsense thats why I had to take her to A&E. She had been there all day and night under constant care and they were also disappointed by the eastlands medical practice behaviour and urged me to put a complaint on nhs website so that other people should not suffer. Actions speak louder than words. You can imagine through the reviews and the amount of disappointments. It is not just me. Look into it. Open your eyes please if you have little once try to stay away from this place. Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Hi Rosi, Thank you for sharing your concerns. I am sorry to hear about your experience. Our admin team triage all incoming calls and online consultations. Our policy is that children and other vulnerable patients who require urgent triage are passed to a clinician for on the day review. If you could contact me directly regarding this incident with some more information to enable me to investigate, I would be most grateful. Thanks Alex - Practice Manager

reviews.author: Abigai Rowsendale
reviews.text: The worst GP practice i have known since 2006 in the whole UK. The operator on the phone is useless. First they do not answer the call secondly when they want to answer they just want to be possessive and want to be your boss. Absolute stupidity. I do not believe they have any qualification because people equipped with proper knowledge and training does not speak with that tone of voice and insecurity. Our admin team are trained to triage incoming calls and online queries to ensure the most appropriate action is taken. I completely understand how this might come across as unhelpful, but I assure you our intention is to support you as best we can. If you would like to contact me directly I can look into this for you. Alex - Practice Manager

reviews.author: Tilly
reviews.text: I normally abstain from proving negative feedback but this is definitely overdue. I’ve always had no issue with the receptionist team but during today’s call the receptionist that answered the phone was rude, impatient and dismissive. Furthermore, some doctors put the wrong information on the ‘NHS app’ and if you challenge that you are welcomed by a receptionist that doesn’t want to be there nor provides the appropriate information. If things don’t get better will probably find another practice. Be mindful when you register here as the patient care sometimes can be lacking .

reviews.author: leah white
reviews.text: I cannot praise this surgery enough, the receptionists are amazing, ive experienced some difficult situations with doctors and getting appointments for my autistic daughter, but they go above and beyond here, they actually listen and dont just rush u off the phone. When my daughter was poorly and I called at 11am they got me in for 5.30 and was considerate of the fact that she probably wouldn't like to wait due to her autism. They then called me back and said they had had a cancellation and to bring her in at 12. The doctors are lovely and are really good with her as she loves doctors and medical things so they really engage. Not the average surgery and I would highly recommend.

The only negative is being asked is it an emergency as I think if it’s an emergency I’d ring 999.

reviews.author: Fadi PCM
reviews.text: Rude staff, unfriendly at all, inexperienced and a very poor service, when you go to the practice its not busy and almost empty in many cases, but when try to book an appointment they will give you after weeks, I believe the staff trying to reduce the number of patients so they don’t work more, but to be honest the doctors who are working there are excellent. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Good afternoon Fadi, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review of our practice. I would like to firstly assure you that none of our staff are trying to reduce the number of patient appointments. This is not something our administration staff have access to do nor do they have the motive. Unfortunately, the current demand for appointments does not meet capacity. This a problem across the country. The number of appointments we offer per day is in line with national guidance. Whilst our waiting room may have seemed empty during your visit, our GP's have many tasks to carry out throughout the day to ensure our patients get the right care. As well as face to face/telephone consultations, they have lots of administration to carry out such as prescriptions, referrals, communications with other services etc. I am sorry you felt our staff were rude and unfriendly. Please contact me at the practice with some more information and I can investigate this incident. Alex - Practice Manager

reviews.author: Asif Bashir
reviews.text: Thank you for leaving a 5* review for our surgery. All feedback is appreciated and its good to know that our hard work is valued. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for leaving a 5* review for our surgery. All feedback is appreciated and its good to know that our hard work is valued.

reviews.author: Janet Brindley
reviews.text: Awful reception staff. Not sure what their purpose is, aside from sitting behind a window and eating, as they can't make appointments, and may as well be replaced by AI, which would probably provide a more human experience. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. Whilst its disappointing to receive 1 star, feedback is always appreciated. Our reception team is dedicated and hardworking, performing numerous essential tasks that may not always be visible. They are continuously multitasking and often working on multiple behind-the-scenes activities that contribute significantly to our daily functions. Occasionally, a receptionist may appear to be being difficult when in fact they are just following guidelines/rules set out by the clinical team. It is imperative that those guidelines/rules are followed to ensure that all 5700 of our patients get the best care we can offer. Please do contact me if you would like to discuss this issue in further detail. Alex – Practice Manager

reviews.text: they give out wrong information, you can’t get an appointment they tell you to ring back at 8am and you still can’t be given an appointment, they lie to you, medical negligence and this will be getting taken further Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Good morning Ellie, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. reviews.text: Absolutely shocking. Avoid at all costs. It took them a year to respond to my request on their website. They need to be investigated by the authorities. reviews.author: Ian Shakeshaft
reviews.text: Been a patient at this practice for over 30 years, in the past i have always had good service and always found the staff and doctors - friendly, professional and helpful. During and since Covid the service has deteriorated DRAMATICALLY! Covid wasn't my fault, had all my inoculations and followed all the rules - why did the service levels chang??? A lot of people have trouble with modern technology and should not be EXPECTED to 'do things on line'!??? Sadly now trying a new Surgery. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Good afternoon Ian, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I am saddened to read that you feel our service has deteriorated since the Covid 19 pandemic. General practice has changed quite significantly since the pandemic and whilst we do encourage the use of online services, we appreciate that this is not for everyone. Our telephones lines are open between 8am and 6pm Monday to Friday and our practice door is open for those patients who prefer to make an enquiry at the front desk. GP appointments are telephone consultations in the first instance with face to face being offered if required. However, if patients feel a face to face is more suitable then this can be accommodated. Since the pandemic, patient demand has increased considerably and as a neighbourhood, we have worked together to put extra services in place such as extra appointments during the evenings and weekends, video consultations with an external provider, appointments with First Contact Practitioners, Pharmacists and other healthcare professionals. I would be more than happy to hear more about your recent experiences with our practice and I am available if you want to get in touch. Alex Jones - Practice Manager

reviews.author: James Sheppard
reviews.text: The practice is dominated by a do nothing & ignore you reception. They mess up my medications routinely, and ignore requests to correct it from myself & pharmacist week after week. You have to lose your rag, dedicate a day to going there and insisting on seeing a doctor for them to stop gaslighting you & sort it out. The appointment policy enforced by rude, obtuse dismissal is: phone every minute from 8.30am for appointment roulette, and if by the time you get through at 9.30 or 10 there isn't an appointment that day, you either wait for 3 weeks, play roulette tomorrow or go to a&e. It doesn't matter if a Dr told you to come back a week later if the agonising pain didn't go, the policy is to overload A&E instead of treating you with respect & empathy. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hi James, Thank you for your review of the practice. I am disappointed to learn that you feel this way. As you know, we have recently spoken and the medication issue has now been rectified. Please do not hesitate to get back in touch with me if you feel you have further complaints. As with the medication issue, we can hopefully offer you a resolution. If you don't already use the NHS App, it may be useful to know that you can make appointments, request prescriptions and view your health record via the app. You can also get in touch via the online triage section on our website. Many patients find this to be a useful way of getting in touch with the practice and avoid queuing on the telephone during busy periods. Kind regards Alex Jones Practice Manager

reviews.author: Laura Olchawa
reviews.text: Do NOT go to Dr Kanakanti!! Here’s some reasons: I come regarding some mental health problems a few years back I was not helped and listened to one bit and told to go on a walk! My young brother during lockdown got very sick with a throat infection to the point he couldn’t breathe and was suffocating himself, she told us to wait for the antibiotics to kick in! She prescribed my 3 WEEK OLD BABY eye drops for conjunctivitis and before giving them to him I read the box and it said DO NOT use for children under 2 YEARS OLD! I confronted her about this and she said this doesn’t matter 😂. I had just phoned in order for her to help my other son with his mental health, how to deal with situations, and to boost his confidence up and she told me he needed a referral from his school headteacher to book an appointment with her! This is ridiculous, he’s been suffering for months and had plenty of teachers tell us to book an appointment but she didn’t want to help him! To top it all off she’s always extremely extremely rude to every member of our family so I guess she does this to everyone! Only person she actually listens to is my father!!!! Absolutely ridiculous this woman should of never become a doctor!!!! Only time that this was a good GP practice was when one of the doctors had someone taking over! These are absolutely shambles, have you in the room for 30 seconds because they clearly cannot be bothered!!! Please save your patience and do not go to this doctors!!!!!!! Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Good afternoon Laura, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I can see from your review that you have some issues with our practice. I am unable to discuss the issue about your brother with you however I would be more than happy to discuss the issues about you/your children. Please contact me via telephone or through our practice email (gmicb-mh.eastlands@nhs.net) and we can look into each of your complaints. I would like to assure you that Dr Kanakanti and the rest of our team do our very best to help each of our patients get the best care available. What may seem like an unwillingness to help from your perspective will often be something out of our control. Alex Jones - Practice Manager

reviews.author: J B
reviews.text: I have used this surgery since I was a child. I've always found the Doctors very caring & understanding. The nurses are lovely, especially Nurse Cath - she is very knowledgeable & supportive. I feel that Amna on the reception team will always go the extra mile to help me, she has been great. Sometimes I do find it hard to make an appointment, especially short notice on the same day, but I think this is a common problem at most doctors surgeries across the country at the moment. I have been able to make them for a few weeks later if my problem isn't urgent. However, my daughter has health problems & learning disabilities and she does always get an appointment very quickly when she needs one - even on the same day, which is fantastic for both of us. Thank you

reviews.author: sally perkins
reviews.text: I have been with this practice all my life and when the new surgery was open it went downhill. Not being able to get appointments. Repeat prescriptions late. Could not get passed the receptionists. I had a serious illness and was in a lot of pain at the time. I stopped going because it stressed me out so much. I had a nurses appointment today and also needed to see a doctor but wasnt an emergency. How things have changed. New Team new perspective. I was given an appointment there and then to see the doctor while I was there. I just want to say the receptionist was excellent and how happy I am that things are back to how it used to be at the old surgery. My faith has been restored. What a lovely team.

reviews.text: I have been a patient with this practice since moving to Manchester in 2017 and I have been so well looked after ever since. I recommend them to anyone who needs a reliable GP service. Thank you for all of your hard work. Makeda Mills

reviews.author: zee b
reviews.text: Been a patient here since birth. This used to be a great practice. These days I dread contacting and feel like nobody cares anymore. I’ve had to log several complaints in the last few years, regarding both process and attitude of staff. Staff are so unhelpful and obtuse, rude and condescending. Especially the receptionists but right through to practice mangers and general staff. It’s only the doctors and nurses who have any care (if you’re lucky enough to get get an appointment). Receptionists are rude, quick to presume, over talk you, not listen, have a “can’t do” attitude, fob you off and treat you like the enemy at the gates, even when they’re in the wrong. You have to fight to get looked after and the care you expect. Even if they don’t know something you’re enquiring about; Rather than asking or endeavouring to find out, the modus operandi for them is to fob you off, get you off the phone, Tell you to ring 111 or some other website. Even when you’re trying to explain they misunderstood something, they over talk, shut you down and then threaten you with hanging up the phone! I dread to think what service less persistent patients than I would get. I actually dread having to ring them and it makes me stressed and upset at the worst time (when ill) not feeling like a patient and more of a burden. Avoid this practice at all costs unless you enjoy an argument and dealing with constant complaints with NHS England. Sad to see how this has changed for the worse.

reviews.author: Fallon Piper
reviews.text: This has been my practice for 13 years and since first attending I have watched it deteriorate. Reception staff are extremely rude, so rude that I have avoided trying to get an appointment even though I need to. Having to disclose to a receptionist what is wrong and for them to then relay this information back in a demeaning manner is just disgusting. Cath the nurse and 2 other doctors are fine but for me this place is one big let down, especially when you struggling with an illness and need help! UPDATE: Since Monday I have been trying to get in contact with the practice which I deem to be as an emergency. I then contacted them yesterday as the online form I filled in was apparently the wrong one as the texted me, to which I filled another form out today for the same issue to happen. Yesterday I was told abruptly why didn't I ring up if I had an issue! RUDE! So with this information I then phoned up this morning after being on hold to explain to which I was told don't know why your having problems when other forms have been sent over, which was made out to make me feel I was in the wrong when all I want to do is speak to the doctor! This is not the first time this receptionist has been condescending and rude towards me when you are meant to be holding yourself to a high standard as you are the receptionist. And because I did not want to disclose my issue was told to full in the form myself, I am entitled under the human rights act to not disclose any information I deem as personal and private, other practices do not work like this. Highly irritated and frustrated at the levels I have to go through just to get an appointment. I will be considering moving to a different practice now as I cannot deal with degrading attitudes, and coldness I have felt from this practice especially since we have been in the pandemic!

reviews.author: Maurizio Gasparro
reviews.text: Steer clear from this practice if you care about living longer. My experience with them is terrible and scary. This should be a zero star review, not even one. They keep saying that they will send me the referral since Feb 2023 but it never happens, to the point that I had to pay to go privately to get it sorted. This happened again about 6 years ago when they were reluctant in giving me a referral, I had to literally beg them and ONLY AFTER TWO YEARS I did finally get it and guess what? It was cancer, so I could have died. They are shallow, don't care about our health. Again, about 5 years ago I had another problem with my back, I couldn't even walk and this was a recurring problem. They kept telling me that there was nothing to do, just to get paracetamol and get some rest, until I got to the point that I couldn't walk for real, then only after 3 years FINALLY they prescribed an MRI and guess what (again)? I have a disease that needed urgent attention. Another one: about 6 years ago (maybe more) I went to see them because I was unwell, feeling tired and dizzy nearly faintish all the time and I remember it was warm weather like in May/June. The doctor didn't even visit me, just asked some questions like "do you drink enough water?" or "do you do sport?" "what do you eat?" etc... and then he just said "well, you have nothing, it's just the warm weather. Avoid fatty food and drink more water". 5 years later, where I kept feeling in the same way, finally, and only after the 10th visit where I was having constant banging headaches, another doctor FINALLY visited me, checked my blood pressure and (again) guess what? I have hypertension and needed medications. I risked a stroke or heart attack for 5 years!!! I've had enough of them now, I feel I'm a survivor, a lucky one but I can see that one day I won't be so lucky if I stay with them, so I decided to go somewhere else for a chance to live longer. As a foot note: the Nurses are absolutely fine. They are lovely and care about patients. I hope this review will help saving lives, because that's all about here.

reviews.author: Alfred Gregory
reviews.text: My wife has been a patient of this practice all her life, she is now in her fifty’s. Up until the practice moved to Lime Square, and sadly Doctors Saeed and Jamil left, she never had a problem with the practice, their procedures, or their staff. The doctors were always polite and helpful, even though their time was limited. You only have to look at the reviews on this page, to see that there has been a serious decline in the number of positive reviews for this practice, there is something seriously wrong when they fail to get the basics right!!! It was confirmed to me that if you raise your concerns too many times a practice can drop you from their patient list. If you have a concern, especially when it concerns your health, it should be addressed in a professional manner, you should not be made to feel that you are on borrowed time and that it would be in your interest to say nothing. In the last two years my wife has seen two doctors at this practice, i will refer to them as Dr U & Dr S. Two doctors who in my wife’s opinion could not be more different when it comes to their attitude. Unfortunately, she was recently informed that Dr U had left the practice. However, Doctor S. who I’m sure is a good Doctor, has been abrupt, rude, impatient, and confrontational with my wife, mainly because she expressed her concerns stemming from inconsistences within the practice. These inconsistences have the potential of causing serious issues when it comes to patient health and their medication. No Doctor knows everything that goes on within any practice, it is both arrogant and selfish to think otherwise. Issues • Request from pharmacy was not processed for five days. • Prescription not passed to driver (pharmacy) by reception staff for five days. • Prescription requested for three items. Prescription produced for only one, three-day delay (including weekend) before the other prescription was ready to be filled by the pharmacy. • Emergency home visit requested and refused, “we are too busy, there’s nothing we can do”! no further help was offered or suggested. This practice needs to employ staff that know what they are doing, it's no joke, some training is urgently needed! At the very least the reception staff should understand the procedure when it comes to a patients prescription. Before Christmas my sister over heard one of the reception staff say that they try not to book too many people in on a Friday so they have a quieter day! I don't know whether that is happening or not, but to even suggest such a thing is total unprofessional, who is in charge at this practice?

reviews.text: It's very appalling that I called in early in the day to get an appointment for an illness that has troubled me for two weeks as I explained to them, still called in around 3:50 pm to inform them of my expectation for appointment as I hadn't heard from them at the time. But they ended up not booking me for appointment. The doctor called me around 7pm saying that it will be next day. No sympathy, no compassion, no consideration that my critical condition has lingered for 2 weeks without medical attention. It wasn't a good experience at all and this is just one out of many. Besides, I don't think I've gotten any remedy from this gp regarding my health conditions, I'm afraid 😕 Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Hello Franklin, We’re sorry to hear about your experience and understand how frustrating it must have felt to have not had the appointment you requested. We do offer same-day appointments, and although the vast majority of our patients are seen on the day they contact us, very occasionally, appointments can run over, or patients may need to be scheduled for the following day if it is safe to do so - which was likely the case here. Please be reassured that if your condition had been critical, urgent treatment would have been arranged immediately. The fact that your appointment could be scheduled for the next day indicates your condition was stable and it was safe to do so. We also want to gently remind patients that if a condition feels critical, emergency services such as A&E should be contacted instead of the GP practice as we are not an emergency service that can deal with critical conditions. We know how frustrating it is to sit and wait in a phone queue in the morning. If you are able to, you can use our online form system which is available 24/7. I hope you will find this easier. We appreciate your feedback and hope you continue to feel supported by our practice as we strive to provide safe, compassionate care for all our patients. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.text: I have used Robert Darbishire Practice for a number of years. In recent years their triage arrangements have become very efficient, prompt and reassuring in the light of what I learn in the press about other practices. My online enquiries are dealt with on the same day by pre-arranged phone appointment (notified by email or text) from a relevant health practitioner - usually a GP - and advice provided by phone or by surgery visit. Their monitoring of my health conditions (annual health checks) have always been prompt. Data emerging from, for example, blood tests, are provided within one week and, where issues emerge (either from me or the GP) are dealt with by further telephone appointment. I feel fortunate to be a registered patient at this practice. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Hello Bob, Thank you so much for leaving such a positive review about the service you receive at The Robert Darbishire Practice. reviews.author: Saqib Javed
reviews.text: I am having a horrible experience with this surgery for some time now. In order to get a simple blood test done, I had two appointments cancelled by the surgery with a text message sent a couple of hours before the appointments citing staff absences/shortages. Finally, the test went ahead on the third occasion. On another occasion my 7 year old son was given appointment almost a month after I rang them to get a simple blood test. Finally, on the day of his appointment we were just 2 min late and the receptionists turned us away saying you are late and the nurse is very busy today. I asked her to speak to the nurse and she refused to do so saying "I know her answer already she wont see you". I am registered with this surgery for more than 10 years and never in my experience I was seen on time. The surgery is always running between 10 to 30 mins late into each appointment and the patients are supposed to wait until finally seen by someone. This is not fair on patients as the surgery expects them to wait for the doctor or the nurse when they are running late whereas if the patient is one minute late they don't bother to see us even if we are willing to wait. I don't see the logic in it. If I am two minutes late with a child that means someone else must be seen during my time slot then why can't I wait and be seen in the slot of the patient who is seen before his/her appointment. Technically speaking, from the 10 mins slot allocated to me I still had 8 minutes remaining and I know the blood tests only take 5 mins. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Hello Saqib, Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I am sorry to read that you are unhappy with the services that you and your family have received at the practice. As this a public forum, I cannot reply in detail to the issues raise due to data protection issues. But I am happy to investigate the points you raise if you would like to contact me securely via our online feedback form on our website https://rdp.org.uk/form/feedback/ Many thanks Debra Patient Complaints Officer

reviews.author: Νεφέλη Πάσχου
reviews.text: Extremely uncaring reception staff - aside from frequently experiencing issues with them being full (even if forms are filled in the morning), if you receive a phone call that you cannot take right then, chances are that you will miss your appointment entirely. The "doctors will call back" response I have received from reception if I call them directly is often a lie as well, as I have had to personally ring them back again due to not receiving a call back. I appreciate that the demand might be high and something might get overlooked, but giving misleading expectations should not be acceptable, and should at least be met with an apology when it happens. An example of missing an appointment was when I was in the toilet (due to the pain I was experiencing from my issue), called back within 10 mins, and was met with a rude response and no alternative, just a "try again tomorrow". I almost always receive calls after 5pm no matter how early I fill in the form as well, which as you can imagine, makes scheduling hell and it is extremely difficult to ever be seen. It's at the very least disappointing to experience no sympathy or understanding from staff. Effort to help patients/introduce alternative appointment methods should be higher, especially since the form system clearly has tons of issues, and reliance on GP services is very high right now. reviews.text: The experience here has been nothing short of laughable. I booked two blood tests close to two months ago (both by the time the doctor asked for a retest), didn't hear anything back initially, booked the tests for me after I pressed again two days apart, but kept delaying in informing me of the results. As a result, today, three weeks after the day my blood was drawn, I was only informed of the results of one of the tests at my urging, while the other very important test was left out and not tested at all! I can't believe the standard of the receptionist here, who is responsible for my health? Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hello Ziqiu. Thank you for your review. I’m saddened to hear your experience with us has not been positive. When it comes to blood tests at the practice, it is the patients responsibility to get back in contact to gain their results, unless there is something significantly wrong that needs addressing immediately. This is told to you during your blood test appointment by the Health Care Assistant who takes your blood sample. To do this, you can either submit a test results form on our website, or when calling the practice, selecting option 3. Also, I feel like it is worth noting that is not our reception team who decide what blood tests you need or will be taken during your appointment. This will be added to your record by your doctor. Unfortunately, I am not able to add any more detail in response to your comment on this platform. This is because it is a public platform and to do so would breach your patient confidentiality. If you would like me to take a further look into this situation then please do fill in a feedback form on our website. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.text: Didn’t realize how bad it could be but I went to the doctor to ask about multiple things, (which they always do by phone first, which is really not the best.) and she cut me off and loudly said bye when I was trying to explain my situation and was not finished. We do operate a little differently to other practices by offering a telephone consultation first, and then if needed, patients are brought into the practice for a face-to-face appointment. reviews.author: Yu Yao Hao
reviews.text: Incompetent doctors… One doctor went to ask colleagues what my problem might be and what treatment should I have; another doctor searched online how to treat my problem right in front of me. I couldn’t believe how they became doctors if they knew nothing. I’ve never seen a doctor so unsure about patients’ problems and asking other doctors questions or searching online (which is something I can do by myself). All the time the treatments I received was unhelpful. They asked me to get different ointments for my skin problem again and again, none of them really treated my skin problem. I was just wasting a lot of money on those ointments. I JUST NEED A CAPABLE DOCOTR TO CORRECTLY DIAGNOSE MY PROBLEM AND PRESCRIBE THE MOST EFFECTIVE MEDICINE OR OINTMENT FOR ME. What’s wrong with the doctors I’ve met so far at this GP. I believe there is definitely a capable doctors here. I believe..maybe Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hello Yu Yao Hao. Thank you for your review. We appreciate any reviews we receive whether they be positive or negative as they help us to improve the service we offer to patients. Here at The Robert Darbishire Practice, we believe that collaboration is key. We have many doctors that have different specialities and encourage other doctors to call on them when they need help with treating a patient. We apologise that you’re unhappy with a member of our team getting a second opinion, but we believe that it better than leaving a problem untreated or offering the wrong solution. We also help to train budding doctors from the local University and give them the valuable first-hand experience of working in a GP surgery. When this happens, each trainee is paired with a qualified GP, and is expected to double-check their diagnosis and treatment with their mentor to ensure it is correct. There are many reasons why a doctor may search online for treatment options. This could be to find patient resources, to double check treatment plans or to check the medication is appropriate. Our team are highly skilled and highly trained, but with their being millions of conditions, diseases and illnesses, we would not expect our team to recall every single one and allow them to use proper resources should they need them. I think it is worth noting that some conditions take time to resolve, and many conditions are similar to others. Whilst we wish we were able to cure everyone immediately, that is not always possible, and it may take time to see results. We apologise you’re not satisfied with the service offered to you. If you would like to register with another GP service, you are able to find one close to you using the NHS website. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Naya Rehman
reviews.text: My mother has been a patient at this practise for years now. She has learning difficulties and suffers with mental health problems. She has had ADHD assessments and additional tests done to find out what her diagnosis was, she was told to hand in this paper work to the reception at the practise (before covid) they misplaced all these documents with all her initial assessments and results in there. Since then she has been on several different medications unsure of what it is actually tackling, she has gained weight due to the medication she’s been given. Her doctors have given her numerous numbers to call to redo them assessments and figure out on her own what she has - which she is still on waiting lists for. She doesn’t get a face to face review with her doctor regularly, only last year a mental health nurse rang her up, as it got extreme, however she’s been suffering with severe mental health her entire life. I’m 20 years old and struggle with my own mental health as I have been supporting my mother my entire life and have been on the other end of her episodes which she hasn’t received the right/enough support for. Wouldn’t recommend this practise especially if your suffering with mental health as it isn’t as prioritised.

reviews.text: System is disorganised and careless; staff are inconsiderate and passive-aggressive. It’s really disappointing that you feel the service we offer to patients is disorganised and careless. Please let me reassure you that is not the case, and our entire team works incredibly hard to support our community with their physical health, mental health and overall wellbeing. We are stretched at the moment with the demand for GP services being higher than it has ever been. Unfortunately, this does affect our appointments, and as a same day service means that appointments are usually full within the first few hours of opening. This is something we have been working on and have already implemented changes like adding on an extra 18 hours per week to our opening times. We are trying our best to treat as many patients as possible each and every day, within nationally set safety limits. However, if we do not have appointments left, this should always be communicated to patients, so we apologise if your requests were left unanswered. I’m saddened to hear about the situation you witnessed with the patient at the reception desk. This is something I would like to look into as this behaviour is not in line with our values or how staff members are expected to treat patients. If you would like to help me with this, please fill out a feedback form on our website with as much detail as possible. If you’re looking to move practices, there are many that cover the same/similar areas that we do. If you visit the NHS website, you are able to search practices by your postcode. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Vron Earp
reviews.text: Amazing practice! I've been supporting people, via a charity for 3 years, to access medical care, who have a range of challenges, including language barriers, and have never had a bad experience here. The staff have gone out of their way to show kindness, compassion and a willingness to support as much as possible The people I support to go to RDP tell me they receive good care under their GP. I would absolutely recommend anyone in the area to register here! Thank you RDP Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Vron, thank you very much for your lovely review. We're so glad that every experience you have had with our practice has been positive and that you'd recommend our services to anyone within the area. Our main focus as a GP practice is to treat every patient with care and compassion. We're passionate about creating a warm and welcoming space for patients to seek help and advice with their healthcare needs, so it's great this is what you've experienced when supporting patients. I have passed on your review to our entire team, I know they will all be very grateful for your kind words. Keep up the good work in supporting people in the community, and we'll do the same! Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Kayleigh Dickinson
reviews.text: Bad practise. Not welcoming at all. I know the NHS and GP practises are overworked but the level of care and compassion towards sick patients , and well patients for that matter, shouldn’t change. Doctors are rude and not nice and reception staff are blunt. As someone else stated, the best doctors and staff members have gone and I no longer feel comfortable attending appointments here. 3 of the best doctors here who understood me and my issues have left.m. Seems as though they left for the best, though. No nice and understanding doctors left. Utter disgrace of a doctors surgery and I encourage everyone to never sign up here and don’t even think about applying as a new patient. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hi Kayleigh, thank you for your review. I'm saddened to hear that the experiences you've had lately with the practice have been negative and that you feel our team are not compassionate towards patients. Please let me reassure you that we do care about patients, and we are constantly training our team on customer service and delivering their words with kindness and empathy. We really value your opinion and would like to hear how you feel we can make improvements to our service that would benefit patients. If that is something you would like to share, we would like to invite you to join our Patient Participation Group. This group is a group of people who are patients of the surgery and want to help it work as well as it can for patients, doctors and staff. They get together to bring different ideas to the surgery to help us treat patients better or to improve what we do in some way. If you would like to join our Patient Participation Group, fill out this form: https://bit.ly/3DIQQ4x. We are going to be hosting a meeting within the next few weeks and hope to see you then. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.text: Absolutely shocked how this place is still running with the reviews and it’s horrible service . As an NHS service, we are regularly audited by the Care Quality Commission (CQC) and have received an overall rating of Good. You can find the full report of the CQC findings on their website. reviews.author: Romi Morris
reviews.text: Indeed ! One of worst gp surgery in the country. If you go up to 5 minutes you will have to book another appointment. However they can make you sit hours and hours for your appointment. In another words THEY ARE ALLOWED TO MAKE MISTAKES BUT YOU CAN'T. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Romi. I'm sorry to hear that you feel we're the worst GP surgery in the country and that you're unhappy with the way we conduct appointments. Whilst we would like to give patients a long amount of time to discuss their issues, that is just not possible at the moment. This is because there has been a huge surge in demand for appointments since the pandemic, which has also been increased by the prevalence of winter illnesses that seem to be spreading around our community. However, we do allocate more than five minutes per appointment for each patient. Regarding waiting for hours for an appointment, I’m unsure if you’ve had a face-to-face appointment that you’ve been kept waiting for, or if you’re referring to a telephone consultation. I’ve not heard of patients having to wait for hours in the practice for an appointment but if that is the case please do let me know by filling in a feedback form on our website as that would be very concerning. If you’re talking about telephone consultations, we are unable to give exact time scales for telephone appointments as there are so many variables that may throw a specific appointment time off track. This could be an emergency appointment needing to be seen first, other patients not answering the doctors call, patients needing a bit of extra time to discuss their medical problems and more. When you book a telephone consultation, you should however be told to expect a call either in the morning or the afternoon. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.text: GP is non-existent. Filled the form to request appointment, they say there is no. Called them the second they open, they say no appointment left. reviews.author: Neethu Mathew
reviews.text: I was expecting a telephone call for my son after making appointment which took me 2days. But without calling they just popped a message stating” Unfortunately we haven't been able to reach you by phone. Please call reception to rearrange the appointment booked.” Which is so ridiculous, I called themback straight away and the receptionist stated doctor left home earlier. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Neethu. Thank you for your review. We're sorry to hear that you had a negative experience with us and that your sons appointment couldn't go ahead. With telephone consultations, we do operate a two call system. That means that if a clinician is unable to reach a patient on the first call, they will try again once more. If they are still unable to get in touch with a patient, the patient will be asked to rebook the appointment. We appreciate this may seem unfair, but with the extremely high demand for appointments, our team aren't able to dedicate the time to continuously call until they get through. Unfortunately, without knowing your son's name, I am unable to confirm if this was the case for you, or if the doctor went home earlier than originally planned. If you would like me to look into exactly what happened with your son's appointment, please do fill in a feedback form here: https://bit.ly/3WCApP4. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Nellight
reviews.text: The worst experience with any GP so far. It took them over 4 weeks to register me even though I already had an issue to deal with urgently. Then, the online form is broken and doesn't accept international phone numbers which makes it literally impossible to book an appointment through their website. I tried to call and after over 30 minutes in the queue three times I was either told to call back the next day or they simply hung up on me. They also have seem to forgotten my referral to a specialist which should have been done weeks ago. I am honestly just exhausted at this point. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Stickman. Thank you for your review. I'm sorry to hear that we've provided the worst experience you've had with a GP so far. We are located in the heart of popular Manchester student areas, and have received an unprecedented amount over registrations over September and October. Our team have been working very hard to get through these registrations, but the volume of registrations has meant that it has taken longer than we would have hoped to get patients onto our system. Thank you for pointing out the issue with international numbers and our online forms. We want every patient to be able to easily access healthcare so I will certainly get this looked into. We aren't able to control how many people are waiting in the telephone queue to get through to the reception team. Our reception staff members work very hard to get through the calls but if we have a lot of people calling, the queue can get very large. That is why we do encourage those who are able to use the online form system to do so. We are a same day only appointment service and it is ran on a first come first served basis (unless you require an emergency appointment). We aren't able to book appointments in advance and unfortunately, once the appointments for the day are booked, we aren't able to offer any more. I understand this can be really frustrating, but this means we are able to give patients the care they need when they need it and avoids patients having to wait for weeks at a time to speak to a doctor. Unfortunately, due to the public nature of this forum, I'm unable to comment on your referral or being hung up on. If you would like me to look into those issues for you, please do let me know by filling in a feedback form here: https://bit.ly/3fequhN Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Aiga Lorence
reviews.text: Don't waste your time with this practice! Go elsewhere! Went in today for my son to have his blood taken. Checked in at reception, been told to sit down. Sat down for minutes 10-15 before was called back to reception to book a new appointment?!?! They "book" you in and when you turn up they say there's no nurse available. Total waste of our time and money. This situation now happened twice! They tried to give us another appointment for tomorrow at 4.30 pm whilst they even don't take bloods after 4.30 pm!!! What a nonsense! Sitting there useless, wasting tax payer money whilst telling us, tax payers not to waste nhs money. Had to take an appointment during school hours to make sure my son finally gets his blood taken and tested. Not even sure there will be nurse available for our appointment. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Aiga. Thank you for your review. I was extremely concerned reading about your experience so wanted to take a look into this incident for you. To take the blood of minors, a nurse or health care assistant needs specialist training. We do have one staff member in the practice who is trained to take the blood of children. Unfortunately, due to an admin error, your son was booked in with the incorrect staff member who hadn't had the specialist training, which meant your appointment had to be cancelled. We do sincerely apologise that you weren't informed of this in advance, and that you came to the practice only to be turned away. We continually try our best to provide a high level of service to patients and acknowledge that on this occasion we let you and your son down. All staff members involved have been given further training to ensure this incident does not happen again. We hope in the future you will have a more positive experience with us here at The Robert Darbishire Practice. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Eron Ameen
reviews.text: This GP needs a lot of more improvements, when you want an appointment, they tell us do it online rather than book for us straight away over the phone, physical appointments almost don’t exist anymore! then the doctor rings us in unexpected time while we are busy. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Eron. Thank you for your review. We do encourage patients who are able to use the e-consult system to do so as this allows our reception team more time to help those patients who aren't able to use the internet. Our reception team also do not book appointments, they only request them - the same as when you submit an online form. A doctor or a nurse will then triage your request and decide what course of action is needed, whether that be a prescription, telephone consult or face to face appointment. Along with our e-consult system, we do also operate a telephone triage system. This means that all patients will be given a phone call first and if it's needed, will be invited into the surgery for a face to face appointment. We've found that telephone consultations have been really beneficial and have allowed patients to get the help they need from the comfort of their own home. We'll always try our best to call at a time that suits you but can't always guarantee this will happen as the demand for appointments is really high at the moment and we try and help as many people as we possibly can throughout the day. To make sure that patients do not miss their appointment, we also call twice throughout the day to reach you. If you aren't available at a certain point in the day, please make sure you let us know on your request so your doctor or nurse is clear on when they can and can't reach you. We do hope that in the future you will have a more positive experience with us here at The Robert Darbishire Practice. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Elspeth Woolsey
reviews.text: Go elsewhere. I'm exhausted with this Practice. I have ignored quite a few things but will be looking elsewhere as they could raise your blood rather than help. I'm not a fan of their online system (but that's my preference) and after waiting over 20mins, was then told to explain my symptoms online. When the doctor phoned she was completely fixed on previous blood tests I'd had done for my autoimmune condition and kept referring to those bloods even though I'd spoken to a specialist nurse about it and have an appointment regarding it later in the week. This is not the first time this type of response has happened and I'm sick of a doctors practice getting fixated on my autoimmune disease rather than the issue I've come with - I'm aware they could and can be related but it would be nice to have the issue investigated rather than just put under the umbrella of my auto-immune disease but she completely ignored me telling her ho my body had been feeling leading up the issue. I was, thankfully, prescribed medication (based on the previous time this happened - why they don't want to investigate it beyond ridiculous!), I asked for this to be sent to the pharmacy next to them and was asked "What's the name of that pharmacy"(?!?) I googled to tell her and she said she'd send the appointment there. I walked there during my lunch hour to be told they hadn't received it, went to the doctors and wait ed 5-10mins for the receptionist machine to load up before telling me it was at a different pharmacy!! (Again, not the first time they've done this this when I asked for it to be sent to this pharmacy!) The nurses are the best thing about this place but I'm fed up with the lack of care or interest from doctors - I'm aware of my body, so am also aware when something is not right. It might be good if you could listen to to your patients and go from there. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Elspeth. I'm sorry you've not had a pleasant experience with us and you feel that your medical problems are being ignored. We strive to offer the best service and care to patients and I'm saddened that you've not received this. I would really like to look into the issues you've been experiencing and to see if there are measures that can be put in place to ensure you have a more positive time when dealing with the GP's here at The Robert Darbishire Practice. If you care about your health - avoid this place Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Hello Brooklet2. Thank you for your review. We're sad to hear that you feel you can't get reasonable help and that any good doctor wasn't available for a second appointment. Whilst most of our doctors have been with us for some time, we do also take on trainee doctors for placements so they can gain the valuable experience needed to continue their career. These placements do only last for a few months, which is why you may have not been able to see the same doctor twice. We understand your frustration of having a telephone consultation, however, we have found that clinicians are able to diagnose most problems over the phone. If they can't, they will bring patients in for an examination in the practice. Having telephone consultations also allows doctors and nurses to treat more patients in a day, which is a better use of resources and ensures more patients get the help they need. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.text: The receptionists and admin team are absolutely useless and are a disgrace! I've been trying to register my father as a temporary patient as he was running low on his medication. Yesterday I had to ring the practice 4 times as one of the receptionists simply hung up. My father had a stroke last year and he took his last tablet this morning. I will make a complaint to PHE,NHS or whoever you complain to. AVOID if you can. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Hello Pako. Thank you for taking the time to post this review and to give us some feedback. I’m sorry that you feel our reception and admin teams are completely useless and that you’ve been struggling to register your father with us. At the moment, we are experiencing a very high amount of new registrations here at The Robert Darbishire Practice, and have received around ten times the amount last month that we would get in a usual month. Unfortunately, our admin team have to manually work through each application to add them onto our system, which I’m sure you appreciate can take a lot of time. Please let me assure you that they are working as hard as they can to get through all of the applications and any delay you’ve experienced is not because they’re ignoring new patients. If you would like to make an official complaint, please fill in a feedback form on our website and I would be more than happy to take a deeper look into this issue for you. You can find the form here: https://bit.ly/3mTDPMh Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communication Officer

reviews.text: avoid this GP by any means they have the worst receptionist who doesn't really care for patients and very rude as well. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Hello Daniel. Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review, we always appreciate any feedback we receive as it helps us to improve the service and care we offer to patients. I’m sorry to hear that you’re not happy with the behaviour of one of our receptionists, and that a GP refused to see a 2 and 4 year old child for a face to face consultation. I’m sure you’re well aware, but Coronavirus is still very much a part of our lives, and we want to make sure that we keep patients as safe as possible. Because of this, we first offer telephone consultations to patients, as we have found that most of the time problems can be diagnosed over the phone. From that telephone consultation, if a GP feels that the patient needs to be seen, they will invite them in for a face to face consultation. If your children were not invited in for a face to face appointment, it is likely that that a telephone consultation would have been deemed appropriate to find out the problem. Please let me assure you that throughout the entire pandemic, we still have been open and have been seeing patients for face to face consultations. Despite the rumours in the news, we have never been closed and have always been here to care for the community. If you would like to take this further, and would like me to investigate this incident, please fill out a feedback form here: https://bit.ly/3mTDPMh Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communication Officer

reviews.author: X
reviews.text: Using this practice almost makes it feel like you don't have a GP. It is completely unsuitable for anyone in work or study - to get any sort of appointment, you have to wait all day on a ringback from a doctor or nurse who wants a 10 second soundbite of your problem before deciding whether your issue is worthy enough to get an appointment. The receptionists refuse to give you a time for this ringback - it could be at any point during the day and if you miss it you've screwed. What if I am driving, at work, in a meeting, in the shower? Patients should not have to sit by their phones all day to receive basic medical care. On top of this, when you enter the waiting room it is crowded and often noisy and the staff are running late - I've sat there for 30 minutes on occassion and felt physically anxious as a result. Perhaps you could take on fewer patients (and make less money) but provide an accessible service so I feel like I can actually use the NHS? The only upside is that most of the staff I have encountered have been nice apart from a rude Nurse Practioner and GP.

But the last message related to an event in their practice that morning so then she suggested I block the messages from 'GPSurgery' which would also have blocked my own surgery.
