reviews.text: I had an extremely disappointing experience with this dentist. My appointment was 25 minutes long and I arrived 7 minutes late, due to the car park being full, having to find and pay for on-street parking, and arranging (and paying for) a babysitter to attend the appointment. I explained the situation clearly to the receptionist and asked for it to be relayed to the dentist. Despite this, the dentist showed no empathy or flexibility. After waiting six years to finally register with an NHS dentist since moving to Manchester, I was shocked to be told I would be taken off the register for being late once — something that, having worked in two dental practices myself, I have never known to be standard policy. What made the situation worse was the dentist’s behaviour: instead of speaking to me directly like a professional, he avoided the conversation entirely and hid behind a wall, while incorrectly claiming I was “over 10 minutes late.” This felt dismissive, unprofessional, and frankly inhumane. After such a long wait to access NHS dental care, this experience was incredibly upsetting. Patients deserve understanding, honesty, and basic respect — none of which were shown here.

reviews.author: Carla
reviews.text: I wish my first experience with a GP here in England would have been a better one, but this practice is appalling in all its aspects. To start with, somehow they never received my NHS number. It took me eight months of endless phone calls to convince a secretary to call the authorities. One of the secretaries I spoke with even gave me a number to call myself in order to ask for my NHS number. The lady that replied at the phone was shicked that I had been given this number, as the only people they speak with are surgery employees and not patients. As a result of this I couldn't get any type of referral for almost a entire year. Even when I finally did get my NHS number and asked for a referral, it never arrived. The doctor that sees me is incompetent at best. The few times I went in, she almost tried to convince me I was fine. Her behaviour was so dismissive that I almost felt like I had to justify myself for being sick. I started dreading getting ill and postponing the time I had to see a doctor because their uselessness almost started to scare me. Needless to say, it is impossible to get an appointment on the same day (or on the following days, for what it is worth) and if you do have something serious you might as well stay sick, or go directly to the hospital, because I doubt anything ever gets done here. I am sorry that such a surgery it is even allowed to stay open. They are an example of medicine at its worst.

reviews.author: Lucy Inch
reviews.text: Awful experience this morning at this practice. First of all they thought the best time to do a fire drill would be with a full waiting room and in the freezing cold and rain. Then when we came inside which was 10 minutes after my appointment was meant to be I checked my nhs app to see that my appointment had been changed to 10:45 without my knowledge or notification. There was a reason I booked it at 10:20 not 10:45. I have also never experienced this in the past but I assume it’s so they meet their key performance metrics around access and availability. Some clarity on this would be good and do not blame the fire drill as it was nearly 10 after I should’ve had my appointment when the fire drill was done. Then the nurse I saw basically just fobbed me off when my condition hasn’t improved at all in a week. I have been told to wait another week and come back if it doesn’t improve despite already waiting before I came in to see someone in the first place. Practice response date: a month ago Practice response: Dear Honey Thank you for taking the time to leave us with a review. We are very sorry to hear that you were unhappy with your experience at the practice today. Fire drills are a mandatory safety requirement for healthcare organisations and are carried out to ensure the safety of our patients and staff in the event of a real emergency. Unfortunately, they cannot always be scheduled at convenient times. However, for clarity, I was l also part of the drill, and can confirm that it took place in dry conditions and was completed as quickly as possible to minimise disruption. From start to finish the exercise took 2 minutes and 30 seconds. We apologise if the evacuation caused a slight delay to your appointment. During unforeseen disruptions such as safety drills or emergencies, appointments may run behind. For clarity, we never change times to meet any form of a KPI, and without further context or patient details to investigate, I am unable to comment further on this. Regarding your clinical consultation, our clinicians aim to provide safe, evidence-based care and will advise follow-up based on clinical assessment and national guidance. We are sorry if you felt your concerns were not fully addressed. If your symptoms have not improved or you remain worried, we would strongly encourage you to contact the practice so we can review this with you. We take all feedback seriously and are always looking to improve our service. If you would be willing to discuss your experience further, please contact the practice directly so we can fully investigate the concerns raised and support you appropriately. Yours faithfully Mrs Lesley Hyde Practice Business Manager

reviews.author: Sydney Lyons
reviews.text: Had to drop off a sample to be sent off and so I arrived at 6pm (half an hour before closing!) and was told they wouldn't take it as samples had already been sent off that day. There is 0 guidance anywhere that suggests what time they send samples off. Since it was a Friday night, I'd now have to repeat the sample due to it being time sensitive with the practice being closed over the weekend, before I could even walk back in to request more pots upon realising this, the staff had locked the practice door on me claiming they were closed, probably because they couldn't be bothered having someone walk in where they've already cleaned. Furthermore, my condition I've been visiting about causes me unbearable pain which the practice won't even prescribe pain killers for. Practice response date: 2 months ago Practice response: Dear Sydney Thank you for taking the time to provide feedback regarding your recent experience at the practice. I am sorry to hear about the distress and frustration this caused you and appreciate the opportunity to respond. My name is Lesley Hyde and I am the Practice Business Manager and part of my role is to monitor and investigate any concerns or complaints made to the practice. Please se below my response to the issues you have raised: Sample Collection Arrangements We apologise for the inconvenience caused when you attended the practice to drop off a sample at 6pm and were advised that it could not be accepted at that time. We understand how frustrating this must have been for you. For clarity, samples must be received by the practice by 4:00pm to ensure they can be included in the scheduled daily laboratory collection at 4:30pm. Samples received after this time cannot be accepted, as they may not be stored within the required conditions and timeframes set by the laboratory. Accepting samples outside of these parameters risks inaccurate or invalid results, which could affect patient care and safety. We do have a poster displayed in our reception area outlining the sample cut off time; however, we acknowledge your feedback that this information may not have been sufficiently visible prior to your visit. As a result of your comments, we have now placed additional signage on our front entrance door and updated our practice website to make sample submission times clearer and more accessible. You can view this update here: https://www.thearchmedicalpractice.co.uk/practice-information/sample-collection/ Our clinicians usually advise patients of the relevant sample drop off times when issuing sample pots. If this did not occur in your case, we sincerely apologise. We have reminded all clinical and reception staff of the importance of clearly communicating sample cut-off times to patients to help prevent similar situations in the future. Access to the Practice Building We are sorry that you felt unable to re-enter the practice and that this added to your distress. For staff safety reasons, when a receptionist is working alone at the front desk and their colleague is temporarily required elsewhere, the front door may be placed on a buzzer system. In these circumstances, patients are still able to gain access by pressing the buzzer and would be let in by a member of staff. We regret if this was not clear at the time and if it appeared that the practice was closed earlier than advertised. I can assure you however, the practice was still open. Pain Management and Ongoing Care We are sorry to hear about the level of pain you are experiencing. Prescribing decisions, including pain relief, are made by clinicians based on individual clinical assessment and current medical guidance to ensure patient safety. A GP would only prescribe “pain killers” if they felt there was a clinical indication to do so. If your symptoms are persisting, then I would encourage you to arrange a further appointment with a clinician so that your pain and ongoing symptoms can be reviewed again. Next Steps We take all feedback seriously and are grateful that you have brought these matters to our attention, which has already led to improvements in how we share information with patients. If you would like your concerns to be investigated further under the NHS complaints procedure, or if you wish to discuss my response further, please contact me at the practice (0161 226 0606). We are always looking for new members to join our PPG, if you would like further information of if you are interested in joining is, please click the below link: https://www.thearchmedicalpractice.co.uk/practice-information/patient-participation-group/ Yours faithfully Mrs Lesley Hyde Practice Business Manager

reviews.author: Lea Shaughnessy
reviews.text: This is the first GP I've really loved being with, and as someone with multiple chronic conditions I couldn't praise them highly enough. This does mean I have experience with many Drs which can make communication easier for me, but I find all the team here perfectly reasonable. I also will say you must request appts through the app at 8 am as is generally standard, but no phone waits. I have had multiple conditions diagnosed here that are infamously under-diagnosed and ignored, for example especially with regards to female hormonal health. These are conditions I have spent up to 10 years visiting GPs about and bring turned away. The even use local anaesthetic for IUD insertions, before I requested! I have never found any of the doctors here dismissive. I've seen Dr Kandola, Dr Chaudri, Dr Hamza, Dr Collabella, Dr Chhoangalia, Dr Cooper, maybe even more. But I could not highly enough praise Dr Kidd. Both the care she offered and bedside manner were far above standard, and made some pretty horrific experiences absolutely tolerable. She does not sugar-coat either, she is truthful about what is uncomfortable and helps you get through it. Hailey Daniel has been fantastic to see as well. Both these staff have been very thorough to answer my questions and make sure my consent is informed. My meds get regularly reviewed. I get contacted about my necessary jabs. Script refills are done VERY promptly through the app too. The standard of GP receptionists in England seems to be dire, but I've always found those at the Arch to be pleasant and as helpful as they can given the NHS systems in place. They also have an option where you can keep your place in the phone queue for a callback, which I find great. I may often wait 10 mins for my appointment, again a factor of NHS conditions I believe. For Christ's sake they give out free fruit, I don't think they could do better if Jesus himself came down to heal the sick. Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Dear Lea Thank you for taking the time to leave us with such a wonderful and detailed 5* review. We pride ourselves on the service we deliver to our patients and it is reassuring to us when we receive such positive feedback, as it confirms that our patients really do feel we are doing a good job. I have shared your review with our practice team. Yours sincerely Lesley Hyde Practice Business Manager

reviews.text: From my experience the doctors in this surgery are hit and miss in terms of your care. It is like a lucky dip you could get someone really good or someone not that good, one doctor in the past smirked and laughed when I was being serious talking regarding my mental health with them and that wasn't very encouraging experience, but on other occasions I've seen really good doctors in the surgery where I've left feeling good. And some of the receptionists can be rude and not caring, and don't know correct information as recently I've had one of them tell me in a condescending tone that they do not do something in a certain way but I knew for a fact they can do as someone I know had emailed them earlier that day for me regarding the situation so I told the receptionist to go and check the emails and they came back on the phone after checking and they didn't have that rude condescending know it all tone anymore as they probably felt a bit silly once they knew I was right, so sometimes it's hard to trust what they say is correct. On another occasion I was told I would be able to get a doctors letter regarding a personal issue and I was asked to pay 30 pound to have the doctor type up the letter for me, the letter was supposed to take up to 4 weeks so 1 day before the 4 week timeframe was up I contacted the surgery to see what is going on and I was told the doctor can't do the letter anymore, they can do the letter if they wanted to as I know of other people that have had the same letter done by a doctor, but why take the payment from me for the doctor and then why does It take 4 weeks to tell me the doctor can't do the letter, surely I could of been told that a lot earlier and if I didn't chase them up they wouldn't of even contacted me within the 4 weeks timeframe I was told I would receive the letter by. This surgery could be doing better training with the receptionists to have better manners and be more mindful when speaking to people, and maybe get some better doctors so that every doctor is good and there is more consistency in the care of patients so it's not as hit and miss... And you state in your most recent reply to this review that you've replied to my 'reviews' many of times and they are always changing, as if you are trying to make out I'm lying and I'm making numerous separate reviews, I can guarantee this is the only review I have made and I have only edited this review to correct spelling errors etc that I have noticed, you have replied to this review twice not many of times like you said. I can assure you everything I have said in this review is true. I hope things improve with the surgery in the future as it's my local surgery and I don't like going anywhere else as there is some good doctors and staff at the Arch Medical Practice. Thanks for listening. reviews.author: Liam
reviews.text: Impossible to get an appointment. Despite what is claimed below. I have since changed to a different surgery. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Hi Liam Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. I am sorry that you feel we only deserve a 1* rating. One of the things we pride ourselves on is how accessible we are here at The Arch, therefore I am surprised to read that you find it "impossible to get an appointment". As of today, at 9:31am, we still have over 20 GP appointments free to book (including via the NHS app). Mon-Fri 8am - we release appointments which can be booked via the NHS app. These remain bookable all day long until the appointments have all been taken. Most days we still have appointments free to book until late morning. Mon-Fri 12pm - we release appointments which can be booked via the NHS app, these are for 6 days in advance. We have lots of other services which too can be booked via the NHS app such as physiotherapy and symptomatic sexual health checks (which remain available to book all day long). Mon-Fri 8am to 6:30pm you can submit a request via our online service where we can offer you advice and guidance, you can also submit admin requests for letters, sick notes, forms to be completed etc via this method: Contact us about your request (accurx.nhs.uk) Mon-Fri 8am to 6pm we operate a duty GP list, this means we never turn away elderly, vulnerable, mental health, chronic disease, palliative patients and we always see children up to the age of 14, regardless of the time the patient contacts us. We also have extended access appointments available in the evenings and weekends and currently they too have not been used at maximum capacity. If you cannot use the NHS app for any reason, you can of course call us, however we believe that if a patient can use social media then there should be no reason for them not to use the NHS app. You can also visit the practice if for any reason you cannot call us or use our online platforms. It is important for us to keep the phone lines free for our elderly and vulnerable patients who simply cannot use the NHS App. I would reach out to you to directly to discuss how you can easily book appointments here at the practice, however I am unable to trace you on our system. Please can I ask that you contact me as soon as possible on 0161 226 0606 so that I can try to understand this issues you have encountered and if indeed this is a review for the correct practice. I look forward to hearing from you. Many thanks Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.text: Positive: I was amazed by how efficient my treatment was from the referral to the hospital my procedure happened within 2 months of seeing the doctor here. It has changed my life and I am forever thankful to these fantastic GP's. Wonderful reception team too, absolutely smashing job these ladies do and they are super respectful and communicate with compassion. Negative: Recently, I needed some follow up tests for another illness and you didn't carry out what you said you would over the phone. I was a little bit disappointed I wasted my trip, but I hope that's just a one-off communication error. If bloods, ECG and observations can't be done in one appointment slot, then please tell me prior the doctor making this appointment on my behalf. I dont live local, so it's not easy for me. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Dear Adam Thank you for taking the time to leave us a 4* review - we really do appreciate it. It is wonderful to read that you have had such a positive experience with our staff and that you see what an amazing job they do. I will be sure to share your feedback with the whole team. I would really like to discuss with you in more detail about the tests which were not carried out in one appointment for you, please could I kindly request for you to call me at the practice on 0161 226 0606 so that I can get some further information from you? Many thanks Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

I am so pleased to read that you are managing your health needs successfully with the support of our amazing team. I will be sure to share your feedback. Many thanks Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.text: Dear management I am writing this review just because of the Hero that is working as a GP in your practice. Dr Collabela is not just a doctor, he is more than doctor I have ever seen in my life. he is so helpful, patient, knowledgeable, compassion with patient, really on time and so on, if he was not helping me God knows where I was, he is not hero by word, he is doing by action, all I want recognition of his sacrifices and we need this type Doctors. reviews.author: abigail webb
reviews.text: Paid £50 pounds for a form that can only be completed a doctor. Handed it in months back and still was not complete. Asked for another form to be submitted, again waited more than 2 weeks to and still waiting. I will be taking this further. They say that they have a deadline and are busy with patients, which I sure they are but that is not my fault. If you charge £50 pounds for a bits of writing then I expect it to be done asap. Practice response date: a year ago Practice response: Hi Abigail, Thank you for taking the time to review our practice. I am sorry that you are unhappy with the wait times for your private forms to be completed. We are a NHS practice and the work which you are asking us to do does not fall under our GMS contract, therefore it is classed as private work. Private work has to be done in a GP's own time as we would be in breach of our contract if we did this in our core hours. Due to this, there will always be a delay. We do however aim to get private work completed within 4 weeks. I do not want to reply to the specifics of your review however, on reviewing your notes, the timescale you specified of "months" is indeed inaccurate. Our priority will always be our NHS work as this is what we are commissioned to do, therefore you can take your form to a private GP and we would be happy to provide you with a brief summary to support your request. I would make you aware that the cost of such form via a private GP would likely be more than £50 however, you may well receive it quicker. If you would like to discuss this further then please do not hesitate to reach out to me at the practice (0161 226 0606). Many thanks Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.text: Had a very pleasant appointment with Dr. Zafar. He diagnosed the issue promptly. The receptionists is very polite and the overall experience was really nice. reviews.author: Катя Которая не катит
reviews.text: This is just a disgusting clinic, not only do you have to do it at 8 am to make an appointment, but all three of my appointments were cancelled because I have been sick for less than a week or two. Every day they tell me completely different information, which makes my condition even worse, in fact, I just need to get confirmation of illness for my school, however, they have been misleading me for three days in a row, saying completely different things, starting with the fact that they do not issue such confirmations (although why would my school connect me to this clinic then), ending with the fact that today I hear that I can get this confirmation online, and yesterday they told me that I have to re-register with the doctor to get this confirmation. So much wasted nerves on a simple matter that could have been resolved on Monday. I strongly advise you to avoid this clinic, as this is simply unprecedented rudeness, canceling a patient's appointment for the third day in a row. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Patient Thank you for taking the time to review our Practice. I am sorry that you feel we deserve a 1* review & I to read that you are unhappy with the service you have received from us. On investigation it has been reported to me that you booked a GP appointment for a letter to confirm you have been unwell for 5 days. There are lots of reasons why we would be unable to provide you with the letter: 1) you have a self-limiting condition which doesn’t currently need treating by a GP. 2) as we have not seen or treated you for your illness we would not be able to provide you with a letter confirming that you have been unwell. 3) private letters do not form part of our GMS contract & must be done outside of our NHS core hours. The letter you requested is also chargeable at £30 & the wait for a private letter can be up to 4 weeks. 4) as you were unhappy with the above information our receptionist provided you with, she booked you a call with a GP tonight to discuss the self-management of your illness, however I must stress that this will not result in a letter being produced today. If you need proof of your call with the GP, please visit the NHS app where your consultation will be available. I can see that you have 2 cancelled appointments & I am extremely sorry that this has been frustrating for you. Yesterday you booked in with a GP for a mild illness, we care navigated you to the pharmacy which you were agreeable with. You then booked in today for the same reason but explained it was for a letter to day say you have been unwell. Our care navigation team are trained to signpost patients appropriately to reduce the amount of avoidable GP appointments that are booked unnecessarily on a daily basis. You can book appointments lots of different ways (Mon to Fri). Via the NHS App: 8am - on the day appointments for urgent issues. 12pm - routine appointments for 6 days in advance. If you prefer a weekend or evening appointment then you call the Practice (anytime) where we will book this for you (we call this enhanced access). We also refer patients to the pharmacy throughout the day. If you have an admin request, i.e. for a letter, then you can request this via our online consult: https://florey.accurx.com/p/P84630/patient-form I hope that this answers any question you may have around our appointment system & that you can now understand why your face to face appointments were cancelled. Should you wish to discuss this further, please reach out to me on 0161 226 0606. Yours faithfully, Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.text: By far the best GP practice I have been registered with. The receptionist is always lovely (I'm not sure of her name; the blonde lady). reviews.author: Simi Vongola
reviews.text: Pretty good. The doctors are kind and don't dismiss you or talk over you. I'd recommend using the NHS app to book appointments early (take whichever doctor is available as they all have different availability). Refilling repeat prescription isn't done via phone so you'll have to go in person, or call your nominated pharmacy to put in a request for you or again use the NHS app which I recommend. The reception is alright as far as I've used them but they're so busy in the mornings I'd say wait till noon if you can to phone in. Most requests/questions can be sent in via email or the NHS app if phoning reception isn't an option for you. As someone with anxiety I like to avoid phone calls so I use the app for most stuff related to the gp and I get a fast response, usually the same day or the next day. Referrals take ages but that's just a general issue and you can ask for updates on it via the app too. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Simi Thank you for taking the time to leave us with a review. It is extremely important that we receive feedback from our patients so we can understand what is working well and to be made aware of any potential issues so we can improve on them. Your review is detailed and very comprehensive and i am sure it will provide useful to other patients. Once again, thank you. Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: A McD
reviews.text: I’ve tried to call the surgery twice this morning at 8am. After waiting 25 mins, the receptionist answered, and put the phone down after 2 seconds, as I was trying to speak. I called back and waited another 15 mins. The same receptionist answered. I said hello, they responded how can I help, and then again put the phone down straight away. I found it so disappointing, as she answered as if she had heard me. The surgery is aware you have very long waiting times in the morning. Why would they not even give a chance for people to speak before putting the phone down. Very unprofessional, as it really felt like it was on purpose. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear A McD Thank you for taking the time to provide us with this feedback, please can i ask that you contact me at the Practice so that i can investigate what went wrong? The number is 0161 226 0606. I am so sorry that you felt that the telephone was hung up on you on purpose, this is not usual practice and it is something that i will investigate fully once i have further details from you. You can also book all of our GP appointments on the NHS app each day at 8am and 12pm. The feedback for this so far has been extremely positive as it has removed the need for patients to sit in a long telephone queue waiting to speak with a receptionist. I look forward to hearing from you. Many thanks, Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: Requiemae
reviews.text: I would advise avoiding this practice if you can. They are frustrating to deal with and at times have bordered on dangerous. Referrals made for the wrong patient/ unnecessary investigations Of course, no apology given when this was brought to their attention. Referrals they said they would make - not making them and not informing you of this. Borderline impossible to book an appointment if you have a job while simultaneously holding long term medication hostage if you don't book one. I'm not sure what they expect patients to do, book a day off in case theres an available slot when you call in at 8am? And if there's no slot then what? Do the same the next day? There is there online system as well which can be unavailable for weeks at a time. Of course when you do finally manage to book in you get a 4 hour window during which the GP will call you and even then they sometimes manage to call outside those times. Now I appreciate that GPs are overworked and busy and I don't mind being called later than expected. But it's ridiculous to have to clear an entire morning/afternoon for a 10-15min consultation. And god forbid you miss their call (when they call outside the stated times), you'll get a condescending message saying that they couldn't reach you and you have to do the whole process all over again. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Requiemae Thank you for taking the time to leave a review of our Practice. My name is Lesley and I am the Practice Manager in charge of investigating complaints made to the Practice. I am sorry that you have not had a positive experience and I would like to try and understand what may have gone so badly wrong in more detail. I have been unable to locate you on our system and therefore I cannot contact you to discuss the issues that you have raised. Please could I ask you to kindly call the Practice at your earliest convenience on 0161 226 0606 to speak with me as I am keen to try and resolve your issues as soon as possible. Many thanks Lesley

reviews.author: Imma Smiteu
reviews.text: If you get through to them they provide a good service, however it is very hard to get an appointment. They disabled their NHS app appointment system so the app just says "no appointments available to book online at this time". When I call them they say you can book through the app but I tell them they disabled it and they say "we didn't make the app". Horrible. I call to make an appointment they say "we're full" before you even say what issue you have. Horrible. Terrible. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Imma Thank you for taking the time to review our practice. I am please to read that you feel we deliver a good service. I would however like to discuss your experience of the NHS app further as we have not disabled it, we actively promote the NHS app and over 60% of our patients use the app successfully to order medication, view their medical records and to book appointments. if you pop into the Practice our Digital Facilitator will take a look at the app on your phone so we can identify what has gone wrong. We gibe out appointments via the NHS app at 8am and 12pm Monday to Friday. The only patients who cannot book appointments through the NHS app are those who require a double appointment, as this facility is not available yet. it is also extremely important that I investigate the telephone exchange you mention above as this is not the level of service which is usually provided. Please can i ask that you reach out to me at the practice to discuss this further (0161 226 0606) so that I can download the telephone calls and review with our reception lead? I am unable to locate you on our clinical system from your user name you see. I look forward to hearing from you. Many thanks, Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: Sam Brown
reviews.text: The doctors and medical staff at this surgery are attentive, professional, knowledgeable and are all round great and I couldn't praise them any more. What really lets this surgery down is the staff who answer the phones - their entire goal is to usher you away, whether or not they've actually dealt with your problem or not. They really couldn't care less in helping your issue or sign posting you in the right direction, they just incentivise you as much as they can to look elsewhere. Considering they are the face of their doctor's surgery, that just astounds me. Every single time I interact with them it's incredibly disheartening, as they don't answer your queries and just come back with useless and empty suggestions or advice. I just rang up asking about updating a prescription as there's a manufacturing issue with the pharamcies, and the reply I got was "I'll message someone, OK?", and I literally had to probe with multiple questions as what exactly that means as she was trying to hang up the phone. I had no idea what exactly had been resolved or what the next steps were? They genuinely couldn't care any less about your issue, they just want you off the phone. Not long ago I rang about holiday vaccines, before I had even finished my sentence their reply was "we don't do that here, OK?" and just before she was about to hang up after deploying her 'golden advice' I had to say "can I have a bit more than that please, where should I go to?". They either have not been trained sufficiently to deal with relevant patient issues, or they simply do not care. I'm going to go for a mixture of both. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hi Sam Thank you for providing us with such a detailed review. I would like to apologise for any upset or poor service which you feel that you have received from our reception team. I am of course very concerned by some of the issues which you have raised and i would like to discuss them with you in more detail. Could i kindly ask that you call me on 0161 226 0606 so that i can get some more details from you which will allow me to download the telephone calls you refer to and review them with my reception lead? We pride ourselves on delivering excellent customer care, therefore it is important for me to understand what has been going so terrible wrong when you contact the Practice. We do indeed provide travel vaccines, if you still require an appointment, please contact the practice and ask to speak with Danielle who will arrange this for you. Many thanks, Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: B
reviews.text: Mostly okay experience, it takes a while to get through on the phone (I’ve been 50th place in the queue at 8:30am) but I’ve always managed to get an appointment and the nurse who did my blood test was lovely. One of the receptionists , not sure who , usually has a dismissive tone. I was told by the NHS website to book a GP appointment if experiencing symptoms of tachycardia. I explained this to the receptionist who admitted “I don’t know what you’re talking about” in reference to my symptoms. She didn’t direct me to a GP and instead tried to schedule a video call with a contracted private company. When I said I wasn’t free that day, she told me to ring up another day to see if they had any spaces. I don’t understand why she thought this was the appropriate avenue, when I rang 111 about my tachycardia they correctly gave me a GP appointment for it. I dealt with the same receptionist after my GP appointment. The nurse specifically instructed me to wait for a call back for the admin team about any cancellations for an ECG. I missed a call from them, waited that day, and called back the next day to notify them that I hadn’t made an appointment still. When I told this to the receptionist she was confused and told me that it was my responsibility to call the practise, contrary to what I was told. Throughout the call she had the same dismissive tone and it sounded like my problems were just an inconvenience to her. I get that receptionists have to juggle appointments and what not but I didn’t do a single thing wrong. I don’t even want to call the practise anymore because I feel stupid when I speak to her. Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Amy Thank you for taking the time to review our Practice. We are aware that it can be frustrating when calling at 8am however all of our appointments are available to book through the NHS app. You just need to go on the app at 8am and you will be able to book for the same day or for 6 days in advance. I would really like to discuss the issue which you raised regarding on of my receptionists, please could I ask that you kindly reach out to me at the Practice so that I can gather some more information from you and conduct and investigation as to what went wrong? We really appreciate all feedback as it provides learning points for us, so thank you again. I would also like to apologise that you found our receptionist to be dismissive, this is not the level of service we pride ourselves on. Please be reassured that I take all complaints seriously and it is important to us that our patients feel able to reach out to us when they need us. I look forward to hearing from you. Kind regards Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.author: Karen McLeod
reviews.text: Rarely go to my surgery, but was summoned to go for a annual review which I have not had for more than 5 years. The health assistance I saw was very thorough and she told me I MUST make an appointment with a GP, as my blood pressure was extremely high. She also told me to do a urine sample and reiterated again "don't forget to make a GP appointment " I was told by the receptionist that I couldn't and was told to ring at 8 in the morning. I explained that the nurse insisted I book a GP appointment, which the receptionist said "she will have to speak with the nurse because she shouldn't of told me that. Who do I need to adhere too. Confused Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Dear Karen Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. I am pleased to read that you received good service from our HCA, it is always wonderful to read positive reviews about our team. Our GP appointments are released every day (Mon - Fri) at 8am for same day appointments and for pre-bookable appointments, available 6 days in advance. You can book either a same day appointment or an appointment 6 days in advance by going on the NHS app or by calling the Practice at 8am Monday to Friday. If the HCA had deemed the appointment as urgent, we would have added you to the emergency GP list for the same day and you would have been seen whilst you were in Practice. The receptionist needed to check with the HCA if the issue was urgent or if it was indeed acceptable for you to book the appointment through the usual channels. I am extremely sorry for any confusion around the booking of your GP appointment and I will share your feedback with our Practice team so that we can learn from it. If you would like to discuss this further, please do not hesitate to reach out to me at the Practice. Many thanks Lesley Hyde Practice Manager

reviews.text: Unfriendly, rude and unhelpful staff. Called this place as a foreigner two weeks ago, was met with unavailable callback service for international phone numbers, two failed call backs in a 15+ queue, meaning a total of 90 minutes to get through to a receptionist. The only thing the lady was interested in was whether I'm a patient with them and if not, got told to ring other doctors and hung up on. As someone who's suffering of sciatica pain while on holiday in a country I don't have any health insurance in, no knowledge of how the health system works and being unfit to travel back home, I've never felt more helpless and stranded than at that moment. Begs the question whether this receptionist is aware that they work in the health*care* industry if all they care about is whether you're a patient with them or not, and if not you're given the worst advice, no sympathy and not even allowed to explain your situation. Practice response date: 3 years ago Practice response: Good morning Alex M Firstly I would like to apologise that it took you a long time to get hold of the surgery via the telephone, this is unusual for us and I would like to investigate this further so that I can understand what went wrong. I am also sorry that you felt one of my team were rude to you. Please could I kindly ask that you contact me at the surgery so that i can get some further information from you which will allow me to track your call? Many thanks Mrs Lesley Hyde

reviews.author: Albert Ross
reviews.text: (Using a pseudonym as people appear to have been removed from the register for writing critical feedback) To have limited resources and capacity is one thing, but what brings the NHS and The Arch Medical into the realm of systematic neglect is that it copes with its shortcomings through gaslighting, invalidation and dishonesty which severely affects patient outcomes. Whilst I like socialised healthcare, and despite the sanctimonious PR, I could never again speak praise of such a harmful system in dire need of reform. If you ever have an injury that affects your judgement in any way, please, please, please find somebody who will help you act in your best interest because it certainly won't be The Arch Medical practice or better yet register somewhere else in the first place with a track record of responsibility. I saw the reviews, brushed them off and registered and it is something I will regret for a long time and perhaps the rest of my life. Please don't do this, this is your health, it is worth so much more than that. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Albert Ross I am sorry to read your review and that you are posting under a pseudonym for fear of being removed from our list. I can confirm we do not remove patients from our list for providing critical feedback. We take all feedback of our services seriously and I would be most grateful if you could contact the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager so we can obtain all the facts to enable us to undertake a thorough investigation of your feedback and make necessary changes where possible but we are unable to do this without further details being provided. Kind regards.

reviews.text: I would normally don't leave reviews because I always think mistakes happen .. and if they do I am sure it will be rare. In this scenario I feel like Arch Medical is only a bunch of people that not only have no experience in what they do but also rude unprofessional and does not understand people's needs. This place took me to the point of leaving this review because.1.Every time you have a test done there is no feedback unless u ask and if u ask you might wait for 2 months if the case. 2.When you are booked (if u lucky to do so) they message you and say is canceled three times happen recent no options given to rebook and they just leave it to it rather than helping you with the following appointment and make sure you will be looked after. 3. Booked in for test got it neutral and asked to be redone after a WEEK still not been able to do a test see if I have infection so I can treat it NEVERMIND IN HAVING RESULTS BECAUSE THEY ARE COMMING WHEN THINGS MIGHT GET WORSE !!!! There is NOBODY to ask what was wrong with the sample test so we can make sure next one we getting it right, receptionists absolutley unproffesional and don't care who you are and what's your problem been treated like animal not people wonder how these ladys been employed to face people because they do a terrible job the way they talk and behave. I have many issues i could tell but i stop here. All in all ... disgusting . I am looking to flag this out because I have met 2 people they had similar experiences and they never spoken probably because they just not bothered as much... today I decided to shout. I HAD ENOUGH !!! Is anyone able to "tidy up" this place ? I wonder ..... or just simply have to move somewhere else as soon as I get the chance. ******************************* UPDATE ONE WEEK AFTER. Mission impossible to speak to someone on the phone. 4 different days before 9am and waiting for more than 40 mins unable to speak to someone 11 in the queue from 8:30 onwards again wait over 40 mins unable to get in touch. And of course I went in and the receptionist told me that you are not on site. I have been told to use a generic email. I'm not really sure if this is what I am looking for. Still going in circles looks like. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Chris B. We are sorry you feel we only deserve one star. We take all feedback of our services seriously and are passionate about investigating matters further. I feel your comments require a full investigation of the service you have received from our staff but I am unable to identify you from here. I would be most grateful if you could contact the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager so we can obtain all the facts and undertake a thorough investigation of your experience. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Vasilis Vlastaras
reviews.text: Actually this practice deserves a zero. Unbelievably bad service. I woke up to call the practice after having vertigo for 3 days and I need to be seen by a doctor. This is a recurring problem I am having. They called me back 1.5 hours later only to tell me to call them back tomorrow same time because they do not have a doctor. I am telling them 'I already called you today, make an appointment for tomorrow', they are telling me I need t ocall them tomorrow. I am asking them, 'what will it happen if you do not have a doctor tomorrow? Will you ask me to call again tomorrow? I can not call you tomorrow only to find out that I need to cal lyou back 2 day later or even 3 days later. I can not chase you because it is impossilbe you to make appointments for next couple of days. The lady in the desk was repeating the same 'you need to call tomorrow'. What's the point to be registered with this practice anymore? I can not go to a walk in! Actually I can not walk because of vertigo. I am on bed already for 3 days but I can not find any solution with the practice. All I can do is to try to call back. By the way their web system is always down during the weekends. We are not stupid, we understand the way this practice operates. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Vasilis, I am sorry you feel the surgery only deserves one star and we apologise for the experience you are receiving in trying to book an appointment. If you can call the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager we can try to resolve this for you as we are unable to find your record at the surgery from the details above. We would also require as much details of the person you spoke to and the time and date they called you as it is not our practice for the reception/telephone staff to call patients back regarding appointment booking. Our online consultations are open during the week and you can access this via our website at www.thearchmedicalpractice.co.uk. Kind regards

reviews.text: Very lazy, so reluctant to deal with patients Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Karen, we are sorry you feel we only deserve one star. reviews.author: Ann Gannon
reviews.text: I’d give zero stars if I could. Have spoken to a GP once about recurring pain in my lower abdomen, an issue that I think could be serious, this was over four months ago. They should have referred me for a scan, when I enquired about it, they gave me a number to ring, got through once to be told that the referral hadn’t been made. Have tried a few times over the last four months to speak again to a GP and chase up the appointment for the scan, neither has happened. Someone needs to look into how appalling the service is, it’s not fit for purpose and patients are at risk. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Ann I am sorry you feel we deserve only 1 star but we thank you for taking the time to leave your comments. I can see the referral has been actioned and chased and I have again asked for this to be chased. If you would like to call the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager where we can go over this information in detail with you. Kind regards

reviews.author: Rosalie Pilkington
reviews.text: I've never had better service from a GP than I have here. I appreciate remote appointments might not be for everyone, but each time I have had a medical issue they have been quick to get in touch with me, listen to my needs and provide appropriate medical help, I've never felt talked down to, or like what I am saying is not being taken in to account. It is nice to be taken seriously and communicate with medical professionals that actually listen to what you are saying. Can't thank them enough for how easy they have made everything. Practice response date: 4 years ago Practice response: Dear Rosalie, thank you for your lovely comments and 5 star review. I will share your comments with the clinical and admin teams. We also thank you for taking the time out to provide us with such a positive review. Kind regards

reviews.text: Avoid like the plague. Malpractice and patient bullying appears to be a thing here. Since writing this review the practice has removed me from the GP register because how dare you write a bad review. reviews.author: Jessica Dickson
reviews.text: It’s true that it can be difficult to book an appointment here due to how oversubscribed it is. However, I don’t think that is the practice’s fault but instead a reflection of how severely underfunded the NHS is. Whilst it does take a long time to get through on the phone, I’m very thankful for the call back service, which makes things a lot easier. Once I manage to get through, I’ve had nothing but pleasant experiences with the staff at this practice. The receptionists are friendly and nice. The doctors and nurses are professional and understanding. I can get quite nervous with blood draws and the nurses have always been so patient, which I truly appreciated. I’ve seen Dr Gill a few times and think she’s a wonderful doctor as well. A big thank you to all the lovely staff :) Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear Jessica, thank you for your 4 stars and your lovely review. We are experiencing high numbers of calls and have provided other ways of contacting us using our website for online consults, online forms and further information to relieve the pressures on the phones. I will share your wonderful feedback to the team. Kind regards

reviews.author: anna nas
reviews.text: Appauling service. I am aware GPs are very busy currently, but in the past week -They failed to send a prescription to the pharmacy after telling me it was sent - They didn't get back to me at all after telling me they would- I sat on my phone for 8 hours - When I finally got through to a male GP the next day, he was incredibly rude and dismissive. My covid symptoms have returned with a vengence 3 months after initially having it, and the heart flutters and palpitations are really scaring me. He would not even acknowledge the possibility of long covid saying 'There are viruses other than covid you know' and insisting I wait another week to speak to them when these symptoms have been present in some form for THREE MONTHS. He just wanted to get off the phone and go home clearly- I was evidently still stressed and unsatisfied with his 'help'. Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear Anna, I am sorry to hear of your experience and we would like to discuss this in further detail so we can investigate and take this up directly with the members of staff involved. I had to google technical words describing my blood test as the receptionist didn't know what they meant and wouldn't book an appointment to discuss the results. The GPs seem stressed out but they are perfectly fine, I am sure the receptionist staff would be alright too if trained properly. reviews.author: Cute Coco
reviews.text: All the receptionists are always lovely and happy to help. GPS are very good too. Never had any issue which can't be solved. Polite staff. Would recommend this practice to anyone who wants to register. Just one small issue that it take too long sometimes for the call to get through but if you are not happy then you can choose the option for a call back on answer machine. I guess this is the problem with all GP practices due to COVID-19. Its unfair reading so many bad reviews. Me and my family been patient for over two years now. Never seen and rude behaviour from staff but I do understand when people push you to the limits then as a normal human being there is a response. People expect GP appt for everything these days. Hope people don't take things for granted and appreciate the access they have to NHS which other people around the world don't have. If you want to keep it that way stop complaining and start appreciating. Keep up the good work Arch Medical Team 👏👏👏 👍👍👍 Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear N Orakzai, thank you for the 5 stars and for your lovely comments and understanding, especially in the current situation with COVID and the pressures this puts on our clinical and administration teams. We are currently finding our phones lines are extremely busy, we also have available on our website the ability to submit an e-consult request for those who have access to the internet and this will help release the telephone lines for those that are unable to access the internet. Again, I thank you for your lovely comments and understanding, I shall share your lovely review with all of our staff. Stay safe. Kind regards

reviews.author: Mehrgan Peyvandi
reviews.text: Only giving this one star because there is no option for zero stars. The reception staff are the least professional individuals I’ve ever dealt with. They tell you they will do something for you (such a processing a prescription) and it’ll take 72hrs to get processed or for them get back to you. Then you call them after 3 days just to find out that the person you spoke to last time hasn’t actually processed anything and you have to wait 72hrs again (if you’re lucky). The phone staff have no sympathy for whatever problems you have and will not hesitate to take a horrible attitude towards you if you show that you’re not happy with the service they’re giving you. The worst customer service treatment I have ever experienced and absolutely unprofessional! Practice response date: 5 years ago Practice response: Dear Mr Peyvandi, I am sorry you felt we didn't deserve any stars. On looking at the prescription request, we only received this on 29 September from an outpatient provider by letter. The prescription was raised 2 October 2020 which is within our 72 hr request time. We do not have a record of you speaking with any of our reception team. Could you please contact the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager to provide details of the dates and times you telephoned or visited the surgery to request your prescription so I can investigate further and speak to the member of staff directly. Kind regards.

I moved recently in another practice, that is faster, yes but ; they really understand your emergencies, the most important thing they are not rude at all, therefore for three years me and my family were treat badly for nothing!! reviews.text: the doctors here are perfectly fine, however it is very difficult to get an appointment.
