We have a provisional date in December for installation of the new system. If you have registered for online access then appointments can be booked or cancelled via our online Patient Access without the need for telephoning the surgery. Kind regards.

reviews.author: David Carsons
reviews.text: the doctors here are perfectly fine, however it is very difficult to get an appointment. I was told to ring at 8 AM when appointments are released but the line was engaged for 20 min (18 call attempts) before I got through to being on hold, where I was only the second in the queue. This implies that their phone system can not keep many more than this on hold, which is ridiculous when you are trying to get ready for work and can't really keep trying over and again. The phone system desperatly needs updating. Also releasing appointments staged at say 08:00, 12:30 and 5:30 throughout the day would make it far easier to get an appointment! Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear David, we are sorry you feel the surgery only deserves one star and apologise for you being unable to get through to the surgery. We can reassure you that the telephone system is currently being upgraded to a better system but these … More

reviews.author: Nick Crotty
reviews.text: The receptionists are unhelpful and rude, you'll struggle to get an appointment within 2-3 weeks, and even if you do there's a very good chance that they'll cancel it and the whole process has to start again. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Nick, We apologise for your appointment being cancelled. Due to sickness the appointments had to be cancelled for the day. I am sorry you felt our reception team were unhelpful and rude and I would like to know further details so I can investigate and speak with the person directly, as this may be a training issue. Can you telephone the surgery and ask for the Practice Manager so you can provide further details which will enable me to carry out the investigation. Kind regards

reviews.author: Abdalla Abdalla
reviews.text: I was late for 5 minutes, Shaw School Alsumaria News Practice response date: Edited 6 years ago Practice response: I am sorry you feel we only deserve one star. It is Practice Policy to not allow a late patient to check in as we are a very busy practice and our clinicians have other patients to see. This would have a knock on affect to other patients and their appointment times if we saw patients that were late for their appointment. If a patient is late it is at the discretion of the GP or Nurse as to whether they will see a late patient. If this was not explained to you by the reception team member please can you contact the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager to provide further details so we can investigate the circumstances and if we find this is a training issue with a team member we can pick this up directly with them. Kind regards

reviews.author: Jafar Ahmed
reviews.text: I was a patient for 25 years I had a misunderstanding with the reception they kick me out is that Medical Practice replied to your and then I had an appointment I want to go to the GP and they told me that you not the longer registered with us I asked for the manager and I’ve been told that she’s not there I left my contact number she never called me back I called them whenever I miss you and my name they keep telling me the manager is not there is that fair after 25 years Only small minor misunderstanding which is at I apologize the manager made me to apologize I did apologize and this to kick me out they need to get the right people on the reception and also the manager to do the right job Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Jafar, having reviewed the situation and the level of your behaviour at the time, which was deemed inappropriate and being a practice that operates Zero Tolerance we felt the relationship between the practice and patient had broken down and we requested removal via NHS England.

reviews.author: beautifully human
reviews.text: I have been a patient at the practice for 20+years now. Doctors & Nurses have always been helpful, couple of times I have had to use out of hours and even they have been helpful. I used to lose patience with the busy tone whilst trying to get an appointment at 8am when I have gotten through I've always managed to get sorted. Receptionist try their best to accommodate the patients and play a huge part for the medical centre. We have to learn to appreciate that and realise we aren't the only patients the practice have. If you have an urgent problem NHSdirect phoneline is just as helpful and in serious cases A&E is your safest and quickest option. The practice as a whole try their most best to serve the community and have been amazing to me as a child and now an adult. It is one of the best medical centres not to mention clean in my opinion. Keep up the amazing work! Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Beautifully Human, thank you for your lovely comments and sharing your experiences over 20+ years. We are glad you are receiving excellent care from the Clinical Teams. I will share your comments with the teams. Kindest regards.

reviews.author: Jo Ja
reviews.text: I have got appointment only once for my son. The appointment was after two weeks anyway, so all his symptoms disappeared by then. Before that, I rang with very bad cold. Lady on the phone said she could give me an appoitment in a week, I advised I was 41 weeks pregnant and was going to be induced that day. Then lady said that she could squeeze me in a day earlier. Was it suppose to be a joke? If so, I did not get it. Anyway, I'm going to change the practice as this service is ridiculous. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Jo Ja, I am sorry you found it difficult to make an appointment for your son and yourself. Our reception staff should have advised if it was an emergency to contact NHS111 or walk in centre or to attend A&E. Without the full details of the day and time of your call I am unable to investigate what information was given to you by the staff member that you feel they were making a joke? If you can contact the surgery and ask to speak to the Practice Manager and provide details of the date and time you made the call then this will allow us to investigate as all our calls are recorded so we can review if a member of the team needs further training to ensure this doesn't happen again. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Anita Morales
reviews.text: I had to change this as my current experience during the last few months has been awful. Today (Saturday 19/10/19) I had to go to the GP because I had an appointment with my son that got cancelled for the second time. Since I'm working full time I thought I could use this opportunity to collect my repeated prescription from the reception. I went there and I was told that today they are only attending Flu patients, I can understand that, although I didn't know. I've asked for an exception given that I need to take this everyday for life, explaining that I wasn't aware that they are not supposed to do so, because it wasn't a 'normal day'. To my surprise I've just found a person with a lack of empathy and common sense. This person didn't even ask whether my prescription was for a life-threatening illness or not. That is worryingly negligent from an institution entrusted with the care of people. Just to clarify, the waiting room was empty, there were two receptionists at the time, my prescription was 50 cm and 1 minute away from there. I was not asking for anything unrealistic and I tried to explain the reason for my confusion, but I just received a “no” for a response. Obviously, I was denied the chance to speak to someone else. I can understand rules, although I wasn't aware of those. This was clearly a terrible misunderstanding as I thought the practice was open (due to my son's appointment). I think this world would be a lot better if people were more reasonable and empathetic. My experiences with doctors, on the other hand, have been mainly positive Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Anita, thank you for your kind comments regarding the practice and staff. I will look into the issues with calling the practice on Wednesday mornings as the phone lines are staffed but are extremely busy. We have a dedicated telephone room and dedicated staff to answer the calls so you would not hear or see the calls being taken within reception. Thank you for your query regarding the calls on Wednesday's and we will investigate the issues. Many thanks.

reviews.author: J J
reviews.text: Dear J E we are sorry you feel the practice only deserves 1 star and we would like to understand the reason for this. If you can please contact the Practice Manager to discuss your reasons then we can look at making improvements. Without this information we are unable to deal with any of the issues you may be experiencing. Kind regards Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear J E we are sorry you feel the practice only deserves 1 star and we would like to understand the reason for this. If you can please contact the Practice Manager to discuss your reasons then we can look at making improvements. Without this information we are unable to deal with any of the issues you may be experiencing. Kind regards

reviews.author: Khara Pee
reviews.text: Not Happy with the system in emergancy involving a baby you still need to wait till 8am the next day. when you do call you cant get through...till after 9 to be told thier are no appointments. Thinking to move doctors been with them for years but no improvement spend half the time debating with the receptionist... had ebough Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Khara, I am sorry you found it difficult to make an appointment for your baby. Our reception staff should have advised if it was an emergency to contact NHS111 or walk in centre or to attend A&E. Without the full details I am unable to investigate what information was given to you by the staff member or what advice they gave you once you were advised we had no available appointments as this may be a training issue within the team. If you can contact the surgery and ask to speak to the Practice Manager and provide details of the date and time you made the call then this will allow us to investigate as all our calls are recorded so we can review if a member of the team needs further training to ensure this doesn't happen in future. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Selonetta Karbah
reviews.text: I cant understand how any one can fault Hulme Medical centre. Personally, my experiences with that surgery over the last 20 years have been second to none. Doctors Segar, Doctor Doyle ( my favourite), Doctor Lee, our wonderful Louise Bolton, Olivia have all been so supportive. Even the Asian Doctor that I met with durign the lost of my dad ( Dr Gill) They even offer pastoral care. I just love these Doctors and I think we need to commend them for the excellent job that they do. Never had any issue and dont think I ever will. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your lovely comments and we are glad you are receiving excellent care from the Clinical Teams. I will share your comments with the teams. Kindest regards.

reviews.author: Domas
reviews.text: If you can contact the Practice Manager to discuss your reason for the review then we can look at resolving any issues you many have. Kind regards. Practice response date: Edited 6 years ago Practice response: If you can contact the Practice Manager to discuss your reason for the review then we can look at resolving any issues you many have. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Dane
reviews.text: Excellent consultation with Dr. Lee, went above and beyond my expectations. Had previous positive appointments here, too. Such is the strain placed on the NHS at present, it can be challenging to get a timely appointment, but it's unfair to hold that against anyone here Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your kind comments. I will share these with Dr Lee and the team. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Daniel Jones
reviews.text: Terrible. Been trying for 2 months now to get an appointment, I have insomnia and it's impossible to wake up at 8am for me. Whenever I call all I get is ' call back tommorow at 8am'. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: I am sorry you felt we only deserved one star. We are currently upgrading our call system and have also employed more clinical staff to increase our appointments available. We have also recently started opening until 8pm on Mondays and we are now open on Wednesday afternoons too. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback.

reviews.author: Steven Luck (Lucky)
reviews.text: They only release appointments 2 weeks in advance and they’re released whilst working people drive to work, so it is impossible to book an appointment with them as they’re all gone by the time you arrive at work. They won’t let you book more than 2 weeks in advance, so even if you are happy to wait for your appointment so as to fit them in around your job they won’t accommodate you. It is pointless even signing up with this GP if you have a job with normal working hours, you will never get an appointment with them. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Steven, I am sorry you are finding it difficult to get an appointment. We try our best to make appointments available on the day if you call at 8am. If you have an on-line access account you can book your own appointments. This will save you from having to phone in and will mean you can check throughout the day for cancellations. If we have no available appointments and a patient advises us that it is an emergency to be seen then our staff will advise the walk in centre or other appropriate services. If you would like to discuss your concerns further then please do not hesitate to contact us and ask to speak with our Practice Manager. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Fangru Liu
reviews.text: Thank you for the 3 star. It would be great to know how we can improve our service. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Thank you for the 3 star. It would be great to know how we can improve our service. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback.

reviews.author: Aleksandra Delenko
reviews.text: I am quite a regular patient at the Arch Medical centre and I can say that the doctors are absolutely amazing! They have never shown me anything buy empathy, care and have always done their best to address the issue. I have never been denied a referal or any other treatment I was asking. I really think they are great and going far and beyond during a very challenging for NHS time. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Aleksandra, thank you for your lovely comments. I will share your comments with our team. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Robert Docherty
reviews.text: This is a well run practice. The only negative I've noted is sometimes delayed appointments Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear Robert, thank you for your kind review. We are looking at ways to improve our services so your feedback will help us to review our appointments process. Kind regards

reviews.author: Who am I?
reviews.text: Good Docs I would highly recommend them to anyone. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: Dear John, thank you for your lovely comment. I will pass this onto the Doctors and Team. Kind Regards.

reviews.author: Sanchari
reviews.text: To book an appointment, i have to call back at 8am , once the next batch of appointments are released. Online appointments are also not available. I had to call literally hundreds of times in order to be connected to a receptionist. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: I am sorry you felt we only deserved one star. We are currently upgrading our call system and have also employed more clinical staff to increase our appointments available. We have also recently started opening until 8pm on Mondays and we are now open on Wednesday afternoons too. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback.

reviews.author: E
reviews.text: This doctors surgery have let me down immensely. Previously this doctors have provided an okay service, but for the last 3+ months they have been incredibly useless. I had an appointment in November of which was then given a referral to the orthopaedic department for a potential stress fracture in my knee and badly damaged ankle and I needed help relatively quickly. I changed my address the day of that appointment at the Doctors request to speed up the process. Three weeks later I got a call saying they hadn't changed my address so my referral hadn't gone out yet, so I changed it for a second time during that call. I called several times since then but still no referral. It is now over three months since that appointment and today I have been told that the person who changed my address didn't notify anyone so my hospital letter was sent to my old address and there is a possibility I have to start again on the waiting list. This is appalling and I was unable to walk for a long period of time and as an full time endurance runner my entire ability to do any form of training has been ruined and set me back a great deal. I am incredibly upset, and it is down to the staff that work there that I have been forced to stop training for months longer than I needed and in pain to be due to getting no help I needed because of this. I am incredibly upset and do not recommend this doctors if you require help as they can't even seem to change a simple address. Edit: Even after constant calling and trying to get my referral sorted, the receptionists continue to be rude and have even blamed the situation on me several times stating that "They were waiting for me to change my address" even after all this time. They have refused to help with the referral even though it is all down to this practice that I will now not see a specialist for over 5 months. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Emily B, I am sorry you feel let down by the surgery and have experienced poor service. We aim to provide and excellent service so I would like to investigate this further. I am happy to discuss this comment and investigate further. If you could please contact the surgery and ask to speak to the Practice Manager then I can take further details that will allow me to investigate. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Bridesmaid Chic
reviews.text: Just frankly useless. Always sound like they are doing you a favour by even being arsed to pick up the phone. Patient care zero stars. Should work for Asdas Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: I am sorry you feel this way. We aim to provide a good standard of service and care. If you could contact the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager to discuss your comments further and we will investigate the circumstances with the members of staff involved. Kind regards

reviews.author: Dave Marshall
reviews.text: The level of care from medical staff is excellent, but this practice is marred by systematic operational failure. In attempting to book an appointment, you are directed to call back at 8am on a certain day of the week, once the next batch of appointments are released. This creates a free-for-all in which all patients, desperate for appointments, have to call literally hundreds of times in order to be connected to a receptionist. This system is not fit for purpose. Arch Medical, please listen to the reviews being submitted here. Everyone is saying the same thing. How you are operating is not satisfactory. No other practice I have been registered with uses this system, nor do they have these issues. Since you seem to put so much effort into responding to every one of these reviews, please can I use this medium to get a response: Please help me book an appointment. Please send me registration documents so that I can book online, I never reieved these. This practice needs to recognise that when it comes to booking appointments, the responsibility for being organised lies at their feet and not at the patient's. Not interested in a copy & paste response telling us that you're looking in to the problem because I don't believe it. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Mr Marshall, thank you for your comments. We are sorry you are unable to get through on the phones. We are experiencing an extremely busy period. The lines are free now and if you call in there are emergency appointments available for this morning and also later this afternoon/early evening. With regards to registering online the documents to complete have to be collected from our reception team, bringing with you proof of identity. If you would like to discuss this further then please telephone the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager. Kind regards.

reviews.author: Hella Base
reviews.text: I’ve noticed that majority of the time when I call the phone doesn’t even ring, it almost feels like phones at the gp are all unplugged. I also tried calling through my mother and sisters phone hoping to get through but I am put straight to a voicemail. I tried a week ago and I am now trying again. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: We are sorry you are finding it hard to get through on the telephone. We are experiencing a high demand for appointments and the telephone lines are extremely busy. We have 10 telephone lines coming into the practice. Callers are placed in a queue once the call is answered. We try and answer and deal with our calls as quickly as possible. I am unsure why your call did not go through? It may be that all 10 of our incoming lines were busy. Have you thought about setting up and on-line account so you can book appointments directly? This is also useful so you can check for cancellations throughout the day.

reviews.author: Nikhil Mehan
reviews.text: I have attempted to ring this practice on multiple occasions for the past 2 weeks to discuss my blood test results as instructed by my GP. However due to the incompetence within the administration of this practice I have not been able to whilst suffering from the same symptoms. I have rang at 8 in the morning most days and it indicates the user is busy so I've tried later to no avail, it does not even put me in a queue therefore to make an appointment its a guessing game as to when the staff will be free. The staff are often very rude as well. Will be changing my GP soon if the practice if they eventually wake up and pick up the phone. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Nikhil, thank you for your comment and I am sorry you have found it difficult to get an appointment. We try our best to make appointments available on the day if you call at 8am. I notice you did not attend for a recent appointment and if you have an on-line access account you can cancel your appointments to allow others to book into that appointment or you can book your own appointments online. This will save you from having to phone in and will mean you can check throughout the day for cancellations. If you would like to discuss your concerns further then please telephone the practice and ask to speak to the Practice Manager.

reviews.author: Aaliyah Harriett
reviews.text: The Arch Medical Practice provides the most disorganised service. It can take weeks up to a month to get an appointment, you are advised if you need one immediately to call on the day at 8am, but good luck getting through. This morning both me and my mum were calling nonstop hoping that one of us would get through to get an appointment. I personally made 97 calls over the period of 20 minutes - with the calls going to a busy tone. I had to rearrange work commitments to make time to call up! Sometimes you ring and are put in a queue for an hour sometimes there is no option at all. It’s not until around 11.30am I was able to get through and even then It took 5 attempts to get put in a queue and then 10 minutes in the queue before I was through to a receptionist. Once I was finally through I was informed that there were no appointments left for today - or the entire week! - and that I should call back again tomorrow at 8am when more appointments are released!! Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Aaliyah, I am sorry you have been unable to get through on the phones to the surgery and finding it difficult to get an appointment. We try our best to make appointments available on the day if you call at 8am. If you have an on-line access account you can book your own appointments. This will save you from having to phone in and will mean you can check throughout the day for cancellations. We are currently investigating the issue with the calls not being answered in a timely manner. It is our busiest time of year and we are experiencing a very high number of calls and demand for appointments. If we have no available appointments and a patient advises us that it is an emergency to be seen then our staff will advise the walk in centre or other appropriate services. If you would like to discuss your concerns further then please do not hesitate to contact us and ask to speak with our Practice Manager.

reviews.author: Ghassan Alobaidi
reviews.text: Lovely and very helpful staff .. God bless you all .. thank you .... Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your lovely comment. I will be sure to share this with the practice team and the GP's. Many thanks, Sharon.

reviews.author: Abs Basso
reviews.text: Ridiculously bad service, Had a appointment at 4 o’clock and I wasn’t seen till almost 5 which made me late for my shift at work causing me to loose pay, my previous appointment was even worse I was left waiting for over 2 hours to be seen and the receptionist was very rude and Unempatheric when I asked how long it would be until I will be seen, please stop overbooking appointments that you can not keep !! Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Abdullah, I am very sorry to hear that your appointment was delayed by such a long time. We are currently reviewing and making changes to our appointment system and also taking on extra GP's going forward so I do hope this will ensure the waiting times are reduced in future. I am sorry our reception team were rude and not empathetic to your situation. I will speak directly with the reception team regarding your comments. I am sorry for your poor experience but if you would like to discuss this further then please telephone the surgery and ask to speak with the Practice Manager.

reviews.author: Susan Leech
reviews.text: Phoned up to get appointment I have very bad asthma coz I've got this bug it gone right to my chest she told me to go walk in centre or go rushome it a joke this medical center bad service all the time Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Susan, thank you for your comment and I am sorry you have found it difficult to get an appointment. reviews.author: DeaN O'Hope.
reviews.text: The Arch has been my Doctors for 6 years now. I suffered a stroke in 2007 so I have regular appointments. The surgery is well kept and the receptionists are really friendly and helpful. My GP is the best I've ever had, and I've had more than a few. Overall I have nothing bad to say whatsoever. 5*. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your lovely comment. I will be sure to share this with the practice team and the GP's. I'm really pleased your experiences are good and I thank you for sharing your findings with our other patients. Sharon.

reviews.author: Pseudodreams Productions
reviews.text: Thank you for your 5 star rating, kind regards. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your 5 star rating, kind regards.

reviews.author: beata sikora
reviews.text: I am sorry you felt we only deserved one star. It would be great to know how we can improve our service. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback. Practice response date: 6 years ago Practice response: I am sorry you felt we only deserved one star. It would be great to know how we can improve our service. Please contact the Practice Manager if you would like to offer any further feedback.

reviews.author: emma daly
reviews.text: The receptionists are rude and unhelpful here. Unorganised and lack communication. You are constantly on hold (30 mins+) and when you finally get through they are extremely disrespectful. This is unfortunate since, some of the doctors are really helpful. It's a shame the rest of the practice isn't the same. Glad to be transferring. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Emma, I am not sure you have the right practice because you are not showing as patient. Perhaps you have used a different name for your review? I am very sorry to hear that you have been unable to get through on the telephone and that the receptionist were unhelpful. We do have a number of new receptionists, who are still learning so this may explain why they seemed disorganised. This does not excuse them from being rude. I will share your comment with them. I would really like the opportunity to discuss this further with you so I can learn from your experience and try to put things right. Next time you call please ask to speak to the Practice Manager so I can better understand why things went so wrong. I am sorry for your poor experience.

reviews.author: Jenny C
reviews.text: Had to wait almost an hour to be seen as computers went down and nurse did not know when they went back on. No apology or kind word from anyone. Just a couldn't care less attitude. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Dear Jennifer, thank you for your comment. My room is next to the nurse's room and I heard her tell you that the computers had gone down and I heard her apologise for this. Unfortunately the issue with the computers was a city wide issue affecting a lot of the Manchester practices, and something we had no control over. I am sorry if you felt the practice could not care less about you. This certainly is not the case and I will share your comment with the nurse to let her know how she made you feel. I am sorry you had a poor experience on your last visit, such issues are quite rare, and I'm sorry that a computer shutdown happened on the day you attended. I hope you have a better experience next time you come.

reviews.author: Ciaran Kelly
reviews.text: Phoning up for an appointment today and have been caller number one on hold for the past 25 minutes. Honestly think the receptionist was on a tea break. Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Thank you for this comment. Our phone lines have been busy today and all of our staff are answering calls as quickly as they can, however, I have had a similar comment from another patient about being number one in the queue for a long time. I have asked our telephone provider to investigate as it would seem there is a fault. Our receptionists take their breaks from 11.30am until 2pm and we ensure all stations are covered during these times. I would therefore concluded that there is a fault with our lines rather than staff being on their breaks. Please feel free to contact the surgery and ask to speak to the Practice Manager should you wish to discuss this matter further or receive an update on rectifying the fault. Many thanks.

reviews.author: Mutahir butt
reviews.text: doctor colabella very helpfull very polite very intelligent doctor 5 STARS!!! Practice response date: 7 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your kind feedback. I will share your comments with Dr Colabella. Kind regards

reviews.author: Mr H
reviews.text: Dr Doyle is the best. She listens to your problems & cares about her patients. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thank you for this rating.

reviews.author: Dainis Gorbunovs
reviews.text: I have met GP and mentioned 2 of my health issues. Then I was told that 10 minutes are up and I must leave after I asked help with another health issue I have been having for years. She said I have to book another appointment. 2/5 for at least helping with some of my health problems. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thanks for your comment Dan. It is true that all our GP appointments are 10 minutes. We ask patients to book a longer appointment if they have many things they would like to discuss. I am sure that many of our doctors would love to have longer with each patient, however, we have to be fair to all our other patients who have also booked an appointment. You are quite within your rights to ask for a double appointment next time you book, but I would ask that you consider your fellow patients and only book a double appointment if you really need to. Here is a link provided by NHS Choices which may help you make the most of your next consultation. https://www.nhs.uk/nhsengland/aboutnhsservices/doctors/pages/gp-appointments.aspx

reviews.author: john page
reviews.text: I have been with the practice for just over two years and have never had a problem with any of the staff. All great people, even the dragons on reception are lovely. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thank you for this comment. It's always nice to hear when we are getting things right.

reviews.author: Robyn Bennett
reviews.text: Very bad service and receptionist very rude to my friend. Came to practice with a genuine concern about his prescription that has been a continuous problem. Receptionist was very unhelpful and laughed at him with the other receptionist while he was still in earshot. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: I am sorry that you and your friend have had a poor experience. I would very much like to discuss this with you and raise your concerns with the admin team. The behaviour you have described is unacceptable and must not continue. Please contact the surgery and ask to speak to the Practice Manager.

reviews.author: Arek Świerz
reviews.text: Thank you for your rating. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your rating.

reviews.author: Him 1980
reviews.text: Thank you for your rating. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your rating.

reviews.author: Kate Jones
reviews.text: Rally great Service! I always feel safe, well-informed and confident in the professionals there. However, and this is a massive downfall, it's completely understaffed for it's purpose. It takes students from Manchester Metropolitan University, and I presume locals, and it can't keep up. It can be impossible to book an appointment with a doctor of the surgery in advance. I have only ever seen the emergency doctor, and the phone lines are always busy. It is really frustrating. Being a student I spend time at home and in Manchester, trying to come home, just to have a pill refill is ridiculous. I'd be better off going to the Hathersage centre, They'd probably see me sooner. Practice response date: 8 years ago Practice response: Thank you for your comment. It is true to say that our list size has increased over the last couple of years. This is due to the city expanding and more residential properties (and student halls) being built. This is the same with many of the central manchester GP practices. We have addressed this by recruiting three more doctors and an new nurse practitioner. We are also trying to manage appointments by writing to those who book and don't show up and by signposting patient to other health professionals so patients can be seen sooner. Pill checks can be done by many local pharmacies and is not necessary something you need to see you doctor for. Likewise the Hathersage centre is there for more complex health needs. The NHS in general is over subscribed but by choosing well and the right service for you needs, you can help the NHS meet this growing demand.

reviews.text: Would rate 0 Several complaints Try to make blood test appointment as instructed by gp but rude receptionist said no, make online. When made online, no contact. When it got done eventually after weeks and weeks it was after i had to chase many times. I have something positive to write. Without people like her, the gp would have been run into the ground by now. If this gp was only to visit nurses for the work they carry out. Its a 5/5. Practice response date: 3 months ago Practice response: Hello Pool, Thank you for your review. We do appreciate any reviews we receive, whether they be negative or positive, as they help us to make improvements to the practice that better patients. I was saddened to read about the multiple complaints you had with the practice, and that you believe our team (excluding nurse and two doctors) are rude, and they don’t care about patients. Whilst I understand that’s what you feel your experience reflects, that is not the case and our team does care deeply for patients. We appreciate it is frustrating when you’re turned away from your appointment for being late, that is why we have a grace period of 10 minutes per appointment. If a patient is more than 10 minutes late, they are asked to rebook their appointment, as still accommodating this appointment can really skew all the other appointments after it and lead to lengthy delays for other patients later on. The waiting room may look empty, but staff, especially doctors, have a huge list of responsibilities they need to do, including signing off prescriptions, arranging referrals, writing letters for patients, reviewing results, updating medical records, planning ongoing care, attending training and more. All of these take time and as they form important parts of patient care, need to be accommodated into a doctors working day. Unfortunately, I am unable to go into detail on each point you have made as I cannot confirm your identity. However, if you would like to make an official complaint and would like these incidents looking into, please fill out a feedback form on our website or speak to a member of the reception team. Kind Regards, Lauren Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: Bmanshter William
reviews.text: I did a swap test and I told the surgery I will be abroad for a month when the result will show up and I was clearly informed by the receptionist you can give us a call and will transfer the call to know your issue and what medication you need, I was very clear that I need to know the diagnosis so I can get the medication from the country am in since the issue is very severe with me and totally uncomfortable, I called the surgery and they refused to help me by any mean saying it is the rules that we don’t transfer calls and we cannot inform you your results not by a call or by email which I already sent before the call and was informed the same give us a call and will let the doctor speak to you! When I called they cannot do this and informed me I can go to any hospital in the country am in and tell them my issue and do it all over again or to wait for a month till am back to the country! This is absolutely non sense and waste in people health no sympathy not humane behaviour for sure!!! Practice response date: 2 years ago Practice response: Hello Em. Thank you for your review. I’m sorry to hear about your recent experience regarding your test results. The only time our reception team are able to give out test results is if they are normal. If a result has come back that you need further treatment to resolve, a receptionist would not be able to inform you of this as they are not medically trained to do so, and this could cause complications further down the line. This is why we request patients to make an appointment with the doctor to discuss their results. We aren’t able to simply transfer a call through to the doctor as there is a very high chance they are in the middle of another appointment with another patient who also needs their help. Booking an appointment also gives the doctor time to study your medical history and the test results so they have a clearer understanding of your issue. If a patient is unhappy to wait for a doctor to call them back, our team are trained to direct them to an alternative service where they are able to get medical treatment a little bit quicker, like a hospital or a walk-in centre. Kind Regards, Lauren, Engagement & Communications Officer

reviews.author: benna gomes
reviews.text: I am very disappointed with the way I was treated by a receptionist at this practice. I called regarding a prescription for my child, who has a longterm illness, as their medication was running low. During the call, I was unwell and struggling to remember the exact medication name, which is recorded on his medical file. Instead of receiving help, I was spoken to in a dismissive and impatient manner. My concerns about not understanding the prescription process were brushed off with comments such as “we’ve never had any concerns” and “no one has ever complained,” which did nothing to resolve the issue. Most concerning of all, the receptionist ended the call abruptly by hanging up on me. This was not just poor customer service, it was inappropriate given the seriousness of the situation and the vulnerability of patients contacting a GP practice. Parents calling about essential medication for a child with a long-term condition should be treated with basic professionalism and respect. I hope the practice reviews how front-desk staff handle patients, particularly in situations involving chronic illness and medication safety. Practice response date: a month ago Practice response: Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about your experience and the distress this caused. We aim to treat all patients with courtesy and respect, and we take concerns about communication seriously. Feedback such as this helps us review our processes and staff training to ensure our standards are maintained. Thank you for bringing this to our attention.

reviews.author: Dana Sharkas
reviews.text: I have been with this Practice for more than two years now. My experience has been a mixture between good and bad and here is why: Medical staff the two times a thorough follow up and requesting the right tests that led to serious diagnoses (one of them is hypothyroidism and the other is inflated gallbladder) were due to the good work of tow female medical staff members who put efforts to listen to me and ask the right questions. For the female medial staff members who’ve been in the practice in the past two years I give 5 starts. My experience however with male staff members was completely different. Before requesting the thyroid test by the female staff, another male doctor was taking my calls. For almost six months he kept insisting that my vitamins blood tests were ok (done 20 months before the consultations) and resisting doing new tests. He referred me to physiotherapy and offered a referral to psychotherapy but never occurred to him to check the Kidney, liver and thyroid like the female doctor did. After the results came back with underactive thyroid, I was referred to him again for explanation and was relieved that I finally knew the reason. His answer was don’t be so sure as we need to repeat the test twice to confirm. Later, during these two years my follow up on the symptoms and requests do more check were resisted often by other male staff members. One time I spoke to a senior doctor and ask him to explain the blood test, he did not know how to explain them so I asked to be referred to a specialist who can help me understand why my body in not settled until now, he shouted on the phone: no, will not refer you. If you want more tests check back in three months and hang up the phone! I kept having the abdominal pain and bloating until a new female doctor referred me to do an ultrasound and was then when we found the gallbladder problem. Phone system: was very bad in the past, then it was replaced with one that the line kept dropping after waiting for 40 minutes and when you manage to get hold to the reception staff, they will say they ran out of appointments for that day. Things have become better recently though, but you need to call at 8 am. Nurses: there have been several nurses in the past two years. One time I was asked to come and do the blood test again because the label was not fixed properly on the sample, so the lab refused to process it. Another time, I was called to do general check, weight, hight, blood pressure. The nurse measured my height while I was wearing heels! And insisted the scale was calibrated although it showed 4 KG discrepancy than 4 other different scales I used in the past few months. In the recent couple of months, medical staff have been more responsive, and they made some referral, and I am hoping the improvement will continue.

reviews.author: Daisy Moyle
reviews.text: Please if your a student and need a GP do not go here, I have been under this GP since my uni experience started a few years ago and it has been nothing but added stress throughout my long term health care issues. Every time a consultant has contacted in them in regards to information/a request for medication or treatment they have ignored,”lost” or simply forgot to contact me. I am never contacted in regards to important test results despite being told during these tests my doctor will ring me ASAP, I am ignored when I try to contact the GP manager. You will be more successful getting an appointment (as they’re apparently all gone by 8:15am) by calling 111 who will book you in to the appointments that are “taken”. If your health condition requires urgent care expect no urgency, if your medication is urgent expect it to be sent to the pharmacist in 4-6 week. Please avoid this GP at all costs, students coming and going seems to mean the GPS feel no patient commitment as they do not expect to be dealing with these people down the line when they eventually leave. I have dealt with stressed and overworked GPS before just not ones who seem so fed up and negligent towards their duty or care and patients. Told I had muscle pain, turned out to be a serious heart condition, amongst many other problems so please if you care about your health do not register here. UPDATE Since writing this review I have had referrals from consultants ignored, prescriptions never sent or acknowledged, multiple “lost results”, the survey claims a 4 week turn around for processing urgent test results, aka staff are sat in an office of results and it takes them four weeks to process can’t imagine how many people are waiting, during this time you won’t be told this it will be “still waiting for results” not we have received but still haven’t processed” whenever consultants chase up magically things are done, I suggest everybody takes up complaints with the NHS board as I have done because the practice truly doesn’t give a flying f*ck about anyone’s wellbeing. Avoid this GP practice like the plague.

reviews.author: Russell Lindley
reviews.text: In my experience this is one of the best NHS GP practices in the city, if not the North. It has a functional online booking system in addition to telephoning. The reception staff are generally professional and sympathetic. They have two sites in the city and they are opening a third soon. At some other GP practices in the city, the *only* way to get an appointment is by phoning first thing in the morning and hoping that they still have some slots available. By contrast, at Cornbrook it's usually possible to book routine appointments about 2-4 weeks in advance, and get more urgent appointments much more quickly. All GPs are struggling at the moment because the NHS is underfunded and overstretched in accordance with the government's austerity policies. Most of the negative reviews reflect that.

reviews.author: M Mariah
reviews.text: Had a very bad experience with dr elamin last summer , gave negative feedback through the website last year and no one has bothered to contact me . This dr prescribed me multiple rounds of flucanzole . Even though I had taken 6 months worth of this drug and it did not get rid of this thrush. Instead of referring me to a specialist straight away or doing a sensitivity swab, this dr decides to scream at me down the phone blaming this thrush on my lifestyle choices . There was one point where she prescribed me metronidazole gel and tells me this treats the bacteria that causes thrush. This is false . Metronidazole treats BV or trichomoniasis .i did not have either of these. No where on the NICE guidelines does it say metronidazole gel is second line or is treatment for thrush. I book tons of appointments in the summer and had put down in the e consult form that I wasn’t being taken seriously and then dr elamin finally refers me to gynaecology and gives me more flucanazole. I was then given a sensitivity swab by a different doctor. Come to find out this thrush strain is actually resistant to flucanzole.thats why it wasn’t going away I’m still experiencing this thrush and it has drastically impacted my quality of life. It baffles me that this practise hires doctors who are meant to “specialise in women’s health” but actually know nothing about it at all.

reviews.author: Im Me
reviews.text: My appointment was with Nurse Ozaz, and I originally attended just to have my bloods done. However, upon my arrival, she took the time to gather all the necessary information and carried out a full check including my weight, height, blood tests, and blood pressure. Although I only expected a simple blood test, she went above and beyond, and I’m truly grateful that she did. Her thoroughness allowed her to pick up on an issue that would have been missed if she had only carried out the blood test. I cannot thank her enough. This was my first time meeting her, but she made me feel completely comfortable and at ease. Professionals like her show how passionate they are about their work and how much they genuinely care for their patients. If everyone received the level of care I experienced today, the world would be a much better place. I wish there were a thousand more individuals like her. Her mannerism, politeness, caring approach, and positive attitude truly made me smile. I would like to say a very big thank you to her for going above and beyond. Never change, and always stay the wonderful person you are. You are a star, Nurse Ozaz.

reviews.author: M Mariah
reviews.text: Had a very bad experience with dr elamin last summer , gave negative feedback through the website last year and no one has bothered to contact me . This dr prescribed me multiple rounds of flucanzole . Even though I had taken 6 months worth of this drug and it did not get rid of this thrush. Instead of referring me to a specialist straight away or doing a sensitivity swab, this dr decides to scream at me down the phone blaming this thrush on my lifestyle choices . There was one point where she prescribed me metronidazole gel and tells me this treats the bacteria that causes thrush. This is false . Metronidazole treats BV or trichomoniasis .i did not have either of these. No where on the NICE guidelines does it say metronidazole gel is second line or is treatment for thrush. I book tons of appointments in the summer and had put down in the e consult form that I wasn’t being taken seriously and then dr elamin finally refers me to gynaecology and gives me more flucanazole. I was then given a sensitivity swab by a different doctor. Come to find out this thrush strain is actually resistant to flucanzole.thats why it wasn’t going away I’m still experiencing this thrush and it has drastically impacted my quality of life. It baffles me that this practise hires doctors who are meant to “specialise in women’s health” but actually know nothing about it at all.

reviews.author: Im Me
reviews.text: My appointment was with Nurse Ozaz, and I originally attended just to have my bloods done. However, upon my arrival, she took the time to gather all the necessary information and carried out a full check including my weight, height, blood tests, and blood pressure. Although I only expected a simple blood test, she went above and beyond, and I’m truly grateful that she did. Her thoroughness allowed her to pick up on an issue that would have been missed if she had only carried out the blood test. I cannot thank her enough. This was my first time meeting her, but she made me feel completely comfortable and at ease. Professionals like her show how passionate they are about their work and how much they genuinely care for their patients. If everyone received the level of care I experienced today, the world would be a much better place. I wish there were a thousand more individuals like her. Her mannerism, politeness, caring approach, and positive attitude truly made me smile. I would like to say a very big thank you to her for going above and beyond. Never change, and always stay the wonderful person you are. You are a star, Nurse Ozaz.

reviews.author: Ian Shelmerdine
reviews.text: Feedback for Dr Bahemia I found the appointment a benefit since it was unexpected. My doctor was attentive, listened to my talk about my symptoms and concerns and shared their own options with a colleague to ensure they were giving me the best treatment. I was also impressed with the length of time for my appointment which ensured I did not feel rushed or stressed. However my one concern is that, because I am still having the symptoms and chest pain, no further investigation, apart from an echocardiogram, was agreed on to diagnose my problem and treat it. I have kept this feedback in the link reply since the review box was not blank when I opened the current link for Dr Shafiq. 5 star Dr Shafiq was very focused with the examination and ensured that the urgent nature of my consultation, due to 24 AmbBP results, was in no way something to worry about. He was receptive to the answers I gave during the consultation and made sure that the results of the AmbBP and ECG taken at the practice were explained in detail. His concern and subsequent decision based on the ECG and chest pain observed during my examination were explained and the need for further cardiac tests at the MRI understood. He was also firm in his insistence in my not walking or getting public transport to a and e. The correct decision which his persuasion got over to me. Once again I have been impressed by the care and service given by the practice and it's staff. I must also put a word in for the person who took the ECG readings and their professionalism and approach. Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Dear Ian, thank you so very much for taking the time to leave us a 5 star review. May we join Dr Bahemia in wishing you a speedy and uneventful recovery. Team MIMP

reviews.text: The doctors and nurses here are so kind. This has been my local gp for the past 15 years. They are so down to earth and helpful. Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Dear Maryan, thank you so very much for taking the time to provide us with a 5 star review and your kind words in relation to the care you receive from our service. reviews.text: I’ve been trying to log into the NHS app for over a year now; I have gone into the practice to get help to no avail, I have rang in several times to which they’ve made me fill in a form each time and had no response or help after it, they have also asked me to go into the practice and show my ID which when I did no one knew what was going on or how that would help?! I am trying to see results from tests to know what is happening with my health and I am getting nowhere. The service is horrific. Practice response date: 4 months ago Practice response: Dear Nabila, thank you for taking the time to provide feedback. We are sorry we have not been able to remedy matters for you. We would wish to try and resolve your concern and as such would be grateful if you could contact the practice and ask for the our complaints manager Jacqui.
