reviews.author: Joyce Dutton
reviews.text: Same day appointment given by polite and efficient receptionist for bith my husband and myself. Saw Vivienne Murphy who I have seen before and been very satisfied with. Very pleased again with both sympathetic professional approach. Add her humour and we came out feeling much relieved. Up to Fairfield for Xray. Again good service. Thankyou all.

reviews.author: Beatrice Gaffney
reviews.text: Just been to see Dr Chadha at Minden. An excellent doctor who is polite and friendly, with an impressive depth of knowledge. He takes the time to explain everything clearly, listens carefully, and nothing is ever too much trouble. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Zohaib S
reviews.text: Poor admin staff (call centre I'm assuming?) I waited 30 minutes for what I thought was a physio appointment - only for me to enter the Dr's office - with no physio in sight!

reviews.author: Karen Unsworth
reviews.text: On going issues with my right ear, saw I nurse today and came away with nothing, didn't listen doubt if she had read my notes, an ache below the ear clicking throughout the night very moist in the morning, her advice ibuprofen or paracetamol I can't take either, I asked for otomize? she couldn't give me a prescription can't see an infection yet, it will come going by my history so thanks for nothing.

reviews.author: quackers gaming
reviews.text: Terrible! Dr.Avoid Chadha Puneet.Never come across such a patronising dismissive Dr before.keeps repeating the word ‘Yeah’ & doesn’t seem to listen properly.UNPROFESSIONAL!!

reviews.author: greg johnson
reviews.text: Unorganised chaos, everyone has to call at 8am and join a que with 100 other people. Then when you get through to staff they are rude

reviews.author: John M
reviews.text: Pathetic

reviews.author: Gillian Williamson
reviews.text: I’m really happy with this practice. They are proactive. Dad was at a different practice until this week and they let us down badly over the course of three weeks. We have moved here and l am really impressed with the care and attention already. Thanks Minden.

reviews.author: Ashraf Shaaban
reviews.text: One of the worst medical facilities you can see in your life. The reception staff is uncooperative. They are not qualified in customer service at all.

reviews.author: Ann Barber
reviews.text: I know it's harder to get appointments these days, but I cannot speak more highly of the way I have been treated at Minden. I made an appointment because I felt under the weather. I was seen, referred to a rapid diagnostic clinic and diagnosed with a form of cancer very quickly. They have been wonderful.all I can say is they are doing what they can with the resources they have. Please put yourself in the staff's position...would you want to be treated as badly as they get treated, it's NOT their fault.

reviews.author: Hugo McKellor
reviews.text: I’m surprised at the bad reviews, I’ve never struggled to reach them or make an appointment ever. The staff warm and welcoming, definitely an asset to this GP practice. I would say this is the best practice in Bury as their care and value is a reflection of their hard work and efforts.

reviews.author: Koko Margo
reviews.text: Had to make an emergency telephone appointment, as a face to face would take a month to arrange. Never got the call. Called them twice to confirm I'm still on the nurses call list which they said I was, mind you these confirmation calls took around an hour to get through. Called in the next day, only to have the phone hung up on me. I wasn't even rude, I was literally enquiring why I didn't get the call. I don't know if the operator didn't want to chase it up or if it was an actual accident but when I called back a second later, and I was 62nd in the queue. changing my GP, what's the point of having one if I can't even use it.

reviews.author: Allegra Bosnjak
reviews.text: Had a really great experience this week. The man at the reception (dark hair, not sure of his name) was absolutely brilliant, as well as the nurse I spoke to regarding my travel vaccinations (Lorraine). Thank you!

reviews.author: Danuta Polomska
reviews.text: I can make 0 stars if it possible . Very poor practises , immposible to ring , Im waiting today more than one hour and still missed phone . IM here only for my amazing doctor, everyone else is rubbish

reviews.author: Christine Turner
reviews.text: Just trying the get in touch and speak to someone gives me stress

reviews.author: Zoe Briscoe
reviews.text: Been with these drs for a while now, they’re never any help. I have really bad mental health and I’m constantly fighting a loosing battle with them. They constantly shut me down and never help.

reviews.author: ella rose xx
reviews.text: wish i could rate it 0 the worst doctors i’ve ever known. been in pain everyday for so so long now and it’s impossible to get an appointment. i join the queue for a call back and as soon as i answer the phone gets out down on me, not everyone has time to make an appointment in person so im basically just left to suffer while i pay taxes for this absolutey awful service. its not just me who feels this way either my family and freinds all say the same thing, looking for something me higher up to complain to asap.

reviews.author: David Tranter
reviews.text: Excellent service excellent support staff and superb GP The one problem is the misuse of disabled car parking spaces used by M & S shoppers and its a paients only car park , needs policing or barrier with tokens

reviews.author: Bradley Green
reviews.text: They're constantly signing for posted prescriptions that are not theirs to sign for (i'm not even a minden patient, i'm with rock healthcare, and the post is for the pharmacy, not minden) and then holding them hostage at their reception. To make any progress you either have to stand in the queue at their practice which is always super long, due to one receptionist being on at any given time, and speak to a receptionist who doesn't know anything about anything, or wait on hold in the phone queue for hours and hours and not have your query resolved. Minden, Rock Healthcare and the Pharmacy are all as bad each other but Minden are getting the 1* review because of how inconvenient they have been to my life. I'm just thankful that it wasn't medication that I need to stay alive because I'd probably be dead by now

reviews.author: Vincent Manning
reviews.text: Receptionist today useless bit of common sense wouldn't go a miss

reviews.author: Stamina Power
reviews.text: The employees are uncooperative and deal with aggression, trying to hinder people.

reviews.author: Julie Greenland
reviews.text: Very poor with mental health. They think by sending you of what antidepressant they arevpromiting solves all. When I asked for a blood test for the menopause they sent me for the wrong one. Ask my gp is a joke as is trying to getva face to face appointment. You can no longer book in advance. Once I have my menopause confirmed I am looking to leave. When I first joined this practice it was great. Its going downhill fast

reviews.author: Shahida Shafi
reviews.text: This is really bad if your reading this don't use this doctors I have two children and I can't get a appointment it's been 2 years I've joined and never seen a doctor it's really bad the gp app does not let you book and the phone line is engaged it's now 9am

reviews.author: Pop Izzz
reviews.text: Doctor Champman realy listend to me & is lovely.i I am grateful and now have hope. Which i have not had for 3 years. All the doctors are nice & try their best for us. The receptionist are lovely and most nurses Not a nice experience by one i felt sunken basicaly. Dont want others to feel the same. Patients need kindness not to feel condescended. Especialy when most people are ill or in pain..

reviews.author: Karen Ambery
reviews.text: I would like thank doc c Peterson for his rapid help on 26/4/23,he took my problem seriously and was very efficient, thank-you

reviews.author: adele mckinley
reviews.text: Reception very friendly always helpful nurses and doctors go above and beyond to help you

reviews.author: Phillip Evans
reviews.text: I have been with the Minden practice since February 1999 and recently I have phoned in to see a doctor on on the past 2 occasions in the past 2 months. The 1st time in was in October 2022 and I finally got a call back from a doctor 24 hours later. During this time I had had to call out the on call doctor to see me. The 2nd time in November 2022, I never even got a phone call back to find out why or an appointment. I cannot use ask my GP and I will not, because I feel there is no way the doctor can do a proper diagnoses over a video link. Since the Minden joined the Tower Practice group it has been rapidly going downhill. The receptionists are trying their best, but are being let down by the doctors.

reviews.author: Charlotte Anderson
reviews.text: First time attending today, the doctor was wonderful and very attentive to my baby, sat and spoke to her constantly and quickly diagnosed the issue, couldn't fault.

reviews.author: Ashraf Shaaban
reviews.text: I would like to put zero star, I have never seen employees in this way lazy and uncooperative at all. I asked for a simple document in any center in the world to be issued within minutes. Now I have days and they are extremely indifferent

reviews.author: mark dixon
reviews.text: I have been waiting for a sick note for nearly 2 weeks. All I got from one of the receptionist was screen shot my request and show it to my employer of proof. The next thing she said was it's all Rishi Sunaks fault. So Priminister if you read this can you write me one out please it will be quicker than Minden. I would give the practice zero points but you have to click on something to start.

reviews.author: Helen Doughty
reviews.text: This practice is appalling. Despite how urgent your request is, you cannot get a ‘clinician’ to call you back in any less than a week, if at all. They avoid having to see patients. I know I have a bad chest infection and need antibiotics, it’s a simple request, but 3 weeks later I cannot talk to anyone. I need someone to listen to my chest but it’s impossible. Meanwhile I have barely slept for 3 weeks due to excess coughing. I feel like reporting them. I am definitely changing practices as soon as I am well enough.

reviews.author: Stephanie Irwin
reviews.text: Every 2 months I use the ask my GP service and I never can get on. It states 8 - 11 but it never is. Resulting into me phoning up to be seen to, which will be answered by a member of staff who is always abrupt and rude. Makes me nervous every time I ring up so I choose not too even as a last resort. The staff need a attitude check and the GP service needs to be sorted. I dread it every 2 months

reviews.author: Alex curran
reviews.text: Got one prescription every month, always put in with pharmacy, never get, told by pharmacy they have not received from doctors, every month this happens, took 7 days and numerous phone calls to get it from doctors, asked for a emergency telephone appointment and was told doctor would ring me, still waiting 10 hours later, closed now for weekend, probably get back to me in 6 months

reviews.author: Judy Mellor
reviews.text: This doctors surgery is an abomination. You can't get an appt with a doctor if you ring up and Ask My GP is even worse. Have been waiting for 2 weeks now for a "clinician" to reply to my medical request. All I get when I chase it up is, You are on the list and 2 weeks is the norm. Do you have to be dying to see a doctor these days!!!!! NOT HAPPY.

reviews.author: Anthony Wilde
reviews.text: It's a doctor's so it's okay if you need some medical assistant.

reviews.author: Carol Howard
reviews.text: Felt really ill phoned doctor, after going through the fiasco of first phoning Tottington, listening to umpteen messages. It was Friday afternoon, told no appointments, asked what could I do, I felt really ill, told ring 111 (tried that first. Gave up after waiting 30mins for the phone to be answered) use askmygp, also tried that it, was closed,told if I felt it was urgent go to casualty, eventually the pharmacy helped, now I ask my pharmacy for help first, conclusion don't be ill after 11am

reviews.author: holly smethurst
reviews.text: If you’ve look lower you will see another complain from me and th saga continues! After trying to rearrange an appointment I was told the receptionists don’t have the authority to book appointments I have to rebook the same phone consultation with the doctor for them to rebook the appointment and that would be in 3 weeks time. I have ended up in a and e because my condition has worsened and I now need surgery I wouldn’t have needed had I been seen earlier. I’ve just been back in to book doctors appointment as per a and E advice only to be told I have to book a telephone call with the doctor who will then book an appointment if I need one, despite ghem having the discharge notes from a & e with request from a and e doctor for an appointment. Rachel the office manager is patraonising and I feel sorry for the guys on the desk having to work under this ridiculous policy!

reviews.author: Mick Whelan
reviews.text: I've been a patient with Minden for nearly 17 year's the last 8 month's have been nothing short of a joke I know the NHS is underpressure ect but making me lose money with work just to sort a prescription for medication that I have been on for over 3 year's not on.

reviews.author: David Thomas
reviews.text: I contacted the practice via AskmyGP on Friday 22 April and advised that I was away and could I please have a contact on my return. At 08.05 on Tuesday April 26 Dr Rolland contacted me, asked me some questions and I had an appointment with her at 09.30. I had some bloods taken today 28 April by Mike. I can do no more than thank them both for their efficency and care delivered with such a friendly and comforting attitude.

reviews.author: sarah ellison
reviews.text: Staff talk to you in a passive aggressive manner, staff lie to cover there own backs, staffs don't send refferals when they're supposed to and swear blind they did, unless they where floating about in cyber space for 5 days who knows. We're seriously looking into finding out how to reporting to these to health governing bodies, just when we think we've turned a corner with them, they once again revert back to their old callous ways. Nothing more than a business this. Each patient is ££.

reviews.author: Jill Budgen
reviews.text: Been in Extreme pain in shoulder since December been off from work since. Trying to get hold of a sick note is a joke. I requested a sick note over a week ago and eventually got signed off by a gp asking what’s the problem. I need this sick note to get paid. Can’t even see a doctor. The receptionist does my ears in as she speaks loudly that everyone can hear. My mum fell a month ago went to the surgery to see if she could see a doctor same receptionist said no. Mum had appointment with the wound clinic even the nurse rang the surgery, even though the wound clinic is on first floor and minden on 3rd the receptionist said no to the nurse. My mum is her 70s had mini strokes plus had breast cancer. Oh yes also they mess around with my mums prescription for cancer that she has to take every day for 5 years. Mum has missed some days due to them not getting her prescription done in time. I’ve been with minden since moving up here when I was 2 now think it’s time for a change. Please if minden staff read this please quieten down that receptionist. I’ve been accuse of shouting at a receptionist which I was speaking normally, is this how they get rid of patients. Minden use to good now it’s gone done hill since 2018. In 2018 I rang for appointment only be told no appointment. I had to go in for my dads prescription only to find an extremely empty waiting room only me and the male receptionist in the waiting room.

reviews.author: brenda smith smith
reviews.text: Dr Hagney always goes the extra mile, so a big thank you.

reviews.author: halcia78
reviews.text: Worst practice. It's impossible to see a doctor. My daughter has been waiting three weeks for a phone appointment. The Ask my GP app has an empty list of doctors working for two weeks.

reviews.author: Lorraine Jones
reviews.text: I used to think this practice was really good but how can someone decide that you will be contacted within 2 weeks when you are in a lot of pain and restricted use. Also not had regular lithium checks that should be every 3 month disappointed in this practice

reviews.author: Alan Tattersall
reviews.text: Worse practise in Bury, I have been poorly since New Years day contacted practise via ask my doctor been passed from Tottington to Bury had various test including six bloods and six prescriptions and at no time do I get a call with the results, this week I have requested a call from a doctor via the app everyday after receiving a letter to contact Tottington practice last Saturday, three of the requests are still open with no reply. Eventually made a call to Tottington practise and was told not registered there and will need to call Minden ( very rude receptionist) called Minden eventually got through was advised a doctor would call me, it’s now five days later and still no call. Time to change Doctors.

reviews.author: Jordan Lyon
reviews.text: Extremely rude receptionist named leanne. She just put the phone down on me when I asked for her name. I was only trying to find out were MY medication was as its due today and not been approved by the gp yet AGAIN.

reviews.author: Des Kelly
reviews.text: Service, appointment system and the app are a disgrace. I've had to take time off work more than 3 times recently because their systems don't work and you can't get to speak to a real person

reviews.author: kaysha leigh
reviews.text: Appalling service … ask my gp app closes by 7:45 after days of trying to get an appointment. Finally get through on Thursday after trying from Monday and had to call at 5:50 to remind them I hadn’t had a call back . Then to be met with a rude condescending and and contradicting gp . They are quiet happy to leave people suffering the debilitating effects of fibromyalgia because they know very little about it … here’s an idea learn ! Not one dr knows what the other is doing and there’s no continuous care from the same dr which in turn leads to miss lead information contradictions and a complete lack of understanding and empathy… when you have a gp ask you what they should do it’s clear there is a huge problem . patients aren’t trained in medicine and mores the point can’t think straight because of fibro fog and exhaustion from the lack of any sleep . Repeat Prescriptions of necessary meds have to be chased up And re requested 2 and 3 times as there never signed off or sent to the pharmacy as stated . I’ve been with this practice for almost 40 years and never has it ever been so bad . Complaints here are a waste of time rug and sand spring to mind . Regrettably this time above them is the only option available something has to change the care here is deplorable . There should really be an option of 0 ⭐️

reviews.author: Daniel Pollard
reviews.text: Daniel Pollard2 reviewsEdited 4 years ago

reviews.author: Katherina Selby
reviews.text: This surgery used to be decent. Now there's one decent Dr and one decent nurse. Ever since the Ask My GP app was introduced, we can no longer get appointments unless a client is booking that appointment as soon as the app opens at 7am. First they would switch it off at 11am and then slowly they began to switch it off earlier and earlier. Now, it's switched off at 9:30am! Absolutely ridiculous. My daughter had a letter referred to them as a "matter of urgency" by a hospital, yet they waited 2 weeks before they sent it to me and posted it 2nd class. I definitely would not recommend this surgery and would advise you go elsewhere.

reviews.author: Candice Burridge
reviews.text: I have been with this practice since I was a little girl. I can't fault it. I won't name my Dr but he is absolutely brilliant. Professional but so down to earth. Even through covid the service is fantastic. I think askmygp is great and I'm pleased to hear it's something the practice is continuing to use. Keep up the excellent work guys. Every single staff member this is to you too.

reviews.author: Claire Grantham
reviews.text: My son had treatment for a ingrowing toe nail 20/05/2021, was treated by a nurse called Lorraine I was so impressed by her care that I just had to leave a review. What an absolutely amazing kind , caring polite woman really made my son feel at ease whilist he was having his treatment. Thank you again.

reviews.author: Laura Jones
reviews.text: Got given the wrong medication from a doctor that had not read my previous notes. Make me very poorly and took me weeks to get off them. Changed doctors now definitely won't be going back there

reviews.author: Lee Green branagan
reviews.text: Ive been with minden doctors since 1970 all my life and I could not ask for a better practice yes its hard sometimes to get to see a gp there but ive always been able to get help and advice from minden and if needed to be seen thay have always managed to fit me in.

reviews.author: Steve Hepworth
reviews.text: I've been with Minden since it was quite a small practice. However, in the last few years it has gone rapidly downhill. It's gone from not being able to get a face to face appointment with a GP you know for a couple of weeks, to not being able to get an appointment with any GP for weeks. Even a telephone appointment is unlikely for over a week! This is in no way a critique on the quality of the GP's who actually work in the practice, as I couldn't properly comment on what they're like as I can very rarely get to see one! It seems that this practice is too big and has too many patients to cope. It does not therefore provide quality healthcare. In fact, it could be argued that you are sometimes effectively without healthcare at this practice.

reviews.author: Sue Williams
reviews.text: I called the doctors Friday morning and spoke to the receptionist. She informed me the doctor would ring back within the hour. Ten minutes later Dr. Norman rang sorted a prescription for me to pick up at my nearest Pharmacy. What outstanding service by him and his team.

reviews.author: Elaine Whittle
reviews.text: Tried all day to speak to receptionist after 15 mins you are cut off. So another day before you can get any advice or antibiotics. As always probably not enough staff

reviews.author: Trevor Davies
reviews.text: Not happy with minden after over 20 years so time to move on to another practice for me !

reviews.author: JOHN-CARL MYLREA
reviews.text: Highly avoid, especially Dr Norman. Far to many patients, takes two months for an appointment and even that ends up being over the phone, he hasn't got a clue, hes just cointing down the days till his next holiday, pathetic doctor and an unorganised practice. Less than a star if possible.

reviews.author: Jay Thornley
reviews.text: Terrible. End of

reviews.author: barbara ackers
reviews.text: It's not often that I need to go to the doctors. I admit I struggled getting in to see a gp when I needed one and felt rushed when I finally got an appointment. The staff at Moorgate, however were great. The receptionist was very friendly and was able to direct me to the appropriate people. The staff in the treatment room on floor one were very helpful and went out of their way to make sure that all my concerns were addressed and Gill and Lorraine (sister) made me feel at ease during examinations. I work for the NHS and all too often find that people just like to focus on negatives and not the positives.

reviews.text: Absolutely shocking awful GP. I am diagnosed PCOS patient that just needed a referral for a fertility treatment. After moving to Bolton I registered with this GP hoping for the best knowing I would need a referral as a patient that deals with PCOS for years. I came in January to ask for the referral. I found out about in July after 7 months of waiting for the treatment! Finally,my referral was sent out by the end of July. I still didn’t hear anything about appointment for my treatment so I called Royal Bolton that advised me to ask GP for a letter to speed up my referral. So I made telephone consultation with Dr Khan(the same thy told me he would refer me right away back in January)to ask for it. He said he would issue the letter. This consultation took place last Monday. So I came with my husband last Friday to ask what is going on with the letter. I was told it would be done today and I would be able to see it in the app. I kept checking and still nothing! Absolutely shocking! Not to mention in the meantime of all of it back in April I was bleeding and in pain and I was told by Dr Khan that it’s fine and I should wait for fertility appointment as it would be addressed then! reviews.author: Royalty x Tehmeh
reviews.text: I’m writing this as a patient who feels deeply let down by the GP system in Bolton. I developed what started as a cold burn, which has since turned into an open wound. It has still not healed and remains untreated properly despite me contacting my GP surgery on two separate occasions. During my first visit, I was prescribed antibiotics. What concerned me most was that the doctor appeared unsure about the condition and searched online during the appointment to understand what it was and how to treat it. Seeing a medical professional rely on an internet search in front of me made me feel unsafe and worried that they didn’t fully understand what they were dealing with. I was given antibiotics and sent home, but there was no proper wound care, cleaning or dressing provided. The wound has still not healed. I attended again on the 11 march because I was worried about infection and the lack of improvement. I waited for around an hour past my appointment time due to other issues at the practice, which I understand can happen when services are extremely busy. However, when I was finally seen, the appointment itself lasted only about two- three minutes. The doctor briefly looked at the wound and said I would be referred elsewhere. When I asked how long that would take, I was told “not long — around two weeks.” I left feeling shocked and frustrated and I’m not someone who is outspoken so I couldn’t even ask the questions I truly wanted to ask, especially when I feel rushed in an environment. I don’t understand why a GP service cannot provide basic wound care such as cleaning the injury and applying the correct dressing. Being told to wait weeks with an open wound feels unacceptable and distressing. I understand GP practices are under pressure and very busy and I am willing to put some delays down to how packed the surgery was. However, patients should still feel properly assessed, treated, and reassured especially when dealing with an open wound that risks 🥀infection🥀. This situation has left me asking some serious questions about our health care quality • What is the role of a GP if basic treatment isn’t provided? • Why are patients left waiting with untreated wounds? • What are we paying taxes for if essential frontline care isn’t accessible? My visit to this GP has shown me that quantity over quality is more valued. I understand the pressures on the National Health Service and that staff are often overstretched. However, patients should still feel safe, listened to and properly treated. Right now, I feel dismissed and let down by a system that is supposed to provide timely and 🥀competent care🥀.

reviews.author: Nadeesha Fernando
reviews.text: Very disappointing experience. I arrived at 4:00 pm for my 4:10 pm appointment while being 34 weeks pregnant. I had also just picked up my two daughters from school and they were very hungry. The doctor did not call me until around 4:50 pm. During the wait, I saw him talking with a member of staff inside the room. When I asked the receptionist at about 4:45 pm, I was first told the doctor was dealing with a patient on the phone. Later I was told he was speaking with the manager. I understand delays can happen, but waiting around 40 minutes in this situation was very difficult, especially while heavily pregnant and with two children after school. If the doctor needed time for a meeting, appointments should not be given at that time. Very disappointing service and poor time management.

reviews.author: A Ali
reviews.text: I have generally found the practice staff to be polite and professional, however there is a persistent issue that really needs addressing. The doors inside the building bang extremely loudly every time they close, which is very disruptive and unpleasant, especially in what should be a calm healthcare environment. This could easily be resolved by properly adjusting the doors or installing soft-close door dampers to prevent them from slamming. It would make a significant difference to patient comfort and create a much more peaceful atmosphere. I hope the practice considers fixing this soon, as it would greatly improve the overall experience.

reviews.author: angharad Roberts
reviews.text: multiple bad experiences of this practice, it took more than 6 months to send my fertility referral off and i was advised on multiple occasions this has been done , i contacted one day and requested a copy of the referral letter to then be advised there wasn't one as the referral had been noted but nothing sent, if i hadn't of requested the proof i would still be waiting, the manger was great in resolving this but a shame the staff wrongly advised for so long. I went in today for an appointment at 9am for my Flu jab and whilst waiting 20 mints in reception I witnessed one side of a receptionist dealing with a difficult patient on the phone who wanted an appointment today and understandably the surgery didn't have any left to offer, the manor she was speaking to the difficult patient was disgusting and no where near the level of service a receptionist should be trained to, after this call ended the manor she then spoke to patients waiting at reception was beyond me, a witnessed her being abrupt and rude to at least 5 patients and this stemmed from her being annoyed with the previous call she had to deal with. In a customer focused job role you need to have the ability to stay calm and respect people around you and she clearly didn't have this ability, we sometimes have to deal with difficult people but the ability to bounce back and smile at the next person is a must for a doctors receptionist where people are already stressed due to being sick. I will certainly now be looking for an alternative doctors as witnessing what i did today was terribly upsetting. reviews.author: Teresa
reviews.text: I am very disappointed with the care I received my experience with Dr. Jay was particularly troubling. Two weeks ago, I visited the clinic with an eye allergy. Dr. Jay refused to prescribe steroids, saying it would not be good for me in the future. Despite my insistence, he said no. The next day, I had a severe asthma attack, and only then prescribe the steroids I initially requested. This delay in proper treatment worsened my condition significantly. To make matters worse, I had an appointment today for allergy tests, but the clinic did not have any record of the specific tests I needed the Doctor who requested my blood test had forgotten to note which blood tests to perform. As a result, my appointment was rescheduled for next Friday, which is incredibly inconvenient and frustrating. This level of unprofessionalism and lack of care is unacceptable. It seems like the clinic does not prioritize their patients health and well-being. I hope this review brings attention to these issues so that future patients do not have to experience the same negligence. reviews.author: Vee Matt
reviews.text: There are so many things that could be done better at Bolton General Practice but judging by the reviews, they have no intention of improving their services. Where do I start? From the very beginning they messed up my appointment. I had a telephone interview on the 7th of June but they couldn't even leave a message to let me know it was cancelled. Then randomly I received a call on the 11th of June instead when the nurse Gemma told me she had been sick. That's ok, it would have been nice to have been informed by the admin staff but it was fine. We then booked an appointment for today at 8am because I informed her that I start work at 8:30am. She (Gemma) assured me that she would be in the Practice from 8am anyways so not to worry. This is where it gets worse. I arrive before 8am but wait outside until 8am then make my way to reception. I inform them about my appointment. Now, it would have been great if the receptionists had told me at that point that Gemma wasn't actually in. I would have happily rearranged my appointment and left so I could make it to work on time. Instead, they let me sit there even though I asked a couple times if they could please check with her as I didn't want to be late. One receptionist told me she wasn't logged in so she couldn't check which was obviously not true as I realised later that Gemma hadn't arrived yet. Then at 8:07am, a lady strolls in and doesn't acknowledge me so I didn't know at this point that it was Gemma. She casually checks her schedule and talks with the receptionists briefly then goes into a consultation room. She comes out a couple times and goes back in without once acknowledging me, despite knowing that I had specifically booked an appointment with her for 8am. At 8:12am, one of the receptionist whispers to the other and I catch the name "Gemma". I guess at this point, even she realises that she should be proactive and do something. She then goes into the same consultation room the lady went in earlier. She comes out in a few seconds and tells me that Gemma won't be long. It's at this point I know that the lady was Gemma. Gemma never once acknowledged me. Surely, if you're late for an appointment you would apologise for being late especially as you knew I was waiting. It's funny because if a patient had been even 5mins late, their appointment would have been cancelled. At 8:15am, I'd had enough. I was going to be late for work and Gemma had yet to come out of the room. At what time was she going to begin? All I wanted was some travel vaccines! I then go to the reception and tell them I'm leaving as I had to go to work. I guess Gemma overhears the conversation through the open door of the consultation room because for the first time, she comes out and addresses me. I wasn't rude and never raised my voice. I just calmly informed them that I couldn't wait any longer as I was going to be late. Gemma then tells me that she getting the vaccines ready and was stuck in traffic which is why she was late, and that she was almost done. The thing is, she knew I was coming today. It's ok if you're late but at least address the patient waiting for you! Only when I was leaving did she come out and address me. Also, why didn't the receptionists just tell me she was running late as I specifically told them I had to be at work for 8:30am and I was there to see Gemma. In addition, there were other staff I'm assuming were doctors and nurses chatting and laughing just around the corner. One even walked back and forth, looking directly at me. Could none have asked to help? I guess this is another reason the NHS is going downhill. It is already nearly impossible to book an appointment so what do they do all day? Anyways, this was a long rant but I had to get it off my chest. I rarely go to the doctors, last time was probably over 2yrs ago and still they are incompetent. I now do not have enough time to find another GP, register and then book travel vaccines before I go away so I'm having to go without any travel vaccines. Thanks Bolton General Practice for nothing!

reviews.author: AM 90's
reviews.text: Exceptional Care To the Practice Manager at The Rock Healthcare, I am writing to share my recent experience at the Moorgate Primary Care Centre. I attended an appointment for my son’s blood test on the first floor, and I wanted to express my sincere gratitude for the outstanding care we received from a nurse named Michelle. From the moment we arrived, Michelle welcomed us with a beautiful smile and a warm energy that immediately put us at ease. In the rush of the day, I had unfortunately forgotten to bring my son’s labels and had failed to apply his numbing cream an hour prior to the appointment. As a parent, this was a stressful realization, but Michelle handled the situation with the utmost professionalism and kindness. Rather than simply turning us away, she was incredibly gentle and understanding. She took the time to explain exactly how to apply the cream and kindly arranged a new time slot for us to return later that same day. When we returned, Michelle greeted us with the same wonderful smile. My son has autism, and medical environments can often be challenging for him. However, Michelle was so incredibly patient and gentle that I felt entirely at ease throughout the entire process. I told her at the time, but I want to reiterate: Michelle is one of the most wonderful professionals I have ever met. She clearly takes immense pride in her work and treats her patients with genuine heart. She turned what could have been a very difficult day into a positive experience that made me feel truly happy and supported. Please ensure this feedback is shared with Michelle and her supervisors. She is a credit to your team and a shining example of what exceptional healthcare looks like. Thank you, Michelle! Best regards, Amir Abbas

reviews.text: I have been a patient at Rock Healthcare and I am extremely impressed by the whole team. Dr Rasha Ibrahim is professional, attentive and patient. She always takes the time to explain everything clearly and I feel well supported and cared for. The reception staff and the team who help with booking appointments are friendly, efficient, soft-spoken and focused, which makes it easy to access care when needed. The entire practice provides a welcoming, professional and patient-centred service. I would highly recommend Rock Healthcare, with Dr Ibrahim in particular providing exceptional care.Your service doesn’t go unnoticed.

reviews.author: ELM
reviews.text: Saw Charles the nurse today and what a lovely person he is! I arrived late - stressed with my two children for a family appointment after horrendous traffic in Bury and Charles was so patient and good humoured. My children who both have autism were so calm because Charles was. He was able to help me with my asthma and explain things I didn’t know regarding my inhaler. It was end of day so we were lucky to have a bit more of his time but the whole experience was so positive. We moved to this practice a year ago and I can honestly say the reception team and medical staff have all been so supportive and remember that compassion, empathy and good humour, go such a long way to calm stressed people. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Mark Robinson
reviews.text: Worst reception ever! Family of 4 and 4 times this year they have cocked up. They book you in and when you bet there they tell you “Oh it’s booked for tomorrow” despite confirming same-day appointment! They book you in and not telling you It’s at the Radcliffe doctors when you live in bury. Never have in had a doctors this incompetent! Only lived here 1 year and wow constant cockups!

reviews.author: Kay Brown
reviews.text: I tried to register on the NHS website but needed photo ID which I dont have. The w ebsite advised to contact the surgery for a linkage key, etc. I went in person to be told I cant do it without photo ID, when NHS website says I can. They are totally incompetant reception staff & extremely unhelpful. Judging by the reviews they have been for years & dont really care about bad reviews. Ive been with them 20 years + but still have to prove my identity, who have they been treating for the last 20+ years then. Time to change Drs like everyone else appears to be doing

reviews.author: Kath
reviews.text: Great practice! Lovely reception staff, nurses and doctors. The young man on the front desk was extremely helpful and polite! Appreciate the effort and compassion from staff even when it can be busy and stressful :)

reviews.author: Krzysiek Dobosz
reviews.text: 28 November, same place — there are doctor’s appointments, actually two! but not for me… they are for my children! (How??!!) SMS messages confirming my appointment with Dr. Tristan B. also turned out to be a mistake — someone else has an appointment with that doctor. To sum up, this place is a mistake; it’s time to say goodbye to it. On Friday, I was scheduled over the phone for a face-to-face appointment on Tuesday at 10:50 a.m. However, at today’s reception desk, they couldn’t find my appointment. After several minutes of heated discussion among the receptionists, they concluded that the appointment wasn’t for today but for Thursday, November 20th. Another day off work because of Rock Healthcare’s incompetence? I don’t think so — it’s time to say goodbye to this clinic, just like many people and doctors already have.

reviews.author: Lynsey Riley
reviews.text: I had hope when the doctors merged that finally some decent doctors might be avaliable, sadly not. Please do yourselves a favour and dont join this practice. Today I've waited for over an hour past my daughters appointment time with my disabled daughter in absolute agony, you would think perhaps an apology would have been forthcoming but no the doctor then blamed us for us having to queue for nearly 15 minutes when we arrived because the receptionist was helping people in front of us. She then proceeded to medically gaslight my daughter and then refuse to tell me her name when I made it clear I was going to complain. This practice has had some wonderful doctors over the years sadly for the patients they got out while they could.

reviews.author: Chrissie Coulson
reviews.text: I was at an appointment yesterday with a nurse with an infection around and earing that I couldn't remove due to terrible pain, she looked in my ear and said I had an ear infection too, I was asked "do i want cream for the earing infection or antibiotics for my inner ear" I was flabbergasted n thought she would have prescribed both, I said well don't I need antibiotics to clear the infections? So she was typing and said she's sent rhe prescription off to the chemist, I thanked her and picked it up to find no antibiotics just cream for around my earing...rang the surgery this morning n spoke with a very abrupt receptionist, she looked at my notes n said " nurse hadn't written anything about my ear infection" again im shocked as it makes me out like I was lying to receptionist, last week I kept ringing them as my prescription wasn't in the chemist as it had been on order for over a week, kept being told the gp has forgotten to sign it, im going to look in changing my gp.

reviews.author: Becky Goddard
reviews.text: If I could give a 0 rating I would. I tried to login to Ask my GP at 8am this morning to get an appointment for an 3 year old and the site wouldn’t not allow me on, so I rang the surgery. I was put on hold and caller number 20. I was on hold for 25 minutes, to be told that they could not offer my daughter an appointment. I rang 111 who wanted to send me to an urgent care department over 30 minutes away. They sent a referral request to the GP and told me to ring them back. I rang back to be told again there was nothing they could do for my daughter and to go and sit in urgent care at the hospital. My daughter is 3, has a temperature, ear and and a sore throat, she doesn’t need to go to hospital, she needs to see a doctor at her GP practice!!

reviews.author: Lukasz Kuznicki
reviews.text: Very disappointed. I don't know why I still paying national insurance. Useless service

reviews.author: Claire Grover
reviews.text: Edit sept 2025: I've moved from this practice now. Can never get an appt, wait 2-3 weeks just for a telephone appt. Held back on prescribing HRT as I was due a review but couldnt fit me in. On hold forever then get cut off. Time for a change hopefully for the better. Staff are lovely when you can get through or see anyone. On hold for hours, usually end up having to have a tel appt first. Or you wait to get to a lower number in the queue and they cut you off. The worst part is the awful recording when you first ring, if you are unwell it's like nails on a chalkboard absolutely awful. When you do go especially to radcliffe the place is empty. I'm currently struggling for the past year and have a growth I'm concerned about. Time to try and move GP - not sure what happened used to be brilliant years ago!

reviews.author: Steve Williams
reviews.text: I came on here and noticed I left a review from 2 years ago of one star. I can confirm that ZERO progress has been made on how this surgery is operationally run. The GPs are fine, but the staff and Backoffice are the most unproductive you will find. Many a time I had travelled over 40 mins for an appointment to find it cancelled on me with no notice. They are not even bothered. Honestly, they need shutting down because the locum doctors who are OK, are not invested in change, just doing a shift. To think this surgery was OUTSTANDING when I started with them, a long distant memory Im afraid.

reviews.author: Kateryna Yeremyeyeva
reviews.text: Very disappointed with how my daughter’s blood test appointment was handled. After waiting nearly a month for the earliest available slot, it was cancelled on the same morning — just a few hours before — with no explanation and no help rebooking. I had taken a day off work and kept my daughter out of school for this. The lack of support and communication was unacceptable, especially when it concerns a child with ongoing health issues.

reviews.author: Sarah Marsh
reviews.text: Currently been on hold and 'caller number 1 in the queue' for 37 minutes.

reviews.author: Barbara Lodge
reviews.text: Went to see Dr Faiza Khan.What a great doctor.I’ve found her very kind ,helpful and knowledgeable.After being see by several different doctors in the past I hope she will stay in the practice.

reviews.author: Scott Barclay
reviews.text: Went to see Dr Zahid the other day and couldn't be more complimentary about his care. Lucky to have guys like him to help us. Reception also pretty helpful and didn't have a long wait for an appointment.

reviews.author: Kyrena Jeffrey
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would! Mental health cry out was ignored got booked another telephone appointment 24 hours after original cry out for help to be ignored again third appointment booked for telephone for Monday 13th January 25 at 15.10 in total made to wait 4 days

reviews.author: Pie Armsbey
reviews.text: Absolutely diabolical service. From the very top to the bottom. The doctors don’t care, or are clueless. The receptionist are totally objectionable. This place needs closing down and turning into a big BnM’s. At least it will then be serving OUR community. What’s worse ids that they know it. How the Government fund that I’d love to blame Labour but it’s been like this for a decade. Disrespectful, unempathetic useless Close this down

reviews.author: Funk Monkey
reviews.text: Been with this practice now 2-3 years and have been passed around 4-5 different doctors, had several vials of blood lost, test results going missing, waiting on hold for several hours a week to be hung up on or told "call back tomorrow"... being told "someone will contact you in the next week or two with your next appointment" and then being forgotten about for aver a month or two, then when you try to call up to chase things up and the phone number does not even ring anymore?!? Like what is this country and its 'Public Services' becoming seriously??? Absolute joke

reviews.author: Charlie Green
reviews.text: This practise is awful, I desperately wish someone would come and give this place a revamp. Call waiting times are horrific, I called three times this morning - twice the receptionist couldn't hear me and kept saying 'Hello?' before hanging up, this was on two different mobiles so definitely an issue on their end. I was first in the queue when I rang and when I had to call back there were no appointments left. Recently I started trying a different tactic and arriving at the practise for 8am to try and get an appointment in person first thing. Multiple times I've been in there before the receptionists have, despite the practise opening at 8:00. Girls walking in and sitting down in their coats, turning their computers on at 08:10 while there's a queue of people, the phone ringing off the hook and being unanswered. Another time I got a letter saying 'Please ring us about a letter we have received.' and both times I rang the receptionist had no idea why they'd sent the message and booked a very vague appointment for me where I had to wait a week to find out what it was for. Anxiety inducing to say the least. There's just no onus on the team there. The doctors and nurses are lovely but the reception team need serious training. It's awful.

reviews.author: Muhammad Naveed
reviews.text: I have had accident on work and I went hospital after that I had appointment for physiotherapy they said see your GP I call them on Thursday my number was on call 13 when I came on my number they disconnect my call I ring them again they said no more appointment available again today is Monday my number was on call 18 when I came on Number 9 they aging discounte my call very bad service

reviews.author: Ken Za
reviews.text: I had a very disappointing experience with the receptionist handling phone calls. She disconnected the call twice, and I found it extremely difficult to secure an appointment, with wait times ranging from 3 weeks to a month. There was a complete lack of empathy for my medical condition. When I was in the first month of my pregnancy, I had to visit the emergency room, and was advised to follow up with a GP. Despite multiple attempts, I couldn’t get an appointment either by phone or in person. I was told to call at 8 AM, only to encounter long wait times, all while in a distressing condition. The lack of compassion and understanding from the staff is deeply concerning.

reviews.author: rabia zaffar
reviews.text: Worst worst worst surgery ever! They have a pathetic service. People at reception have no shame rescheduling appointments again and again for months.

reviews.author: Richard Weddell
reviews.text: I've just tried to call the practice (literally - no exaggeration) 200 times and failed to get through. I have to ask, wouldn't it have been easier and more efficient for them to call me to arrange an appointment - rather than to spend the time sending me a text and requesting me do so, given that they know that their phone lines are always busy and it's a total lottery about whether you can ever get through. That is just process over patient experience. Should look at changing their process to be more patient centric.

reviews.author: Nicholla & Jon
reviews.text: I’ve never known a surgery to have so many doctors working as receptionists. Getting through on the phone is difficult but actually getting an appointment is impossible. The reception team are quite happy to diagnose you and tell you it’s not important enough to warrant being seen by the doctor. This place is an absolute shambles and likely not far off special measures.

reviews.author: John Smale
reviews.text: Went in last was told no appointments ring up at 8am which I've been doing for a month puts a review up because receptionist was so unhelpful got a phone call day after from the bar doc over my review gets told appointment has been booked for 3pm Monday 1st July sits from 2.50pm till 3.25pm goes to receptionist asks about my appointment I haven't got one booked so why did no one from the reception shout my name and ask me about it left me there till 3.30pm and receptionist gets on high horse again absolutely shocking service this doctor surgery is going downhill

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text: I've been waiting 4 months for a phone call. Rang them today and discovered they haven't updated my phone number. Was promised a phone call to review my Medication for PTSD today between 1-6 they never rang again. I've no medication left. Absolutely useless.

reviews.author: julian lambert
reviews.text: I originally gave a bad review as the practice was dreadful couldn't get appointments and when you rang you'd often wait a long time in a queue only to get to number 1 then have line cut, sometimes that would happen more than once untill the appointment hour had timed out.. More recently things got better and there was new staff making more effort and much better service. Let's hope it continues so I'm changing my original 1 star review to 4 for now at least

reviews.author: Jon Cooper
reviews.text: I visited the surgery (at their request) in December 2023 to fill out the paperwork required for travel vaccinations. Once completed, I was told that the surgery would be in touch to make an appointment for the required jabs. No call came, no appointment was made and now it’s too late for some to be administered. Always a disappointment with Rock healthcare Bury.

reviews.author: Marta Wolf
reviews.text: I spend over an hour on the queue. Finally when I get have a chance to speak with the woman in reception I been told that all the appointments are book for today I told her that I have to and ear infection for last 2 weeks and I need to see gp. Then her fantastic team leader came and told me that I need to call tomorrow morning for appointment as they don't have anything available. I said that I have ear infection and temperature, he said go and speak with pharmacy I said I spoke with them and they ask me to go and see gp. Such an unless people, they always chating in reception doing nothing. The worst service and place ever!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Karen Doyle
reviews.text: For the last 12months I have had numerous illnesses and diagnosis,s , my hospital referrals and appointments have been dealt with professional and quickly, the doctors keep in touch all the time to follow up on my progress and are so helpful when in the surgery, I also praise the receptionists for their patience. It saddens me to read negative reviews as the pressure they are under is unimaginable, I would also like to mention the excellent care recieved from the doctors and nurses at Fairfield hospital x

reviews.author: Bradley Green
reviews.text: Still terrible

reviews.author: Rainbow 2526
reviews.text: Terrible gp practice, it use to be brilliant one time but has gone downhill. Dr rottawa and dr patel were so good now there's loads of different doctors and you dont get to see the same doctor ! Whenever I call I'm waiting an hour maybe more to get through and then get told there's no appointments left ! If you are lucky you might get a phone consultation. There's only one receptionist on the desk who Is always busy , it's a joke . Time to leave and go elsewhere

reviews.author: ben radley
reviews.text: The fact GP practices are not run on apps nowadays is unbelievable, it's crazy you can't book an appointment in a weeks time on an app. Ringing up at 8am being on hold for 2 hours is such an ancient way of working its shameful

reviews.author: noor amiri
reviews.text: The most useless and time killer practice in all England I am really sorry for typing this but I am sure they deserve it. If you have 2:45pm an appointment they will call you at 3:15pm😞 …

reviews.author: Adrian Chiller
reviews.text: Made me wait an hour on the line in waiting list and hung up when I got to first. This isn't the first time either. Go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Stephen Pang
reviews.text: This place must be most busiest surgery practice in the world. Took me an hour to get thru, just to get hung up. Asked for an appointment for my daughter but got told to call tomorrow instead. luckily it's not an emergency otherwise we'll be all dead. The nurses and doctors are great but the system needs re looking. Avoid if you can.

reviews.author: john goodall
reviews.text: Doctor not very good

reviews.author: Alaa Shadad
reviews.text: Recommend! Doctors are helpful and the receptionists are polite 👍 …

reviews.author: Mike Cottam
reviews.text: Im not criticising just stating the facts. Started my call at number 5 in the queue. Took 18 mins to get to 4, 31 mins to 2 (missed 3 as presumably someone had given up or worse), 35 mins to 1 in the queue and then only another 9 minutes for the call to be answered. I managed to get an appointment and only have to wait 17 days. I would urge everyone to read reviews before deciding on a gp practice.

reviews.author: Shintimon Karotte Thottuvayal
reviews.text: Some of the receptionists are very rude and racial at times. Once I name and complained, but still not changed. I had to face unnessasay waiting with infant because of there discrimination...

reviews.author: Karolina
reviews.text: Truly awful practice.

reviews.author: anna oronsaye
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible service. The receptionist never hear when I call after waiting 30 minutes to get through only for her to say I can't hear you and hang up. Never get to see a gp and whenever I go walk-in they tell you to go to your gp. Told the receptionist and she said go back and tell them gp does not have appointment when she can hear the agony in my voice plus I have done a blood test but gp can only give me results in 2 weeks time even though the results are in and the gp messaged that they need to talk to me regarding my results. Imagine if there is something seriously wrong with me. Since I have been moved to rock health care I have never received a satisfying service. If I could leave 0 star I will!

reviews.author: Chunhong Zhen
reviews.text: Most disgusting GP ever been to. Was 8th in place and waited one hour only to be hung up on. Made appointments for consultation and never get called back. Claimed they’ve made calls all the time but we always wait on the calls and they never end up calling. Must report this GP absolutely disappointed

reviews.author: Daniel Richards
reviews.text: On hold for ages only for someone to answer then slam the phone down. Need more staff on reception to help handle all the calls.

reviews.author: 香奈儿Kay
reviews.text: Terrible GP. Take forever to get through, get hung up on many times when asking for appointments. Never get back to us when we ask for help and advice. Ridiculous GP, worst practice we ever been to

reviews.author: Heather Wilkinson
reviews.text: JUST NOW......... waited 56 minutes and got to number 1 in queue from 11th, my call was then disconnected. Have been phoning continually since yesterday afternoon, but queue hasn't varied from 18th. Same again today then this happens. I'm waiting for a prescription from the doctor I spoke with yesterday morning. How on earth am I supposed to get to know if it's on its way if I can't get through ???

reviews.author: AR Rehm4n
reviews.text: I struggle so so much when it comes to get appointments especially for my babies . No continuity of care . Doctors show no empathy (except for few rare ones ) . Everytime I call , I am on number 20-25 in queue but by the time I come to number one phone gets dropped . So so disappointed

reviews.author: Dominic Diala
reviews.text: I felt so sad after waiting for about half an hour only for the receptionist to pick up the phone and say hello! hello!! hellooo!!! on the quiet line then she hang up. I have to start all-over again. it's horrible!!! go fix your telephone line plssss

reviews.author: Joanne Richards
reviews.text: Absolutely shocking practise, has got to be the worst practise in Bury, if i could leave zero stars i would. Receptionists are rude. Doctors don't bother ringing for pre scheduled telephone appointments, they just don't call at all. Even trying to get through to them at "quiet times" will take usually an hour thats if you manage to get through at all and they don't cut you off after an hour waiting. Trying to get an appointment even with a baby is an absolute joke and if you do manage by miracle to get to see or speak to a doctor, you never see or speak to the same doctor again. Hospital referrals have been "lost" and to top it off my medical records have been updated incorrectly. Avoid like the plague!

reviews.author: Ashraf Shaaban
reviews.text: Uncooperative staff at all, especially the reception staff on the third floor, trying to waste the visitors' time without achieving I asked them for a simple document for my child, and they are delaying me.

reviews.author: Denny Gill
reviews.text: Usually call to get a repeat prescription, was told rudely by a young girl that they dont do that anymore and i have to order through the pharmacy, i mentioned that i have another issue to mention about the fact the doctor missed an appointment call with me but she put the phone down on me before i could explain and rebook, shocking service!

reviews.author: MK Alam
reviews.text: Never have appointments with doctors face to face, only on the phone.

reviews.author: Lauren Newsome
reviews.text: Doctor here refused medication that's been on repeat for over 10 years. Medication this doctor obviously knows nothing about as it should not be stopped abruptly. The receptionist is unprofessional until you tell her the telephone conversation is being recorded. Gets offended when you speak to her the same way she speaks to you. Telephone warrior at it's finest. Wouldn't bother using a doctor here if I was dieing. Also first ever app/dealing with these jokers. Now for me to find another doctors as this one is clearly incompetent.

reviews.author: MDP
reviews.text: Don't think they understand the concept of an appointment time. Expect to wait 45 minutes past your time.

reviews.author: Grace Morrow
reviews.text: Appointment booked for Friday 20th, no face to face appointments so was told a cal would be made between 1-5pm. No call and still nothing to date! Absolutely appalling service! Wouldn’t put my life in their hands! Also the Ask My GP service is also a let down.

reviews.author: Leanne Kavanagh
reviews.text: 50 mins to get through to someone to chase prescriptions which haven't even been put through on 'ask my gp' shocking

reviews.author: Toby Riley
reviews.text: I have a particularly upset wife right now because of the impatience of the phone consultations this place offers. It was hard for her to hear on the quiet line, and as a result. Missed out some information regarding an ear infection that a course of antibiotics hasn't cleared up yet. Before she was able to ask for a repeat of the information, and before she could ask to make sure the prescription would be sent to the correct place (As it was not last time), she was hung up on abruptly. Calling back resets the queue and even though she waited through again, she was hung up on a second time. Of course, now the prescription is being sent to the wrong place -again-. And my wife now has to take a long bus/tram trip into Manchester to pick up what may very well be a wrong prescription by the looks of the other complaints here. Appalling. I understand that with backlogs and stresses due to covid makes it a pressure to get through queues fast enough. But I would guess with just improving level of care to at least a basic level they would cut the times significantly because they wont be inundated by return callers clogging up the line!

reviews.author: HelloClarice
reviews.text: Firstly if there were an option to give no stars then this would be my rating. Abhorrent health practice. How this place has not been closed down by CQC for negligent practice I do not know. As a healthcare professional myself I have first hand witness the distress and anxiety this incompetent surgery team cause my mother. It seems this practice are using covid restriction amongst others to justify the shocking customer care and service they provide their patient's. Prescriptions are ALWAYS late or incorrect, with little to no excuse as to why. Staff seem below minimum on the basic training they should have working within a healthcare environment handling clinical data. Pittyful service. Do not register if you want to feel valued and looked after. This surgery is incapable of providing this most basic of services.

reviews.author: B H
reviews.text: The poor girl on reception is under incredible pressure. It's not fair on staff and patients alike to have the entire process hinge on one individual. I can imagine this place has a high staff turnover. It's a shame because the foundation for a good local clinic is very much in place. Sort it out hr!! Amendment I have only recently moved to the area and joined this surgery. I take regular medication and asked for my repeat prescription only to be told its not possible...it was, it would be available to collect from Tesco pharmacy...it wasn't, and if I've run out to go to a&e...I couldn't. Really struggling without 3 days medication. Really struggling to recommend stepping foot in this place. Amendment #2 Okay after another medication disaster I'm back. Firstly I want to make it clear the receptionist with long red hair is phenomenal. She is the only person there who has helped me and for that reason, and that reason alone, I'm moving this up to 2 stars. That's how good she is. If you get her you've got lucky. If you get any of the other charming reception staff....well...good luck to you!

reviews.author: Natalie Hewitt
reviews.text: Indescribably horrific. Since leaving home I have not found a single decent gp but in comparison to this one they were all amazing. This place honestly needs to be shut down. They are telling me I need a review for a medication I’ve been on for 5 years. I’ve been on similar medication for this condition for 8 years now and NOT ONCE has a gp wanted to review it because it was prescribed by the hospital. Gps have no idea about my condition - it is specialist!! But I got an appointment for this review otherwise they wouldn’t give me my medication. They give me a phone appointment. I am autistic, and when I got home I decided I really couldn’t deal with a phone appointment, my whole day will be filled with anxiety because of it. So I call them and explain, and they said they can’t make face to face appointments and hung up. Don’t bother with this surgery!

reviews.author: Nadia Ahmad
reviews.text: Worst surgery ever experienced, For any appointment, they require to call at 8am. I started calling sharp 8:00am, there line was busy for good 17 minutes, finally when call got connected, and waiting in the queue for another 20 minutes, they said they are booked for today, call tomorrow, my 3 years and 3 months old babies are unwell, and they didn't even give phone appointment with Dr. Highly unprofessional

reviews.author: Kathryn duckworth
reviews.text: Myself and my husband have had such a bad experience while registered at this practice, (we have since moved). Too many problems to list, but we became exhausted with trying to get appointments and take telephone appointments, which are useless if you work and can't access your phone. Overall so stressful being at this practice, would definitely not recommend.

reviews.author: Yawar Malik
reviews.text: You will never see the same GP. You will constantly be making multiple trips to the pharmacy because they either mess up or don’t send the prescriptions at all. You decide to call them in advance of each pharmacy trip to check that the prescriptions have been sent (to mitigate the above mentioned issues) they will of course assure you all has been sent correctly. You’ll subsequently visit the pharmacy who still won’t have it. You’ll sure enough fall behind on your medications and the matter will still take 2-3 calls, 1-2 weeks and possibly another 1-2 fruitless pharmacy trips to resolve. Each call will have you on hold for at least 10-40 minutes. You’ll want to book an appointment but they can never offer one for at least 3-4 weeks. If your matter can’t wait that long the receptionist will tell you to call at 8 AM during the week in order to book one. So you call the next day and after being on hold for at least 40 minutes (a problem they create by offering no appointments) the usually apathetic admin member on the phone with presumably no medical training will make a judgement as to whether or not your issue is urgent and this will not be open to discussion as the advisor will terminate the call on you quickly to deal with the queue of 50 other calls. So even then theres a fair chance that you won’t get an appointment at all. You’ve had a blood test booked for weeks and unfortunately the only nurse on shift has come down with an illness so they cancel on the day (after you’ve waited 2 weeks for the appointment in the first place). Fair enough the nurses are human as well. Unfortunately at this practice you won’t get another appointment for weeks and it will take multiple of the above excruciating phone calls to rearrange. You’ll decide to make a complaint since you’ve had enough, surprise surprise the practice manager call back will never come. Don’t bother unless you’re a junkie for anxiety (in which case this is the practice for you)

reviews.author: Lee Pycroft
reviews.text: What has happened to this once great service . My experience dealing with this practise during the last 6 weeks has been shambolic. An email has been sent raising my concerns and requesting answers/solutions to the problems I've encountered.

reviews.author: Liv Young
reviews.text: Absolutely disgusted in the service provided by this doctors

reviews.author: emily dunning
reviews.text: Amazing practice. I really cannot understand why it has such low stars. The staff are all so helpful and will always go the extra mile for you. It has been a very hard year for us all - especially for those working in the healthcare industry yet i have always had a pleasant experience within this practice. I spoke to James recently who is one of the receptionists and he was so helpful, nothing that i asked for was too much for him. Thank you James and all of the staff at Rock healthcare - you are doing an amazing job!

reviews.author: Căruntu Livia
reviews.text: I had a very bad experience with one of the nurses, however, I complained and they dealt with it and never assigned her to me again. There is also a very nice receptionist at Bury, called James, he has been very helpful and patient each time he answered my phone call, also today, I can't be greatful enough for how helpful he was. Also but not last, Dr. C Johnson, the Lead GP, has been very helpful and knowledgeable whenever she saw me, referred me to the right departments and when dealing with my complain about the nurse. Thank you, Dr. Johnson and James.

reviews.author: Amelia Shepherd
reviews.text: Worse place ever discarged my son of there records as we moves during lockdown and now left an 18month old who needed an emergency appointment without a doctors should be ashamed of themselves

reviews.author: Paula Wilkinson
reviews.text: Absolutely a waste of time , stay clear do not go. Been with this practice for a few years not once have they ever got my repeat prescription right. Can not get an appointment unless you are dead. It came to a head last weekend had to phone 111 on Friday for tablets which should have been done by doctors. reviews.text: Extremely poor! They don't update your records & they're not accurate! Had an appointment and the Dr didn't put anything we talked about in my record. I'm frequently going through withdrawals because they don't prescribe meds on time despite calling and emailing. Reception is just as bad, they clearly don't care about you here and shouldn't be working in the medical field with their apathy. I'm supposed to get the vaccine due to my severe asthma and they denied it because their records don't show my asthma despite having it my whole life, on inhalers multiple times a day, and have been hospitalised for asthma issues. Rhys is a nightmare and straight up denied me medical assistance, putting my life in danger. Do not use this surgery! If you have to go farther for a different gp, please do!

reviews.author: Lynton Susman
reviews.text: Significant turnover of GP's, within a couple of years, many often seeking partnerships with other practices. Extremely unusual to see or even speak to the same GP twice over any course of treatment and so, continuity of care and a rapport between patient and any specific clinician, becomes challenging. Nursing staff have always been fantastic, without which, Rock Healthcare just would not function.. Receptionists, whilst polite, efficient and well meaning, are clearly overstretched. More staff "on the phones" are needed at peak times. As much as 20 mins+ to get through, is questionably a "health risk" in itself, more so for those who may be so unwell, yet may, give up and so hang up. What happens to them is anyone's guess. As a NHS GP Practice, Rock Healthcare has deteriorated significantly in the last few years, particularly as a consequence of losing a totally excellent Nurse Practitioner to another GP practice.

reviews.author: Kathryn Hibbert
reviews.text: I'd love to know who rated this practice as excellent, as seen on the walls of their surgeries??? Rude receptionists! Telling me what medication I can order and when. Trying to blame my old, brilliant, efficient surgery for them still not having my records after four months resulting in lack if meds I need. Incompetent nurse decides I don't have copd, although diagnosed 3yrs ago by doctor and hospital. She stops only non steroid inhaler so now I can't breathe.Ignorant receptionist booked me a Sunday sppointment and I was told off for making it as Sundays are emergency only. Had to leave without being seen after waiting 40mins for pre-booked nurse. On 3rd set of blood tests in a month, although all for same tests. When I asked nurse why she rudely told me she doesn't ask questions, just does her job. Told her not to bother as I will be going back to spring lane Doctors. I'd joined the rock in Radcliffe as it was closer but can only ever get appointment in bury. An all round disgraceful service. I wouldn't have given them one star but had to to be able to leave review.

reviews.author: Leni
reviews.text: 1. Make sure you know when you're going to be unwell guys, because you won't get an appointment for weeks. 2. Rude reception staff who become even ruder if you don't want to tell them why you are making an appointment. 3. After politely pointing out that their customer service is not what it once was, the arrogant woman on the phone replied 'mmm, ok then'. 4. Once saw a doctor who seemed on the surface to be understanding, but was also very quick to get me prescribed and out the door. This is fine, but he prescribed me antibiotics that are known to induce insomnia, when I had just explained to him that lack of sleep was worsening my eczema. It was only after reading the many horrendous online reviews stating that people had suffered psychosis from lack of sleep and had to be admitted to a psychiatric unit, that I called the understanding nurse and told her I would no longer be taking them; I had actually had zero sleep for 2 days and thought I was going insane. In addition, I didn't really need them as my skin wasn't actually infected (I eventually cleared it using Pellamex and gradually improving my sleep habits) 5. If you are even a minute late, you will be scolded and potentially not seen; however, it seems perfectly acceptable practice for the surgery to make their patients wait up to an hour, with no apology or warning. I shall be investigating other practices that I can go to and I will be writing a formal letter of complaint and many other reviews, as they seem to think they can get away with this level of service due to patient need. If they were private business they'd have been dead in the water a long time ago. We must hold them to account.

reviews.text: Poor customer service !!!

reviews.author: Fiona Brady
reviews.text: I rang to request some ooramorph as I'd been in tears with really bad endometriosis pain. Id explained I'd requested it on line the day before but the pain was getting very bad again. The receptionist said he would escalate it to urgent & to ring after 6pm. I was doubled over in pain. By that time so callef the nxt day only to be told by a rude receptionist that it hadn't been done & that they don't do emergency prescriptions it always takes 24 hrs. I was then left not knowing iwhen i might be given the pain relief i needed. When i do get the medicine its a tiny bottle that only lasts a wk when ive a flare up. This means i would need to request another prescription within a wk or 2 which i wouldn't get. I therefore am left to order it when the nxt flare up happens and hope the reception staff will be in a helpful mood & get it sorted quickly for me. The reception staff particularly the females are generally rude & unhelpful at the best of times. ITis not the 1st time ive been made to wait a few dys for emergency pain relief.

reviews.author: Kate F
reviews.text: A decent surgery, but don't advertise online patient services if you cannot provide them! I've been a patient here since January 2018, and so far, I've had positive experiences with all the doctors and (all but one of the) nurses I have seen. Sister Nicola Rigby is absolutely brilliant, and has helped me tremendously with treatment and advice for a condition I have struggled to control for almost 15 years. However the admin system and online patient services tools are TERRIBLE and really let this otherwise decent surgery down. My partner and I both had to fill out the same new patient forms (including all our medications) and online access forms THREE TIMES before anything was processed correctly - why this happened we weren't sure. Even this wasn't 100% successful as my partner then had to book an appointment to see the the doctor to get his long-term prescription verified. The online appointment booking system is also non-functional; I have tried to book appointments several times, searching weeks and months ahead for a session with any doctor at either of the surgeries, and whatever parameters I set, the result is the same. THERE ARE NO APPOINTMENTS AVAILABLE. Yet if I call the surgery, I usually get an appointment within a week or so with no issues. I've heard from a number of patients who've also had the same problem. Rock Healthcare, PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE DO NOT ADVERTISE ONLINE PATIENT SERVICES IF YOU CANNOT PROVIDE THEM.

How can the cqc rate them as outstanding???? I'm pretty sure I'll have even more difficulties after they read this review ! Terrible
